	 * Maximum GPU mesh DISPATCHES launched per frame — the mesh-consumer drain rate (1-32).
	 * Was hardcoded to 2, which was far too conservative: A/B on the demo showed 2->6 cuts
	 * post-traverse queue drain ~2.5x and peak mesh backlog ~35% at zero frame cost (the
	 * per-dispatch render/game-thread cost is small vs frame time at moderate traversal).
	 * Each dispatch builds an RDG graph + ~150KB upload + 4 compute passes, so very high
	 * values trade render-thread frame time for drain rate — raise MaxAsyncMeshTasks /
	 * MaxPendingMeshes alongside it or the in-flight caps bind first. Runtime override:
	 * voxel.Stream.MaxMeshDispatchPerFrame.
	 */
	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Performance", meta = (ClampMin = "1", ClampMax = "32"))
	int32 MaxMeshDispatchPerFrame = 6;

	/** Target frame rate for adaptive throttling (0 = disabled) */
	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Performance", meta = (ClampMin = "0", ClampMax = "240"))
	float TargetFrameRate = 60.0f;

	/** Reduce generation work when FPS drops below target */
	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Performance")
	bool bAdaptiveThrottling = true;

	/** Defer collision/scatter when generation queue exceeds this count (0 = disabled) */
	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Performance", meta = (ClampMin = "0", ClampMax = "200"))
	int32 DeferSubsystemsThreshold = 20;

	/** Maximum concurrent async scatter generation tasks (1-4). Scatter extraction and placement run on thread pool. */
	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Performance", meta = (ClampMin = "1", ClampMax = "4"))
	int32 MaxAsyncScatterTasks = 2;

	/** Maximum concurrent async collision cooking tasks (1-4). Collision mesh generation runs on thread pool. */
	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Performance", meta = (ClampMin = "1", ClampMax = "4"))
	int32 MaxAsyncCollisionTasks = 2;

public:
	UVoxelWorldConfiguration();

	/** Get the world size of a single chunk */
	FORCEINLINE float GetChunkWorldSize() const
	{
		return ChunkSize * VoxelSize;
	}

	/**
	 * Whether the LOD system runs for this world: bEnableLOD, except that cubic meshing always runs
	 * without LOD (greedy meshing is its LOD mechanism, so cubic chunks mesh at full detail at every
	 * distance). Read this instead of bEnableLOD.
	 *
	 * @return True when chunks get distance-band LOD levels, false when every chunk is LOD 0.
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintPure, Category = "LOD")
	bool IsLODEnabled() const
	{
		return bEnableLOD && MeshingMode != EMeshingMode::Cubic;
	}

	/**
	 * Whether terrain generation can run on the GPU: bUseGPUGeneration, in every world mode. Spherical planets were
	 * held on the CPU until the GPU generator had a planet branch (SP-B3: it fell through to generic 3D noise, blobs
	 * instead of a planet); since spherical Phase 2 the GPU generates the CPU's planet (SP-B4), locked by
	 * VoxelWorlds.Generation.GPUvsCPUSphericalParity (WORLD_MODES_REVIEW_PLAN.md §16).
	 * The chunk manager also honours -VoxelForceCPU and voxel.GPUGeneration.Enable on top of this.
	 *
	 * @return True when the configuration allows GPU generation.
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintPure, Category = "Noise Generation")
	bool ShouldUseGPUGeneration() const
	{
		return bUseGPUGeneration;
	}

	/** Get the world size of a single chunk at a specific LOD */
	float GetChunkWorldSizeAtLOD(int32 LODLevel) const;

	/** Get LOD band for a given distance, returns nullptr if beyond all bands */
	const FLODBand* GetLODBandForDistance(float Distance) const;

	/** Get the LOD level for a given distance */
	int32 GetLODLevelForDistance(float Distance) const;

	/** Validate configuration and log any issues (including GetSettingsWarnings) */
	bool ValidateConfiguration() const;

	/**
	 * A planet's terrain extent over and under WorldRadius: BaseHeight with continentalness's offsets and PlanetHeightScale
	 * at its largest multiplier, the numbers GetSettingsWarnings checks the shell (PlanetMaxTerrainHeight / Depth)
	 * against (FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetDisplacementBounds). Spherical Phase 6's test planets size their shells
	 * from it (Scripts/setup_planet_test.py).
	 * @param OutHighest How far above WorldRadius the terrain can reach
	 * @param OutDeepest How far below WorldRadius it can reach
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintPure, Category = "Voxel|World")
	void GetPlanetTerrainExtent(float& OutHighest, float& OutDeepest) const;

	/**
	 * Settings that load and run but produce wrong results, one readable line each: a tree template using a
	 * material id the material registry does not define (KC10); on a planet, a terrain shell that does not cover
	 * the terrain's real amplitude, and water enabled while consumers still read the Z-plane WaterLevel
	 * (SPHERICAL_PLANET_REQUIREMENTS.md SP-A5). Logged as warnings when the asset loads (PostLoad), when a voxel
	 * world initializes with it, and from ValidateConfiguration.
	 *
	 * @return The warnings; empty when nothing is wrong.
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintPure, Category = "Voxel|Configuration")
	TArray<FString> GetSettingsWarnings() const;

	/**
	 * Get the start distance for material-based LOD morphing.
	 * Derived from LODBands: first band's (MaxDistance - MorphRange)
	 */
	float GetMaterialLODStartDistance() const;

	/**
	 * Get the end distance for material-based LOD morphing.
	 * Derived from LODBands: last band's MaxDistance (clamped to ViewDistance)
	 */
	float GetMaterialLODEndDistance() const;

	/**
	 * Get the spawn position for spherical planet mode over the datum (no terrain: the configuration has no world mode).
	 * Returns WorldOrigin + SpawnDirection * (WorldRadius + PlanetSpawnAltitude). For the point over the terrain use
	 * UVoxelChunkManager::GetPlanetSpawnPosition (spherical SP-B11).
	 *
	 * PlanetSpawnLocation values:
	 *   0 = +X (Equator East)
	 *   1 = +Y (Equator North)
	 *   2 = +Z (North Pole) - Default
	 *   3 = -Z (South Pole)
	 *
	 * Only valid when WorldMode == SphericalPlanet.
	 */
	FVector GetPlanetSpawnPosition() const;

	/**
	 * Object path of a configuration that replaces the one assigned to the voxel world actor, or an
	 * empty string when none is set. Lets benchmarks and reviews A/B world modes and meshing modes on
	 * one map without editing it.
	 *
	 * Sources, in priority order: the -VoxelConfig=<ObjectPath> command-line switch (headless and
	 * standalone runs), then the voxel.ConfigOverride console variable (set it in the editor before
	 * pressing Play). Read when a voxel world initializes, so a change applies to the next PIE session.
	 *
	 * @return Object path such as /Game/PluginTesting/Review/Review_Cubic, or empty.
	 */
	static FString GetOverridePath();

	/** Logs GetSettingsWarnings, so a bad asset is reported when it loads. */
	virtual void PostLoad() override;

#if WITH_EDITOR
	virtual void PostEditChangeProperty(FPropertyChangedEvent& PropertyChangedEvent) override;
#endif
};
```

### Source/VoxelCore/Public/VoxelWorldModeTypes.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "VoxelCoreTypes.h"
#include "VoxelWorldModeTypes.generated.h"

/**
 * Shape of a world's bounds (FVoxelWorldBounds). Part of the world-mode API (world modes review WM-A2).
 */
UENUM(BlueprintType)
enum class EVoxelWorldBoundsShape : uint8
{
	/** No edge: the world extends without limit in X and Y (InfinitePlane) */
	Unbounded,

	/** A disc in XY around Center with radius OuterRadius (a circular island's R + falloff) */
	Circle,

	/** An axis-aligned rectangle in XY around Center with half sizes HalfExtent (a rectangular island) */
	Rectangle,

	/** A spherical shell around Center, InnerRadius to OuterRadius (a planet's terrain shell) */
	Shell
};

/**
 * Where a world ends: IVoxelWorldMode::GetWorldBounds, Blueprint-callable through UVoxelChunkManager::GetWorldBounds.
 *
 * Consumers that place, explore, spawn or navigate use it to stay inside the world: an island's bounds are the
 * R + falloff footprint (beyond it generation only writes a flat floor), a plane has none, a planet's are its terrain
 * shell. Part of the world-mode API (world modes review WM-A2, findings KI1 and KI9).
 */
USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
struct VOXELCORE_API FVoxelWorldBounds
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

	/** Shape of the bounds */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	EVoxelWorldBoundsShape Shape = EVoxelWorldBoundsShape::Unbounded;

	/** Centre in world space: the island's centre at the datum height (heightmap modes) or the planet centre */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	FVector Center = FVector::ZeroVector;

	/** Half sizes in X and Y of the footprint's box: (R+F, R+F) for a circle, the half sizes for a rectangle, the outer radius for a shell */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	FVector2D HalfExtent = FVector2D::ZeroVector;

	/** Shell: the inner radius (the deepest terrain). 0 for the other shapes */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	float InnerRadius = 0.0f;

	/** Circle: the footprint radius. Shell: the outer radius (the highest terrain). 0 otherwise */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	float OuterRadius = 0.0f;

	/** Lowest world Z the terrain reaches (heightmap modes: the terrain height bounds; shell: Center.Z - OuterRadius) */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	float MinZ = 0.0f;

	/** Highest world Z the terrain reaches */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	float MaxZ = 0.0f;

	/**
	 * Shell: the outer out-of-world bound, a distance from Center (the datum radius plus the planet's orbit ceiling,
	 * spherical Phase 6): a pawn farther out has left the world, and KillZ sits below it. 0 for the other shapes
	 */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	double OrbitRadius = 0.0;

	/** @return True unless the world is unbounded */
	bool IsBounded() const { return Shape != EVoxelWorldBoundsShape::Unbounded; }

	/**
	 * Whether the vertical line at (X, Y) passes through the world: always for an unbounded world, inside the
	 * footprint for an island, inside the shell's outer radius for a planet.
	 *
	 * @param X World X
	 * @param Y World Y
	 * @return True when (X, Y) is inside the footprint
	 */
	bool ContainsXY(double X, double Y) const;

	/**
	 * Whether a point is inside the world. Heightmap worlds are bounded in X and Y only (a point above or below the
	 * footprint is inside); a planet's world is everything within its outer radius.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos World position
	 * @return True when the point is inside
	 */
	bool Contains(const FVector& WorldPos) const;

	/**
	 * The footprint's axis-aligned box in X and Y.
	 *
	 * @return The box; an invalid box (IsValid false) for an unbounded world
	 */
	FBox2D GetBox2D() const;

	// ==================== Footprint geometry (world modes review M3: WM-I1, WM-I2, WM-I5) ====================
	// All in X and Y; a shell is treated as the disc of its outer radius, like ContainsXY.

	/**
	 * Signed distance in X and Y from (X, Y) to the footprint's edge.
	 *
	 * @param X World X
	 * @param Y World Y
	 * @return Positive inside, negative outside; TNumericLimits<double>::Max() for an unbounded world
	 */
	double GetDistanceToEdgeXY(double X, double Y) const;

	/**
	 * Whether a disc lies wholly inside the footprint: a site, its pad and its falloff ring all stay in the world.
	 *
	 * @param X Disc centre X
	 * @param Y Disc centre Y
	 * @param Radius Disc radius
	 * @return True when the whole disc is inside (always for an unbounded world)
	 */
	bool ContainsCircleXY(double X, double Y, double Radius) const;

	/**
	 * Whether a box in X and Y overlaps the footprint: a map tile or a grid cell that holds some of the world.
	 *
	 * @param Box World-space box in X and Y
	 * @return True when any part of the box is inside (always for an unbounded world)
	 */
	bool IntersectsBox2D(const FBox2D& Box) const;

	/**
	 * The nearest point in X and Y at least Margin inside the edge: (X, Y) itself when it already is.
	 *
	 * @param X World X
	 * @param Y World Y
	 * @param Margin How far inside the edge the result stays (clamped so the footprint does not vanish)
	 * @return The clamped point; (X, Y) for an unbounded world
	 */
	FVector2D ClampXY(double X, double Y, double Margin = 0.0) const;

	/**
	 * The unit direction in X and Y out of the world across the nearest edge: radial for a circle, the nearest side's
	 * normal for a rectangle.
	 *
	 * @param X World X
	 * @param Y World Y
	 * @return Unit vector; zero for an unbounded world
	 */
	FVector2D GetOutwardNormalXY(double X, double Y) const;
};

/**
 * A point's position on the world's surface parameterisation: IVoxelWorldMode::WorldToSurface (spherical requirement
 * SP-A2). The key for every 2D consumer (map tiles, navigation grids, POI cells, explored tiles).
 *
 * Heightmap modes: Face 0, UV = world (X, Y). A planet: one of six cube faces and UV in [-1, 1] on it.
 */
USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
struct VOXELCORE_API FVoxelSurfaceCoord
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

	/** Cube face (0-5) on a planet; always 0 in heightmap modes */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Voxel|World")
	int32 Face = 0;

	/** Position on the face: world X and Y in heightmap modes, [-1, 1] on a planet's cube face */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Voxel|World")
	FVector2D UV = FVector2D::ZeroVector;

	FVoxelSurfaceCoord() = default;
	FVoxelSurfaceCoord(int32 InFace, const FVector2D& InUV) : Face(InFace), UV(InUV) {}
};

/**
 * A point on the terrain surface and the surface's orientation there: IVoxelWorldMode::GetSurfacePoint (spherical
 * requirement SP-A1). The analytic surface generation produces, without caves, conditioning zones or edits.
 */
USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
struct VOXELCORE_API FVoxelTerrainSurfacePoint
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

	/** World position of the surface point */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	FVector Position = FVector::ZeroVector;

	/** Unit surface normal, pointing out of the terrain (local up on flat ground) */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	FVector Normal = FVector::UpVector;

	/** The point's height above the datum (IVoxelWorldMode::GetAltitude) */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	float Altitude = 0.0f;
};

/**
 * What generated a world, recorded with its save so a save is never loaded into a different world (world modes review
 * WM-A4, finding KI7; spherical requirement SP-G9). The save key holds the map and the seed; this holds the rest that
 * decides where terrain, edits and records are: the world mode, the mode's shape params, the voxel grid and the
 * generation version. Built by FVoxelWorldModeFactory::MakeFingerprint; read through
 * UVoxelChunkManager::GetWorldFingerprint.
 */
USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
struct VOXELCORE_API FVoxelWorldFingerprint
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

	/** World mode */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	EWorldMode WorldMode = EWorldMode::InfinitePlane;

	/**
	 * The mode's shape params (island extent, falloff, centre and edge height; planet radius, shell and centre) and the
	 * voxel grid (voxel size, chunk size, world origin), as "Name=Value" pairs joined by ';'. Compared as text.
	 */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	FString Shape;

	/**
	 * Version of the generation code that produced the terrain (FVoxelWorldModeFactory::GenerationVersion). 0 means
	 * not recorded: a save written before fingerprints existed.
	 */
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly, Category = "Voxel|World")
	int32 GenerationVersion = 0;

	/** @return True when the fingerprint was recorded (GenerationVersion > 0) */
	bool IsRecorded() const { return GenerationVersion > 0; }

	/**
	 * @param Other Fingerprint to compare with
	 * @return True when the world mode, the shape and the generation version are all equal
	 */
	bool Matches(const FVoxelWorldFingerprint& Other) const;

	/**
	 * What differs from another fingerprint, for logs.
	 *
	 * @param Other Fingerprint to compare with
	 * @return One clause per difference ("world mode IslandBowl vs InfinitePlane; IslandRadius=200000.0 vs 120000.0"),
	 *         empty when they match
	 */
	FString DescribeDifferences(const FVoxelWorldFingerprint& Other) const;

	/** @return "<WorldMode> [<Shape>] gen <GenerationVersion>" */
	FString ToString() const;
};
```

### Source/VoxelGeneration/Private/InfinitePlaneWorldMode.cpp
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#include "InfinitePlaneWorldMode.h"
#include "VoxelCPUNoiseGenerator.h"
#include "VoxelBiomeConfiguration.h"
#include "HAL/IConsoleManager.h"

// When 1 (default), the analytic terrain-height query (GetTerrainHeightAt) applies the same
// continentalness height modulation as generation, so spawn / nav / POI placement matches the real
// generated surface. Set to 0 to restore the legacy raw base-noise height (A/B or emergency revert).
static int32 GVoxelAnalyticContinentalness = 1;
static FAutoConsoleVariableRef CVarVoxelAnalyticContinentalness(
	TEXT("voxel.Height.AnalyticContinentalness"),
	GVoxelAnalyticContinentalness,
	TEXT("1 (default): analytic GetTerrainHeightAt applies continentalness modulation to match the ")
	TEXT("generated surface (spawn/nav/POI). 0: legacy raw base-noise height."),
	ECVF_Default);

FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::FInfinitePlaneWorldMode()
	: TerrainParams()
{
}

FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::FInfinitePlaneWorldMode(const FWorldModeTerrainParams& InTerrainParams)
	: TerrainParams(InTerrainParams)
{
}

float FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetDensityAt(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	int32 LODLevel,
	float NoiseValue) const
{
	// For InfinitePlane, we interpret NoiseValue as terrain height noise
	// Calculate terrain height at this X,Y from the noise value
	float TerrainHeight = NoiseToTerrainHeight(NoiseValue, TerrainParams);

	// Calculate signed distance to surface
	// Positive = below surface (solid), Negative = above surface (air)
	return CalculateSignedDistance(WorldPos.Z, TerrainHeight);
}

float FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightAt(
	float X,
	float Y,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const
{
	// Match generation: modulate the terrain params by continentalness so the analytic height equals
	// the real generated surface (spawn / nav / POI placement). Gated so it can be reverted at runtime.
	// Generation applies continentalness whenever a biome config has it enabled; mirror that here.
	const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* Ctx = IsAnalyticContinentalnessEnabled() ? &BiomeSnapshot : nullptr;
	return SampleTerrainHeight(X, Y, TerrainParams, NoiseParams, Ctx);
}

float FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::SampleTerrainHeight(
	float X,
	float Y,
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& BaseParams,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams,
	const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot)
{
	const float NoiseValue = SampleTerrainNoise2D(X, Y, NoiseParams);
	float Continentalness = 0.0f;
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams EffectiveParams =
		ComputeEffectiveTerrainParams(X, Y, BaseParams, NoiseParams, BiomeSnapshot, Continentalness);
	return NoiseToTerrainHeight(NoiseValue, EffectiveParams);
}

bool FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::IsAnalyticContinentalnessEnabled()
{
	return GVoxelAnalyticContinentalness != 0;
}

FIntVector FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::WorldToChunkCoord(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	int32 ChunkSize,
	float VoxelSize) const
{
	float ChunkWorldSize = ChunkSize * VoxelSize;

	return FIntVector(
		FMath::FloorToInt(WorldPos.X / ChunkWorldSize),
		FMath::FloorToInt(WorldPos.Y / ChunkWorldSize),
		FMath::FloorToInt(WorldPos.Z / ChunkWorldSize)
	);
}

FVector FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::ChunkCoordToWorld(
	const FIntVector& ChunkCoord,
	int32 ChunkSize,
	float VoxelSize,
	int32 LODLevel) const
{
	float ChunkWorldSize = ChunkSize * VoxelSize * FMath::Pow(2.0f, static_cast<float>(LODLevel));

	return FVector(ChunkCoord) * ChunkWorldSize;
}

int32 FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetMinZ() const
{
	return MIN_Z_CHUNKS;
}

int32 FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetMaxZ() const
{
	return MAX_Z_CHUNKS;
}

uint8 FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetMaterialAtDepth(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	float SurfaceHeight,
	float DepthBelowSurface) const
{
	// Material IDs:
	// 0 = Grass (at surface)
	// 1 = Dirt (1-3 voxel depths below surface)
	// 2 = Stone (deep underground)

	if (DepthBelowSurface <= 0.0f)
	{
		// At or above surface - air (no material)
		return 0;
	}
	else if (DepthBelowSurface < 100.0f) // ~1 voxel at default size
	{
		// Near surface - grass
		return 0;
	}
	else if (DepthBelowSurface < 400.0f) // ~1-4 voxels
	{
		// Subsurface - dirt
		return 1;
	}
	else
	{
		// Deep underground - stone
		return 2;
	}
}

// ==================== Static Helpers ====================

float FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::SampleTerrainNoise2D(
	float X,
	float Y,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams)
{
	// Use FBM3D but with Z=0 for 2D heightmap sampling
	// This ensures consistency with the existing noise implementation
	FVector Position2D(X, Y, 0.0f);
	return FVoxelCPUNoiseGenerator::FBM3D(Position2D, NoiseParams);
}

float FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::NoiseToTerrainHeight(
	float NoiseValue,
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& TerrainParams)
{
	// Noise value is in range [-1, 1]:
	//   TerrainHeight = SeaLevel + BaseHeight + (NoiseValue * HeightScale)
	//
	// Intentionally UNCLAMPED, to stay bit-identical with the GPU generator's NoiseToTerrainHeight
	// (Shaders/Private/WorldModeSDF.ush), which applies no height clamp. A former CPU-only clamp to
	// [MinHeight,MaxHeight] silently clipped peaks/valleys the GPU still generated, so the analytic
	// height diverged from the real (GPU) surface above ~10000 uu. The height range is bounded by the
	// caller's HeightScale (+ continentalness); chunk generation is bounded by GetMinZ()/GetMaxZ().
	return TerrainParams.SeaLevel + TerrainParams.BaseHeight + (NoiseValue * TerrainParams.HeightScale);
}

FWorldModeTerrainParams FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::ComputeEffectiveTerrainParams(
	float X,
	float Y,
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& BaseParams,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& BaseNoiseParams,
	const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
	float& OutContinentalness)
{
	return ComputeEffectiveTerrainParamsAt(FVector(X, Y, 0.0f), BaseParams, BaseNoiseParams, BiomeSnapshot, OutContinentalness);
}

FWorldModeTerrainParams FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::ComputeEffectiveTerrainParamsAt(
	const FVector& SamplePos,
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& BaseParams,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& BaseNoiseParams,
	const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
	float& OutContinentalness)
{
	OutContinentalness = 0.0f;
	FWorldModeTerrainParams Effective = BaseParams;

	// Continentalness modulates height independently of biome material selection (matches
	// FVoxelCPUNoiseGenerator::GenerateChunkInfinitePlane, which gates only on bEnableContinentalness).
	if (BiomeSnapshot && BiomeSnapshot->bEnableContinentalness)
	{
		// Same continentalness noise field as generation: 2-octave Simplex, seed offset from the config.
		FVoxelNoiseParams ContinentalnessNoiseParams;
		ContinentalnessNoiseParams.NoiseType = EVoxelNoiseType::Simplex;
		ContinentalnessNoiseParams.Octaves = 2;
		ContinentalnessNoiseParams.Persistence = 0.5f;
		ContinentalnessNoiseParams.Lacunarity = 2.0f;
		ContinentalnessNoiseParams.Amplitude = 1.0f;
		ContinentalnessNoiseParams.Seed = BaseNoiseParams.Seed + BiomeSnapshot->ContinentalnessSeedOffset;
		ContinentalnessNoiseParams.Frequency = BiomeSnapshot->ContinentalnessNoiseFrequency;

		OutContinentalness = FVoxelCPUNoiseGenerator::FBM3D(SamplePos, ContinentalnessNoiseParams);

		float HeightOffset = 0.0f;
		float HeightScaleMult = 1.0f;
		BiomeSnapshot->GetContinentalnessTerrainParams(OutContinentalness, HeightOffset, HeightScaleMult);
		Effective.BaseHeight += HeightOffset;
		Effective.HeightScale *= HeightScaleMult;
	}

	return Effective;
}

FVoxelWorldBounds FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetWorldBounds() const
{
	FVoxelWorldBounds Bounds;
	Bounds.Shape = EVoxelWorldBoundsShape::Unbounded;
	Bounds.Center = FVector(0.0, 0.0, TerrainParams.SeaLevel);
	GetTerrainHeightBounds(Bounds.MinZ, Bounds.MaxZ);
	return Bounds;
}

float FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetAltitude(const FVector& WorldPos) const
{
	return static_cast<float>(WorldPos.Z) - TerrainParams.SeaLevel;
}

FVector FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::SurfaceToWorld(const FVoxelSurfaceCoord& Coord, float Altitude) const
{
	return FVector(Coord.UV.X, Coord.UV.Y, TerrainParams.SeaLevel + Altitude);
}

void FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightBounds(
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& BaseParams,
	const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
	float& OutMin,
	float& OutMax)
{
	// Height at any (X,Y): SeaLevel + (BaseHeight + Offset(cont)) + Noise * (HeightScale * Mult(cont)),
	// with Noise in [-1,1]. Bound each modulated term by its extreme over the continentalness curves.
	float MinOffset = 0.0f;
	float MaxOffset = 0.0f;
	float MaxScaleMult = 1.0f; // no continentalness => full HeightScale amplitude
	if (BiomeSnapshot)
	{
		BiomeSnapshot->GetContinentalnessExtremes(MinOffset, MaxOffset, MaxScaleMult);
	}

	const float Center = BaseParams.SeaLevel + BaseParams.BaseHeight;
	const float Amplitude = BaseParams.HeightScale * MaxScaleMult; // Noise = +/-1 reaches +/- this

	// Conservative decoupled bounds: the true extremes are within these (offset and multiplier are
	// correlated via the same continentalness value, so decoupling only widens the range — never
	// clips real terrain).
	OutMin = Center + MinOffset - Amplitude;
	OutMax = Center + MaxOffset + Amplitude;
}

float FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::CalculateSignedDistance(
	float WorldZ,
	float TerrainHeight)
{
	// Signed distance: positive = inside terrain (solid), negative = outside (air)
	// Distance = TerrainHeight - WorldZ
	// If WorldZ < TerrainHeight, we're below surface (positive distance = solid)
	// If WorldZ > TerrainHeight, we're above surface (negative distance = air)
	return TerrainHeight - WorldZ;
}

uint8 FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::SignedDistanceToDensity(
	float SignedDistance,
	float VoxelSize)
{
	// Convert signed distance to density [0-255]
	// 127 = surface threshold
	// <127 = air, >127 = solid

	// Normalize by voxel size for smooth density falloff
	// A distance of +/- VoxelSize maps to density extremes
	float NormalizedDistance = SignedDistance / VoxelSize;

	// Clamp to [-1, 1] range
	float Clamped = FMath::Clamp(NormalizedDistance, -1.0f, 1.0f);

	// Map to [0, 255] where 127 is surface
	// Positive (solid/inside) maps to 127-255
	// Negative (air/outside) maps to 0-127
	float Density = (Clamped + 1.0f) * 127.5f;

	return static_cast<uint8>(FMath::Clamp(Density, 0.0f, 255.0f));
}
```

### Source/VoxelGeneration/Private/IslandBowlWorldMode.cpp
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#include "IslandBowlWorldMode.h"
#include "InfinitePlaneWorldMode.h"
#include "VoxelMaterialRegistry.h"

FIslandBowlWorldMode::FIslandBowlWorldMode()
	: TerrainParams()
	, IslandParams()
{
}

FIslandBowlWorldMode::FIslandBowlWorldMode(
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& InTerrainParams,
	const FIslandBowlParams& InIslandParams)
	: TerrainParams(InTerrainParams)
	, IslandParams(InIslandParams)
{
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::GetDensityAt(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	int32 LODLevel,
	float NoiseValue) const
{
	// Base terrain height from noise (reusing InfinitePlane logic), then the island falloff, or the seabed
	// beyond the edge. This used to call everything beyond the edge air, where generation writes the seabed.
	const float BaseTerrainHeight = FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::NoiseToTerrainHeight(NoiseValue, TerrainParams);
	const float FinalTerrainHeight = ComposeTerrainHeight(WorldPos.X, WorldPos.Y, BaseTerrainHeight, IslandParams);

	// Calculate signed distance (positive = inside/solid)
	return FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::CalculateSignedDistance(WorldPos.Z, FinalTerrainHeight);
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightAt(
	float X,
	float Y,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const
{
	// Beyond the island's edge: the seabed generation writes there (no noise needed).
	if (!IsWithinIslandBounds(X, Y, IslandParams))
	{
		return GetSeabedHeight(GetDistancePastEdge(X, Y, IslandParams), IslandParams);
	}

	// Sample base terrain noise (reusing InfinitePlane method)
	const float NoiseValue = FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::SampleTerrainNoise2D(X, Y, NoiseParams);

	// Continentalness height modulation (internal oceans/mountains) — the SAME shared source of truth as
	// InfinitePlane; then the island edge falloff. The two compose: continentalness shapes the terrain
	// inside the island, the falloff fades it toward EdgeHeight at the world edge. Matches generation.
	float Continentalness = 0.0f;
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams EffectiveParams = FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::ComputeEffectiveTerrainParams(
		X, Y, TerrainParams, NoiseParams, &BiomeSnapshot, Continentalness);

	const float BaseTerrainHeight = FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::NoiseToTerrainHeight(NoiseValue, EffectiveParams);

	// Apply falloff and return
	return ComposeTerrainHeight(X, Y, BaseTerrainHeight, IslandParams);
}

void FIslandBowlWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightBounds(float& OutMin, float& OutMax) const
{
	// Base continentalness extent (same as InfinitePlane), then lower the minimum to the seabed's floor beyond the
	// edge: the island fades toward EdgeHeight and the seabed slopes SeabedDepth below it, which can be below the
	// base terrain minimum (KI4's bounds clause).
	float BaseMin = 0.0f;
	float BaseMax = 0.0f;
	FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightBounds(TerrainParams, &BiomeSnapshot, BaseMin, BaseMax);
	OutMin = FMath::Min(BaseMin, IslandParams.EdgeHeight - FMath::Max(IslandParams.SeabedDepth, 0.0f));
	OutMax = BaseMax;
}

bool FIslandBowlWorldMode::IsInsideWorld(double X, double Y) const
{
	return IsWithinIslandBounds(static_cast<float>(X), static_cast<float>(Y), IslandParams);
}

FVoxelWorldBounds FIslandBowlWorldMode::GetWorldBounds() const
{
	FVoxelWorldBounds Bounds;
	Bounds.Center = FVector(IslandParams.CenterX, IslandParams.CenterY, TerrainParams.SeaLevel);
	Bounds.HalfExtent = FVector2D(IslandParams.GetTotalExtentX(), IslandParams.GetTotalExtentY());
	if (IslandParams.Shape == EIslandShape::Rectangle)
	{
		Bounds.Shape = EVoxelWorldBoundsShape::Rectangle;
	}
	else
	{
		Bounds.Shape = EVoxelWorldBoundsShape::Circle;
		Bounds.OuterRadius = IslandParams.GetTotalExtent();
	}
	GetTerrainHeightBounds(Bounds.MinZ, Bounds.MaxZ);
	return Bounds;
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::GetAltitude(const FVector& WorldPos) const
{
	return static_cast<float>(WorldPos.Z) - TerrainParams.SeaLevel;
}

FVector FIslandBowlWorldMode::SurfaceToWorld(const FVoxelSurfaceCoord& Coord, float Altitude) const
{
	return FVector(Coord.UV.X, Coord.UV.Y, TerrainParams.SeaLevel + Altitude);
}

FIntVector FIslandBowlWorldMode::WorldToChunkCoord(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	int32 ChunkSize,
	float VoxelSize) const
{
	// Same conversion as InfinitePlane - Cartesian grid
	const float ChunkWorldSize = ChunkSize * VoxelSize;
	return FIntVector(
		FMath::FloorToInt(WorldPos.X / ChunkWorldSize),
		FMath::FloorToInt(WorldPos.Y / ChunkWorldSize),
		FMath::FloorToInt(WorldPos.Z / ChunkWorldSize));
}

FVector FIslandBowlWorldMode::ChunkCoordToWorld(
	const FIntVector& ChunkCoord,
	int32 ChunkSize,
	float VoxelSize,
	int32 LODLevel) const
{
	// Same conversion as InfinitePlane
	const float ChunkWorldSize = ChunkSize * VoxelSize;
	return FVector(ChunkCoord) * ChunkWorldSize;
}

int32 FIslandBowlWorldMode::GetMinZ() const
{
	return MIN_Z_CHUNKS;
}

int32 FIslandBowlWorldMode::GetMaxZ() const
{
	return MAX_Z_CHUNKS;
}

uint8 FIslandBowlWorldMode::GetMaterialAtDepth(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	float SurfaceHeight,
	float DepthBelowSurface) const
{
	// Reuse the same material assignment as InfinitePlane
	// (Grass -> Dirt -> Stone based on depth)
	// The biome system will override this if enabled

	if (DepthBelowSurface < 0.0f)
	{
		// Above surface - air, no material
		return 0;
	}
	else if (DepthBelowSurface < 100.0f) // ~1 voxel at VoxelSize=100
	{
		return EVoxelMaterial::Grass;
	}
	else if (DepthBelowSurface < 400.0f) // ~4 voxels
	{
		return EVoxelMaterial::Dirt;
	}
	else
	{
		return EVoxelMaterial::Stone;
	}
}

// ==================== Static Helpers ====================

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::CalculateDistanceFromCenter(
	float X, float Y,
	float CenterX, float CenterY)
{
	const float DX = X - CenterX;
	const float DY = Y - CenterY;
	return FMath::Sqrt(DX * DX + DY * DY);
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::CalculateNormalizedDistance(
	float X, float Y,
	const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams)
{
	const float DX = X - IslandParams.CenterX;
	const float DY = Y - IslandParams.CenterY;

	if (IslandParams.Shape == EIslandShape::Rectangle)
	{
		// For rectangle, use Chebyshev distance (max of normalized X and Y distances)
		// This creates a smooth rectangular falloff
		const float NormX = FMath::Abs(DX) / IslandParams.IslandRadius;
		const float NormY = FMath::Abs(DY) / IslandParams.SizeY;

		// Use the maximum of the two normalized distances
		// This gives us the "distance to the nearest edge" in normalized space
		return FMath::Max(NormX, NormY);
	}
	else
	{
		// For circular, use Euclidean distance normalized by radius
		return FMath::Sqrt(DX * DX + DY * DY) / IslandParams.IslandRadius;
	}
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::CalculateFalloffFactor(
	float Distance,
	float IslandRadius,
	float FalloffWidth,
	EIslandFalloffType FalloffType)
{
	// Inside the island radius - full terrain
	if (Distance <= IslandRadius)
	{
		return 1.0f;
	}

	// Beyond the falloff zone - no terrain
	if (Distance >= IslandRadius + FalloffWidth)
	{
		return 0.0f;
	}

	// In the falloff zone - calculate based on falloff type
	const float T = (Distance - IslandRadius) / FalloffWidth; // Normalized distance in falloff zone [0, 1]
	return ApplyFalloffCurve(T, FalloffType);
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::ApplyFalloffCurve(float T, EIslandFalloffType FalloffType)
{
	T = FMath::Clamp(T, 0.0f, 1.0f);
	const float InvT = 1.0f - T;

	switch (FalloffType)
	{
	case EIslandFalloffType::Linear:
		// Simple linear falloff
		return InvT;

	case EIslandFalloffType::Smooth:
		// Smooth hermite (smoothstep) falloff
		return InvT * InvT * (3.0f - 2.0f * InvT);

	case EIslandFalloffType::Squared:
		// Squared falloff (faster drop near edge)
		return InvT * InvT;

	case EIslandFalloffType::Exponential:
	{
		// e^(-3t), rescaled to run from 1 to exactly 0. Unscaled it ended at e^-3 (about 0.05), so the
		// terrain stopped 5% of its relief short of EdgeHeight and stepped down at the edge (KI4).
		const float End = FMath::Exp(-3.0f);
		return (FMath::Exp(-3.0f * T) - End) / (1.0f - End);
	}

	default:
		return InvT;
	}
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::CalculateFalloffFactorForPoint(
	float X, float Y,
	const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams)
{
	if (IslandParams.Shape == EIslandShape::Rectangle)
	{
		// For rectangle, calculate distance to edge in each axis separately
		const float DX = FMath::Abs(X - IslandParams.CenterX);
		const float DY = FMath::Abs(Y - IslandParams.CenterY);

		// Calculate how far into the falloff zone we are for each axis
		const float FalloffStartX = IslandParams.IslandRadius;
		const float FalloffStartY = IslandParams.SizeY;
		const float FalloffEndX = FalloffStartX + IslandParams.FalloffWidth;
		const float FalloffEndY = FalloffStartY + IslandParams.FalloffWidth;

		// Calculate T values for each axis (0 = at edge, 1 = at falloff end)
		float TX = 0.0f;
		if (DX > FalloffStartX)
		{
			TX = FMath::Clamp((DX - FalloffStartX) / IslandParams.FalloffWidth, 0.0f, 1.0f);
		}

		float TY = 0.0f;
		if (DY > FalloffStartY)
		{
			TY = FMath::Clamp((DY - FalloffStartY) / IslandParams.FalloffWidth, 0.0f, 1.0f);
		}

		// Use the maximum T value (the axis that's furthest into falloff determines the factor)
		const float T = FMath::Max(TX, TY);

		// If we're inside the rectangle (not in falloff), return 1
		if (T <= 0.0f)
		{
			return 1.0f;
		}

		// Apply the falloff curve
		return ApplyFalloffCurve(T, IslandParams.FalloffType);
	}
	else
	{
		// Circular: use standard distance-based calculation
		const float Distance = CalculateDistanceFromCenter(
			X, Y,
			IslandParams.CenterX, IslandParams.CenterY);

		return CalculateFalloffFactor(
			Distance,
			IslandParams.IslandRadius,
			IslandParams.FalloffWidth,
			IslandParams.FalloffType);
	}
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::ComposeTerrainHeight(
	float X, float Y,
	float BaseHeight,
	const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams)
{
	if (!IsWithinIslandBounds(X, Y, IslandParams))
	{
		return GetSeabedHeight(GetDistancePastEdge(X, Y, IslandParams), IslandParams);
	}
	return ApplyFalloffToHeight(BaseHeight, CalculateFalloffFactorForPoint(X, Y, IslandParams), IslandParams.EdgeHeight);
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::ApplyFalloffToHeight(
	float BaseHeight,
	float FalloffFactor,
	float EdgeHeight)
{
	// Lerp between base terrain height and edge height based on falloff
	return FMath::Lerp(EdgeHeight, BaseHeight, FalloffFactor);
}

bool FIslandBowlWorldMode::IsWithinIslandBounds(
	float X, float Y,
	const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams)
{
	const float DX = FMath::Abs(X - IslandParams.CenterX);
	const float DY = FMath::Abs(Y - IslandParams.CenterY);

	if (IslandParams.Shape == EIslandShape::Rectangle)
	{
		// Rectangle bounds check
		return DX <= IslandParams.GetTotalExtentX() &&
		       DY <= IslandParams.GetTotalExtentY();
	}
	else
	{
		// Circular bounds check
		const float Distance = FMath::Sqrt(DX * DX + DY * DY);
		return Distance <= IslandParams.GetTotalExtent();
	}
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::GetDistancePastEdge(
	float X, float Y,
	const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams)
{
	const float DX = FMath::Abs(X - IslandParams.CenterX);
	const float DY = FMath::Abs(Y - IslandParams.CenterY);
	if (IslandParams.Shape == EIslandShape::Rectangle)
	{
		// The rectangle's falloff takes the larger axis (CalculateFalloffFactorForPoint), so its seabed does too.
		return FMath::Max(DX - IslandParams.GetTotalExtentX(), DY - IslandParams.GetTotalExtentY());
	}
	return FMath::Sqrt(DX * DX + DY * DY) - IslandParams.GetTotalExtent();
}

float FIslandBowlWorldMode::GetSeabedHeight(
	float DistancePastEdge,
	const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams)
{
	const float Depth = FMath::Max(IslandParams.SeabedDepth, 0.0f);
	if (IslandParams.SeabedSlopeWidth <= 0.0f)
	{
		return IslandParams.EdgeHeight - Depth;
	}
	// Smoothstep: no kink where the seabed meets the falloff (which ends flat for Smooth), none where it levels out.
	const float T = FMath::Clamp(DistancePastEdge / IslandParams.SeabedSlopeWidth, 0.0f, 1.0f);
	return IslandParams.EdgeHeight - Depth * T * T * (3.0f - 2.0f * T);
}
```

// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#include "SphericalPlanetWorldMode.h"
#include "InfinitePlaneWorldMode.h"
#include "VoxelCPUNoiseGenerator.h"
#include "VoxelMaterialRegistry.h"
#include "VoxelGeneration.h"
#include "VoxelCubeSphere.h"
#include "VoxelTerrainConditioning.h"
#include "VoxelPlanetNoise.h"
#include "VoxelBiomeSnapshot.h"

#include <atomic>

FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::FSphericalPlanetWorldMode()
	: TerrainParams()
	, PlanetParams()
{
}

FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::FSphericalPlanetWorldMode(
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& InTerrainParams,
	const FSphericalPlanetParams& InPlanetParams)
	: TerrainParams(InTerrainParams)
	, PlanetParams(InPlanetParams)
{
}

// ==================== World Bounds and Local Frame ====================

bool FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::IsInsideWorld(double X, double Y) const
{
	const double DX = X - PlanetParams.PlanetCenter.X;
	const double DY = Y - PlanetParams.PlanetCenter.Y;
	const double Outer = PlanetParams.GetOuterRadius();
	return DX * DX + DY * DY <= Outer * Outer;
}

FVoxelWorldBounds FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetWorldBounds() const
{
	FVoxelWorldBounds Bounds;
	Bounds.Shape = EVoxelWorldBoundsShape::Shell;
	Bounds.Center = PlanetParams.PlanetCenter;
	Bounds.InnerRadius = PlanetParams.GetInnerRadius();
	Bounds.OuterRadius = PlanetParams.GetOuterRadius();
	Bounds.HalfExtent = FVector2D(Bounds.OuterRadius, Bounds.OuterRadius);
	Bounds.MinZ = static_cast<float>(PlanetParams.PlanetCenter.Z - PlanetParams.GetOuterRadius());
	Bounds.MaxZ = static_cast<float>(PlanetParams.PlanetCenter.Z + PlanetParams.GetOuterRadius());
	// The space above the terrain belongs to the world up to the orbit ceiling (spherical Phase 6, D18): flight and the
	// orbit camera live there, and KillZ goes below it.
	const double Ceiling = PlanetParams.OrbitCeiling > 0.0 ? PlanetParams.OrbitCeiling : 3.0 * PlanetParams.PlanetRadius;
	Bounds.OrbitRadius = FMath::Max(PlanetParams.PlanetRadius + Ceiling, PlanetParams.GetOuterRadius());
	return Bounds;
}

FVector FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetUpVector(const FVector& WorldPos) const
{
	return GetDirectionFromCenter(WorldPos, PlanetParams.PlanetCenter);
}

float FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetAltitude(const FVector& WorldPos) const
{
	// The subtraction in double; only the altitude (the relief's size) is narrowed (WM-BP4).
	return static_cast<float>(CalculateRadialDistance(WorldPos, PlanetParams.PlanetCenter) - PlanetParams.PlanetRadius);
}

FVoxelSurfaceCoord FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::WorldToSurface(const FVector& WorldPos) const
{
	// The cube faces and the tangent warp (FVoxelCubeSphere, WORLD_MODES_REVIEW_PLAN.md §15.1).
	return FVoxelCubeSphere::DirectionToSurface(GetDirectionFromCenter(WorldPos, PlanetParams.PlanetCenter));
}

FVector FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::SurfaceToWorld(const FVoxelSurfaceCoord& Coord, float Altitude) const
{
	return PlanetParams.PlanetCenter + FVoxelCubeSphere::SurfaceToDirection(Coord.Face, Coord.UV) * (PlanetParams.PlanetRadius + Altitude);
}

FVoxelTerrainSurfacePoint FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetSurfacePoint(const FVector& WorldPos, const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const
{
	// The surface point as centre + direction x (R + altitude), the sum in double (WM-BP4): a float R + altitude is 8 uu
	// coarse at R 1e8, which tilted the normal below by degrees.
	const FVector& Center = PlanetParams.PlanetCenter;
	const double Radius = PlanetParams.PlanetRadius;
	auto SurfaceAt = [&](const FVector& Direction)
	{
		return Center + Direction * (Radius + static_cast<double>(SampleRadialDisplacement(Direction, Radius, TerrainParams, NoiseParams, &BiomeSnapshot)));
	};

	const FVector Dir = GetDirectionFromCenter(WorldPos, Center);
	FVoxelTerrainSurfacePoint Point;
	Point.Position = SurfaceAt(Dir);

	// Central differences along two tangents, SurfaceNormalStep of arc either side on the datum sphere. (T1, T2, Dir) is
	// right-handed, so the cross product of the two differences points out of the terrain.
	const FVector T1 = FVector::CrossProduct(FMath::Abs(Dir.Z) < 0.9 ? FVector::UpVector : FVector::ForwardVector, Dir).GetSafeNormal();
	const FVector T2 = FVector::CrossProduct(Dir, T1);
	const double Angle = SurfaceNormalStep / FMath::Max(Radius, 1.0);
	const FVector D1 = SurfaceAt((Dir + T1 * Angle).GetSafeNormal()) - SurfaceAt((Dir - T1 * Angle).GetSafeNormal());
	const FVector D2 = SurfaceAt((Dir + T2 * Angle).GetSafeNormal()) - SurfaceAt((Dir - T2 * Angle).GetSafeNormal());
	Point.Normal = FVector::CrossProduct(D1, D2).GetSafeNormal();
	if (FVector::DotProduct(Point.Normal, Dir) < 0.0)
	{
		Point.Normal = -Point.Normal;
	}
	Point.Altitude = GetAltitude(Point.Position);
	return Point;
}

FVoxelTerrainSurfacePoint FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetConditionedSurfacePoint(const FVector& WorldPos, const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams,
	const TArray<FVoxelConditioningZone>& Zones) const
{
	if (Zones.Num() == 0)
	{
		return GetSurfacePoint(WorldPos, NoiseParams);
	}
	const FVector& Center = PlanetParams.PlanetCenter;
	const double Radius = PlanetParams.PlanetRadius;
	auto SurfaceAt = [&](const FVector& Direction)
	{
		return Center + Direction * (Radius + static_cast<double>(GetConditionedTerrainAltitude(Direction, NoiseParams, Zones)));
	};

	// GetSurfacePoint's construction over the conditioned surface.
	const FVector Dir = GetDirectionFromCenter(WorldPos, Center);
	FVoxelTerrainSurfacePoint Point;
	Point.Position = SurfaceAt(Dir);
	const FVector T1 = FVector::CrossProduct(FMath::Abs(Dir.Z) < 0.9 ? FVector::UpVector : FVector::ForwardVector, Dir).GetSafeNormal();
	const FVector T2 = FVector::CrossProduct(Dir, T1);
	const double Angle = SurfaceNormalStep / FMath::Max(Radius, 1.0);
	const FVector D1 = SurfaceAt((Dir + T1 * Angle).GetSafeNormal()) - SurfaceAt((Dir - T1 * Angle).GetSafeNormal());
	const FVector D2 = SurfaceAt((Dir + T2 * Angle).GetSafeNormal()) - SurfaceAt((Dir - T2 * Angle).GetSafeNormal());
	Point.Normal = FVector::CrossProduct(D1, D2).GetSafeNormal();
	if (FVector::DotProduct(Point.Normal, Dir) < 0.0)
	{
		Point.Normal = -Point.Normal;
	}
	Point.Altitude = GetAltitude(Point.Position);
	return Point;
}

float FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetConditionedTerrainAltitude(const FVector& Direction, const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams,
	const TArray<FVoxelConditioningZone>& Zones) const
{
	const float Natural = GetTerrainAltitude(Direction, NoiseParams);
	return Zones.Num() > 0 ? FVoxelTerrainConditioning::ApplyToAltitude(Direction, PlanetParams.PlanetRadius, Natural, Zones) : Natural;
}

float FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetDensityAt(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	int32 LODLevel,
	float NoiseValue) const
{
	// The terrain noise is the caller's; continentalness is not applied (SampleRadialDisplacement is the full surface).
	const double VoxelAltitude = CalculateRadialDistance(WorldPos, PlanetParams.PlanetCenter) - PlanetParams.PlanetRadius;
	return ShellSignedDistanceAtAltitude(VoxelAltitude, NoiseToRadialDisplacement(NoiseValue, TerrainParams), PlanetParams);
}

float FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightAt(
	float X,
	float Y,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const
{
	// Legacy heightmap query (spherical SP-A3, Phase 4): every planet consumer uses GetSurfacePoint. A stray caller gets
	// the world Z where the vertical line through (X, Y) meets the terrain on the upper hemisphere, not a radius.
	static std::atomic<bool> bWarned{false};
	if (!bWarned.exchange(true))
	{
		UE_LOG(LogVoxelGeneration, Warning, TEXT("FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightAt called on a planet: it returns the terrain's Z "
			"on the upper hemisphere above (X, Y). Use GetSurfacePoint / GetUpVector / GetAltitude (spherical SP-A3)."));
	}

	const FVector& Center = PlanetParams.PlanetCenter;
	const double DX = static_cast<double>(X) - Center.X;
	const double DY = static_cast<double>(Y) - Center.Y;
	const double Rho2 = DX * DX + DY * DY;
	const double Outer = PlanetParams.GetOuterRadius();
	if (Rho2 >= Outer * Outer)
	{
		return static_cast<float>(Center.Z); // the line passes outside the terrain shell
	}

	// Along the line z (height above the centre), f(z) = |P(z) - C| - TerrainRadius(direction of P(z)) is positive
	// above the terrain and negative below. March down from where the line enters the shell to the first point below the
	// terrain (the topmost crossing), then bisect.
	auto Above = [&](double Z) -> double
	{
		const FVector Direction = FVector(DX, DY, Z).GetSafeNormal();
		const double TerrainRadius = PlanetParams.PlanetRadius
			+ SampleRadialDisplacement(Direction.IsNearlyZero() ? FVector::UpVector : Direction, PlanetParams.PlanetRadius,
				TerrainParams, NoiseParams, &BiomeSnapshot);
		return FMath::Sqrt(Rho2 + Z * Z) - TerrainRadius;
	};
	constexpr double MarchStep = 200.0;
	double High = FMath::Sqrt(Outer * Outer - Rho2);
	double Low = High;
	bool bCrossed = false;
	while (Low > 0.0)
	{
		Low = FMath::Max(0.0, Low - MarchStep);
		if (Above(Low) <= 0.0)
		{
			bCrossed = true;
			break;
		}
		High = Low;
	}
	if (!bCrossed)
	{
		return static_cast<float>(Center.Z); // the line meets no terrain on the upper hemisphere
	}
	for (int32 Iteration = 0; Iteration < 40; ++Iteration)
	{
		const double Mid = 0.5 * (Low + High);
		(Above(Mid) <= 0.0 ? Low : High) = Mid;
	}
	return static_cast<float>(Center.Z + 0.5 * (Low + High));
}

void FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightBounds(float& OutMin, float& OutMax) const
{
	OutMin = static_cast<float>(PlanetParams.PlanetCenter.Z - PlanetParams.GetOuterRadius());
	OutMax = static_cast<float>(PlanetParams.PlanetCenter.Z + PlanetParams.GetOuterRadius());
}

void FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetAltitudeBounds(float& OutMin, float& OutMax) const
{
	OutMin = -PlanetParams.MaxTerrainDepth;
	OutMax = PlanetParams.MaxTerrainHeight;
}

FIntVector FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::WorldToChunkCoord(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	int32 ChunkSize,
	float VoxelSize) const
{
	// For spherical planets, we use standard Cartesian chunk coordinates
	// centered on the planet. The spherical nature is handled in density calculation.
	const FVector RelativePos = WorldPos - PlanetParams.PlanetCenter;
	const float ChunkWorldSize = ChunkSize * VoxelSize;

	return FIntVector(
		FMath::FloorToInt(RelativePos.X / ChunkWorldSize),
		FMath::FloorToInt(RelativePos.Y / ChunkWorldSize),
		FMath::FloorToInt(RelativePos.Z / ChunkWorldSize));
}

FVector FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::ChunkCoordToWorld(
	const FIntVector& ChunkCoord,
	int32 ChunkSize,
	float VoxelSize,
	int32 LODLevel) const
{
	const float ChunkWorldSize = ChunkSize * VoxelSize;
	return PlanetParams.PlanetCenter + FVector(ChunkCoord) * ChunkWorldSize;
}

int32 FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetMinZ() const
{
	// For spherical planets, Z range is symmetric and large
	// since we need chunks in all directions from center
	return -CHUNK_RANGE;
}

int32 FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetMaxZ() const
{
	return CHUNK_RANGE;
}

uint8 FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetMaterialAtDepth(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	float SurfaceHeight,
	float DepthBelowSurface) const
{
	// Material assignment based on depth below surface
	// Similar to other modes but using radial depth

	if (DepthBelowSurface < 0.0f)
	{
		// Above surface - air, no material
		return 0;
	}
	else if (DepthBelowSurface < 100.0f)
	{
		return EVoxelMaterial::Grass;
	}
	else if (DepthBelowSurface < 400.0f)
	{
		return EVoxelMaterial::Dirt;
	}
	else
	{
		return EVoxelMaterial::Stone;
	}
}

// ==================== Static Helpers ====================

double FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::CalculateRadialDistance(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	const FVector& PlanetCenter)
{
	return FVector::Dist(WorldPos, PlanetCenter);
}

FVector FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetDirectionFromCenter(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	const FVector& PlanetCenter)
{
	const FVector ToPoint = WorldPos - PlanetCenter;
	if (ToPoint.IsNearlyZero())
	{
		return FVector::UpVector;
	}
	return ToPoint.GetSafeNormal();
}

float FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::SampleSphericalNoise(
	const FVector& Direction,
	double PlanetRadius,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams)
{
	// The full 3D point on the datum sphere: no hemisphere mirror, no seam, feature size in world units (SP-B1). Planet
	// noise (WM-BP5, D22): the point split in double per octave, a hashed lattice with no period.
	return FVoxelPlanetNoise::FBM3D(GetNoiseSamplePoint(Direction, PlanetRadius), NoiseParams);
}

FWorldModeTerrainParams FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::ComputeEffectiveTerrainParams(
	const FVector& Direction,
	double PlanetRadius,
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& BaseParams,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams,
	const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
	float& OutContinentalness)
{
	// FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::ComputeEffectiveTerrainParamsAt's curves, with the continentalness field sampled by the
	// planet noise at the direction's point on the datum sphere (WM-BP5).
	OutContinentalness = 0.0f;
	FWorldModeTerrainParams Effective = BaseParams;
	if (BiomeSnapshot && BiomeSnapshot->bEnableContinentalness)
	{
		OutContinentalness = FVoxelPlanetNoise::FBM3D(GetNoiseSamplePoint(Direction, PlanetRadius),
			GetContinentalnessNoiseParams(NoiseParams.Seed, *BiomeSnapshot));
		float HeightOffset = 0.0f;
		float HeightScaleMult = 1.0f;
		BiomeSnapshot->GetContinentalnessTerrainParams(OutContinentalness, HeightOffset, HeightScaleMult);
		Effective.BaseHeight += HeightOffset;
		Effective.HeightScale *= HeightScaleMult;
	}
	return Effective;
}

FVoxelNoiseParams FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetContinentalnessNoiseParams(int32 WorldSeed, const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot& BiomeSnapshot)
{
	return FVoxelPlanetNoise::MakeFieldParams(WorldSeed + BiomeSnapshot.ContinentalnessSeedOffset, BiomeSnapshot.ContinentalnessNoiseFrequency);
}

void FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::SampleClimate(const FVector& Direction, double PlanetRadius, const FVoxelNoiseParams& TemperatureParams,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& MoistureParams, float& OutTemperature, float& OutMoisture)
{
	const FVector SamplePoint = GetNoiseSamplePoint(Direction, PlanetRadius);
	OutTemperature = FVoxelPlanetNoise::FBM3D(SamplePoint, TemperatureParams);
	OutMoisture = FVoxelPlanetNoise::FBM3D(SamplePoint, MoistureParams);
}

FVector FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::ScaleAltitudeRelative(const FVector& PlanetRelativePos, double PlanetRadius, float VerticalScale)
{
	const double Dist = PlanetRelativePos.Size();
	if (Dist < UE_KINDA_SMALL_NUMBER)
	{
		return PlanetRelativePos;
	}
	const double Altitude = Dist - PlanetRadius;
	return PlanetRelativePos * ((PlanetRadius + Altitude * VerticalScale) / Dist);
}

float FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::SampleRadialDisplacement(
	const FVector& Direction,
	double PlanetRadius,
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& TerrainParams,
	const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams,
	const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
	float* OutContinentalness)
{
	float Continentalness = 0.0f;
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams Effective = ComputeEffectiveTerrainParams(
		Direction, PlanetRadius, TerrainParams, NoiseParams, BiomeSnapshot, Continentalness);
	if (OutContinentalness)
	{
		*OutContinentalness = Continentalness;
	}
	return NoiseToRadialDisplacement(SampleSphericalNoise(Direction, PlanetRadius, NoiseParams), Effective);
}

void FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::GetDisplacementBounds(
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& TerrainParams,
	const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
	float& OutMin,
	float& OutMax)
{
	// Displacement = (BaseHeight + Offset(c)) + Noise * HeightScale * Mult(c) / 2, Noise in [-1, 1]. Decoupled extremes,
	// as FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightBounds: a superset of what generation can produce.
	float MinOffset = 0.0f, MaxOffset = 0.0f, MaxScaleMult = 1.0f;
	if (BiomeSnapshot)
	{
		BiomeSnapshot->GetContinentalnessExtremes(MinOffset, MaxOffset, MaxScaleMult);
	}
	const float Amplitude = 0.5f * TerrainParams.HeightScale * MaxScaleMult;
	OutMin = TerrainParams.BaseHeight + MinOffset - Amplitude;
	OutMax = TerrainParams.BaseHeight + MaxOffset + Amplitude;
}

float FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::ShellSignedDistance(
	double DistFromCenter,
	double TerrainRadius,
	const FSphericalPlanetParams& PlanetParams)
{
	return ShellSignedDistanceAtAltitude(DistFromCenter - PlanetParams.PlanetRadius, TerrainRadius - PlanetParams.PlanetRadius, PlanetParams);
}

float FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::ShellSignedDistanceAtAltitude(
	double VoxelAltitude,
	double TerrainAltitude,
	const FSphericalPlanetParams& PlanetParams)
{
	// Quick reject well outside the terrain shell: definitely air above it, definitely core below it.
	if (VoxelAltitude > static_cast<double>(PlanetParams.MaxTerrainHeight) + 1000.0)
	{
		return -1000.0f;
	}
	if (VoxelAltitude < -static_cast<double>(PlanetParams.MaxTerrainDepth) - 1000.0)
	{
		return 1000.0f;
	}
	return static_cast<float>(TerrainAltitude - VoxelAltitude);
}

FVector FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::ScaleAltitude(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	const FSphericalPlanetParams& PlanetParams,
	float VerticalScale)
{
	const FVector ToPoint = WorldPos - PlanetParams.PlanetCenter;
	const double Dist = ToPoint.Size();
	if (Dist < UE_KINDA_SMALL_NUMBER)
	{
		return WorldPos;
	}
	const double Altitude = Dist - PlanetParams.PlanetRadius;
	return PlanetParams.PlanetCenter + ToPoint * ((PlanetParams.PlanetRadius + Altitude * VerticalScale) / Dist);
}

float FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::NoiseToRadialDisplacement(
	float NoiseValue,
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& TerrainParams)
{
	// Convert noise [-1, 1] to radial displacement
	// HeightScale controls the magnitude of terrain features
	// BaseHeight shifts the overall terrain level
	return TerrainParams.BaseHeight + (NoiseValue * TerrainParams.HeightScale * 0.5f);
}

float FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::CalculateSignedDistance(
	double DistFromCenter,
	double TerrainRadius)
{
	// Signed distance: positive when inside solid (below terrain), negative when in air. Formed in double: both radii are
	// of size R.
	return static_cast<float>(TerrainRadius - DistFromCenter);
}

bool FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::IsWithinPlanetBounds(
	const FVector& WorldPos,
	const FSphericalPlanetParams& PlanetParams)
{
	const double Distance = CalculateRadialDistance(WorldPos, PlanetParams.PlanetCenter);
	return Distance >= PlanetParams.GetInnerRadius() && Distance <= PlanetParams.GetOuterRadius();
}
```

### Source/VoxelGeneration/Private/VoxelBlockSurface.cpp
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#include "VoxelBlockSurface.h"
#include "InfinitePlaneWorldMode.h"
#include "VoxelCoreTypes.h"
#include "VoxelWorldConfiguration.h"
#include "HAL/IConsoleManager.h"

static TAutoConsoleVariable<int32> CVarCubicBlockSurface(
	TEXT("voxel.Cubic.BlockSurface"),
	1,
	TEXT("Cubic heightmap worlds: surface queries, POI pads and campsites use the block tops the world draws (1), or the density ")
	TEXT("isosurface up to a block below them (0, as before world modes review WM-C5)."),
	ECVF_Default);

bool FVoxelBlockSurface::UsesBlockSurface(const UVoxelWorldConfiguration& Config)
{
	return Config.MeshingMode == EMeshingMode::Cubic
		&& Config.WorldMode != EWorldMode::SphericalPlanet
		&& Config.VoxelSize > 0.0f
		&& CVarCubicBlockSurface.GetValueOnAnyThread() != 0;
}

double FVoxelBlockSurface::ColumnCorner(double Coord, double Origin, float VoxelSize)
{
	return Origin + FMath::FloorToDouble((Coord - Origin) / VoxelSize) * VoxelSize;
}

bool FVoxelBlockSurface::IsGeneratedSolid(float Height, double VoxelZ, float VoxelSize)
{
	// The generators' own arithmetic: a float signed distance from the column height to the voxel's position, mapped to
	// a density and compared with the surface threshold (IsSolid).
	const float SignedDistance = FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::CalculateSignedDistance(static_cast<float>(VoxelZ), Height);
	return FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::SignedDistanceToDensity(SignedDistance, VoxelSize) >= VOXEL_SURFACE_THRESHOLD;
}

int64 FVoxelBlockSurface::TopSolidLayerForHeight(float Height, double OriginZ, float VoxelSize)
{
	// The layer whose cell holds the height is solid (its signed distance is at least 0); the one above can still be,
	// when the height lies within the density's rounding (0.004 voxel) under its bottom face.
	if (!FMath::IsFinite(Height) || VoxelSize <= 0.0f)
	{
		return 0;
	}
	int64 Layer = static_cast<int64>(FMath::FloorToDouble((static_cast<double>(Height) - OriginZ) / VoxelSize));
	// Each loop moves at most a step or two: the density saturates a voxel either side of the height.
	for (int32 Step = 0; Step < 4 && IsGeneratedSolid(Height, OriginZ + static_cast<double>(Layer + 1) * VoxelSize, VoxelSize); ++Step)
	{
		++Layer;
	}
	for (int32 Step = 0; Step < 4 && !IsGeneratedSolid(Height, OriginZ + static_cast<double>(Layer) * VoxelSize, VoxelSize); ++Step)
	{
		--Layer;
	}
	return Layer;
}

double FVoxelBlockSurface::BlockTopForHeight(float Height, double OriginZ, float VoxelSize)
{
	return LayerTop(TopSolidLayerForHeight(Height, OriginZ, VoxelSize), OriginZ, VoxelSize);
}
```
