### Source/VoxelGeneration/Public/IVoxelNoiseGenerator.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "VoxelNoiseTypes.h"
#include "VoxelData.h"

class FRHICommandListImmediate;
class FRHIBuffer;

/**
 * Abstract interface for voxel noise generation.
 *
 * Provides both GPU (async) and CPU (blocking) generation paths.
 * GPU generation uses compute shaders for maximum performance,
 * while CPU fallback is available for testing and editor scenarios.
 *
 * Usage:
 * 1. Call Initialize() once at startup
 * 2. Use GenerateChunkAsync() for runtime GPU generation
 * 3. Use GenerateChunkCPU() for testing or editor use
 * 4. Call Shutdown() before destruction
 *
 * @see FVoxelGPUNoiseGenerator
 * @see FVoxelCPUNoiseGenerator
 */
class VOXELGENERATION_API IVoxelNoiseGenerator
{
public:
	virtual ~IVoxelNoiseGenerator() = default;

	// ==================== Lifecycle ====================

	/**
	 * Initialize the generator.
	 * Must be called before any generation operations.
	 */
	virtual void Initialize() = 0;

	/**
	 * Shutdown the generator and release resources.
	 * Must be called before destruction.
	 */
	virtual void Shutdown() = 0;

	/**
	 * Check if the generator is initialized and ready for use.
	 */
	virtual bool IsInitialized() const = 0;

	// ==================== Generation ====================

	/**
	 * Generate voxel data for a chunk asynchronously on the GPU.
	 *
	 * @param Request Generation request parameters
	 * @param OnComplete Callback when generation finishes
	 * @return Handle for tracking the async operation
	 */
	virtual FVoxelGenerationHandle GenerateChunkAsync(
		const FVoxelNoiseGenerationRequest& Request,
		FOnVoxelGenerationComplete OnComplete) = 0;

	/**
	 * Generate voxel data for a chunk synchronously on the CPU.
	 * This is a blocking operation suitable for testing and editor use.
	 *
	 * @param Request Generation request parameters
	 * @param OutVoxelData Output array to fill with voxel data
	 * @return True if generation succeeded
	 */
	virtual bool GenerateChunkCPU(
		const FVoxelNoiseGenerationRequest& Request,
		TArray<FVoxelData>& OutVoxelData) = 0;

	/**
	 * Sample noise at a single world position.
	 * Useful for debugging and point queries.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPosition Position in world space
	 * @param Params Noise parameters
	 * @return Noise value in range [-1, 1]
	 */
	virtual float SampleNoiseAt(
		const FVector& WorldPosition,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& Params) = 0;

	// ==================== Buffer Access ====================

	/**
	 * Get the GPU buffer for a completed generation request.
	 * Only valid after GenerateChunkAsync completes.
	 *
	 * @param Handle Handle from GenerateChunkAsync
	 * @return Pointer to the GPU buffer, or nullptr if not available
	 */
	virtual FRHIBuffer* GetGeneratedBuffer(const FVoxelGenerationHandle& Handle) = 0;

	/**
	 * Read back generated voxel data from GPU to CPU.
	 * This is a blocking operation that stalls the GPU.
	 *
	 * @param Handle Handle from GenerateChunkAsync
	 * @param OutVoxelData Output array to fill with voxel data
	 * @return True if readback succeeded
	 */
	virtual bool ReadbackToCPU(
		const FVoxelGenerationHandle& Handle,
		TArray<FVoxelData>& OutVoxelData) = 0;

	/**
	 * Release resources associated with a generation handle.
	 * Call this when you're done with the generated data.
	 *
	 * @param Handle Handle to release
	 */
	virtual void ReleaseHandle(const FVoxelGenerationHandle& Handle) = 0;

	// ==================== Utilities ====================

	/**
	 * Convert noise value [-1, 1] to voxel density [0, 255].
	 * Surface threshold (127) corresponds to noise value of 0.
	 */
	static uint8 NoiseToDensity(float NoiseValue)
	{
		// Clamp to [-1, 1], then map to [0, 255]
		float Clamped = FMath::Clamp(NoiseValue, -1.0f, 1.0f);
		return static_cast<uint8>(FMath::Clamp((Clamped + 1.0f) * 127.5f, 0.0f, 255.0f));
	}

	/**
	 * Convert voxel density [0, 255] to noise value [-1, 1].
	 */
	static float DensityToNoise(uint8 Density)
	{
		return (static_cast<float>(Density) / 127.5f) - 1.0f;
	}
};
```

### Source/VoxelGeneration/Public/IVoxelWorldMode.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "VoxelCoreTypes.h"
#include "VoxelWorldModeTypes.h"

class UVoxelBiomeConfiguration;

/**
 * Abstract interface for world generation modes.
 *
 * World modes define how terrain is generated based on the world type:
 * - InfinitePlane: 2D heightmap-style terrain extending infinitely in X/Y
 * - SphericalPlanet: Radial terrain around a center point
 * - IslandBowl: Bounded terrain with edge falloff
 *
 * Each mode provides:
 * - Density calculation (SDF) for terrain generation
 * - Terrain height sampling for heightmap-based modes
 * - Coordinate transformations
 * - Vertical bounds for chunk streaming
 * - Where the world ends (IsInsideWorld, GetWorldBounds), a local frame (GetUpVector, GetAltitude,
 *   WorldToSurface, SurfaceToWorld) and the surface along local up (GetSurfacePoint), so consumers work in any mode
 *   without assuming +Z is up or that the world has no edge (world modes review WM-A2; spherical requirements SP-A1,
 *   SP-A2)
 *
 * Build a mode from a world configuration with FVoxelWorldModeFactory::Create. Game code reaches the configured
 * mode's bounds and frame through UVoxelChunkManager (a component of the world actor), which exposes them to
 * Blueprint.
 *
 * @see FInfinitePlaneWorldMode
 */
class VOXELGENERATION_API IVoxelWorldMode
{
public:
	virtual ~IVoxelWorldMode() = default;

	// ==================== Core SDF Functions ====================

	/**
	 * Get the density value at a world position.
	 *
	 * Uses signed distance field (SDF) where:
	 * - Positive = below surface (solid)
	 * - Zero = at surface
	 * - Negative = above surface (air)
	 *
	 * The returned value is the raw SDF distance, which should be
	 * converted to voxel density [0-255] by the generator.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos Position in world space
	 * @param LODLevel Current LOD level (for detail reduction)
	 * @param NoiseValue Pre-sampled noise value at this position
	 * @return Signed distance to surface (positive = inside/solid)
	 */
	virtual float GetDensityAt(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		int32 LODLevel,
		float NoiseValue) const = 0;

	/**
	 * Get terrain height at an X,Y position.
	 *
	 * For heightmap-based modes (InfinitePlane), this samples 2D noise
	 * and returns the terrain surface Z coordinate. A planet has no height per (X, Y): it returns the Z where the vertical
	 * line meets the terrain on the upper hemisphere and logs once (spherical SP-A3); code that must work on a planet uses
	 * GetSurfacePoint, GetUpVector and GetAltitude instead.
	 *
	 * @param X World X coordinate
	 * @param Y World Y coordinate
	 * @param NoiseParams Noise parameters for terrain generation
	 * @return Z coordinate of terrain surface at this X,Y
	 */
	virtual float GetTerrainHeightAt(
		float X,
		float Y,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const = 0;

	// ==================== Coordinate Transforms ====================

	/**
	 * Convert a world position to chunk coordinates.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos Position in world space
	 * @param ChunkSize Number of voxels per chunk edge
	 * @param VoxelSize Size of each voxel in world units
	 * @return Chunk coordinate containing this world position
	 */
	virtual FIntVector WorldToChunkCoord(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		int32 ChunkSize,
		float VoxelSize) const = 0;

	/**
	 * Convert chunk coordinates to world position (chunk origin).
	 *
	 * @param ChunkCoord Chunk coordinate
	 * @param ChunkSize Number of voxels per chunk edge
	 * @param VoxelSize Size of each voxel in world units
	 * @param LODLevel LOD level (affects effective chunk size)
	 * @return World position of chunk origin
	 */
	virtual FVector ChunkCoordToWorld(
		const FIntVector& ChunkCoord,
		int32 ChunkSize,
		float VoxelSize,
		int32 LODLevel) const = 0;

	// ==================== Vertical Bounds ====================

	/**
	 * Get the minimum Z level for chunk generation.
	 *
	 * For bounded modes, this limits how deep chunks are generated.
	 * For infinite modes, returns a practical limit.
	 *
	 * @return Minimum chunk Z coordinate
	 */
	virtual int32 GetMinZ() const = 0;

	/**
	 * Get the maximum Z level for chunk generation.
	 *
	 * For bounded modes, this limits chunk generation height.
	 * For infinite modes, returns a practical limit.
	 *
	 * @return Maximum chunk Z coordinate
	 */
	virtual int32 GetMaxZ() const = 0;

	// ==================== Configuration ====================

	/**
	 * Get the world mode type.
	 *
	 * @return The EWorldMode enum value for this mode
	 */
	virtual EWorldMode GetWorldModeType() const = 0;

	/**
	 * Check if this mode uses heightmap-based (2D) generation.
	 *
	 * Heightmap modes sample noise in 2D and use Z as height,
	 * while volumetric modes sample full 3D noise.
	 *
	 * @return True if this is a heightmap-based mode
	 */
	virtual bool IsHeightmapBased() const = 0;

	// ==================== Material Assignment ====================

	/**
	 * Get the material ID based on position and depth below surface.
	 *
	 * Used to assign materials like stone (deep), dirt (middle), grass (surface).
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos Position in world space
	 * @param SurfaceHeight Height of terrain surface at this X,Y
	 * @param DepthBelowSurface Distance below the terrain surface (positive = below)
	 * @return Material ID to assign to this voxel
	 */
	virtual uint8 GetMaterialAtDepth(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		float SurfaceHeight,
		float DepthBelowSurface) const = 0;

	// ==================== Analytic Height Context (optional) ====================

	/**
	 * Provide the biome configuration used for continentalness height modulation in the analytic height
	 * query (GetTerrainHeightAt). Heightmap modes that apply continentalness (InfinitePlane, IslandBowl)
	 * use it so the analytic surface matches generation; other modes ignore it. Non-owning — the caller
	 * keeps the configuration alive. Default: no-op.
	 */
	virtual void SetBiomeContext(const UVoxelBiomeConfiguration* /*InBiomeConfig*/) {}

	/**
	 * Worst-case terrain-height bounds [OutMin, OutMax] over all (X,Y) for this mode — the authority for
	 * vertical chunk-culling (VoxelLOD). A conservative superset that CONTAINS every value the generator can
	 * produce, so culling to it never removes a chunk holding real terrain. Default: a very wide range (no
	 * vertical culling). Heightmap modes override with tight bounds.
	 */
	virtual void GetTerrainHeightBounds(float& OutMin, float& OutMax) const
	{
		OutMin = -1.0e9f;
		OutMax = 1.0e9f;
	}

	/**
	 * Worst-case terrain bounds as altitudes above the datum (GetAltitude), over the whole world (spherical SP-A4): the
	 * form of GetTerrainHeightBounds that works in every mode. Heightmap modes: the height bounds through GetAltitude
	 * (Z - SeaLevel); a planet: its terrain shell, -MaxTerrainDepth to +MaxTerrainHeight. A conservative superset of
	 * every surface altitude generation can produce, like GetTerrainHeightBounds. Consumers that shade or bound by height
	 * (the map) use it so they need no planet special case.
	 *
	 * @param OutMin Lowest altitude
	 * @param OutMax Highest altitude
	 */
	virtual void GetAltitudeBounds(float& OutMin, float& OutMax) const
	{
		float MinZ = 0.0f, MaxZ = 0.0f;
		GetTerrainHeightBounds(MinZ, MaxZ);
		OutMin = GetAltitude(FVector(0.0, 0.0, MinZ));
		OutMax = GetAltitude(FVector(0.0, 0.0, MaxZ));
	}

	/**
	 * The terrain surface's vertical extent over one patch of the world (a chunk column's footprint): the lowest and
	 * highest surface height there, in world Z. The streaming window (VoxelLOD) keeps every column's chunks around this
	 * range at every distance, so a column streams its own ground whatever the viewer's altitude (world modes review
	 * D8, WM-S1). A planet's window is the column's crossing of the terrain shell instead (spherical SP-C1; a band
	 * around the surface is SP-C5), so planets keep the default.
	 *
	 * Default: heightmap modes sample GetTerrainHeightAt at the footprint's four corners and its centre (variation
	 * between the samples is the caller's slack); other modes return GetTerrainHeightBounds, the whole range. Cost: five
	 * height samples, so callers memoize per column.
	 *
	 * @param MinXY Footprint minimum corner (world X, Y)
	 * @param MaxXY Footprint maximum corner (world X, Y)
	 * @param NoiseParams Terrain noise parameters, as for GetTerrainHeightAt
	 * @return [lowest, highest] surface height over the footprint, world Z
	 */
	virtual FFloatInterval GetSurfaceRange(const FVector2D& MinXY, const FVector2D& MaxXY, const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const
	{
		if (!IsHeightmapBased())
		{
			float Min = 0.0f, Max = 0.0f;
			GetTerrainHeightBounds(Min, Max);
			return FFloatInterval(Min, Max);
		}
		const FVector2D Samples[5] = {
			MinXY, FVector2D(MaxXY.X, MinXY.Y), FVector2D(MinXY.X, MaxXY.Y), MaxXY, (MinXY + MaxXY) * 0.5 };
		FFloatInterval Range(TNumericLimits<float>::Max(), TNumericLimits<float>::Lowest());
		for (const FVector2D& Sample : Samples)
		{
			const float Height = GetTerrainHeightAt(static_cast<float>(Sample.X), static_cast<float>(Sample.Y), NoiseParams);
			Range.Min = FMath::Min(Range.Min, Height);
			Range.Max = FMath::Max(Range.Max, Height);
		}
		return Range;
	}

	/** Step (uu) GetSurfacePoint takes either side of a point for the surface normal's finite differences. */
	static constexpr float SurfaceNormalStep = 50.0f;

	/**
	 * The terrain surface on the local up-line through a position, with its outward normal (spherical SP-A1): in
	 * heightmap modes the point at (X, Y, GetTerrainHeightAt(X, Y)); on a planet the point along the direction from the
	 * centre, so a direction D maps to GetSurfacePoint(Centre + D). The analytic surface generation produces, without
	 * caves, conditioning zones or edits. The normal comes from central differences SurfaceNormalStep either side.
	 *
	 * Cost: five surface samples. Thread-safe like GetTerrainHeightAt.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos Any position on the up-line (only X, Y in heightmap modes; only the direction on a planet)
	 * @param NoiseParams Terrain noise parameters, as for GetTerrainHeightAt
	 * @return The surface point, its normal and its altitude
	 */
	virtual FVoxelTerrainSurfacePoint GetSurfacePoint(const FVector& WorldPos, const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const
	{
		const float X = static_cast<float>(WorldPos.X);
		const float Y = static_cast<float>(WorldPos.Y);
		const float DX = GetTerrainHeightAt(X + SurfaceNormalStep, Y, NoiseParams) - GetTerrainHeightAt(X - SurfaceNormalStep, Y, NoiseParams);
		const float DY = GetTerrainHeightAt(X, Y + SurfaceNormalStep, NoiseParams) - GetTerrainHeightAt(X, Y - SurfaceNormalStep, NoiseParams);
		FVoxelTerrainSurfacePoint Point;
		Point.Position = FVector(WorldPos.X, WorldPos.Y, GetTerrainHeightAt(X, Y, NoiseParams));
		Point.Normal = FVector(-DX, -DY, 2.0f * SurfaceNormalStep).GetSafeNormal();
		Point.Altitude = GetAltitude(Point.Position);
		return Point;
	}

	// ==================== World Bounds (WM-A2) ====================
	// The defaults describe an unbounded heightmap world with its datum at Z 0, so a mode that does not override them
	// (a game plugin's own mode, a test mock) keeps working. The built-in modes override them.

	/**
	 * Whether the vertical line at (X, Y) passes through the world: the test for consumers that place, explore,
	 * spawn or navigate. An island's footprint is R + falloff (beyond it generation writes only a flat floor); a plane
	 * has no edge. On a planet it says whether the line meets the terrain shell; 2D consumers on a planet key on
	 * WorldToSurface instead. Cheap: safe to call per sample.
	 *
	 * @param X World X
	 * @param Y World Y
	 * @return True when (X, Y) is inside the world's footprint
	 */
	virtual bool IsInsideWorld(double /*X*/, double /*Y*/) const { return true; }

	/**
	 * Where the world ends: unbounded for a plane, the R + falloff footprint for an island, the terrain shell for a
	 * planet. IsInsideWorld agrees with FVoxelWorldBounds::ContainsXY.
	 *
	 * @return The world's bounds, with the terrain's vertical extent
	 */
	virtual FVoxelWorldBounds GetWorldBounds() const
	{
		FVoxelWorldBounds Bounds;
		GetTerrainHeightBounds(Bounds.MinZ, Bounds.MaxZ);
		return Bounds;
	}

	// ==================== Local Frame (SP-A1, SP-A2) ====================

	/**
	 * Local up at a world position: +Z in heightmap modes, the radial direction on a planet.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos World position
	 * @return Unit up vector
	 */
	virtual FVector GetUpVector(const FVector& /*WorldPos*/) const { return FVector::UpVector; }

	/**
	 * Signed height above the datum, the surface the terrain's noise displaces from: SeaLevel in heightmap modes (so
	 * Z - SeaLevel), the planet radius on a planet. The water plane (WaterLevel / WaterRadius) is separate.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos World position
	 * @return Height above the datum along GetUpVector (negative below it)
	 */
	virtual float GetAltitude(const FVector& WorldPos) const { return static_cast<float>(WorldPos.Z); }

	/**
	 * A world position's coordinate on the surface parameterisation, the key 2D consumers use: (0, X, Y) in heightmap
	 * modes, a cube face and (U, V) in [-1, 1] on a planet. Ignores altitude: every point on one up-line maps to the
	 * same coordinate.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos World position
	 * @return Surface coordinate
	 */
	virtual FVoxelSurfaceCoord WorldToSurface(const FVector& WorldPos) const
	{
		return FVoxelSurfaceCoord(0, FVector2D(WorldPos.X, WorldPos.Y));
	}

	/**
	 * Inverse of WorldToSurface: the world position at a surface coordinate and an altitude above the datum.
	 *
	 * @param Coord Surface coordinate
	 * @param Altitude Height above the datum (see GetAltitude)
	 * @return World position
	 */
	virtual FVector SurfaceToWorld(const FVoxelSurfaceCoord& Coord, float Altitude) const
	{
		return FVector(Coord.UV.X, Coord.UV.Y, Altitude);
	}
};

/**
 * Terrain generation parameters for world modes.
 *
 * These settings control how noise is converted to terrain height
 * and how the SDF is calculated.
 */
struct VOXELGENERATION_API FWorldModeTerrainParams
{
	/** Base height of terrain (sea level) */
	float SeaLevel = 0.0f;

	/** Scale factor for noise-to-height conversion */
	float HeightScale = 5000.0f;

	/** Minimum terrain height offset from sea level */
	float BaseHeight = 0.0f;

	// NOTE: no Min/MaxHeight clamp here — terrain height is intentionally unclamped so the CPU stays
	// bit-identical to the GPU generator (which never clamped). A height cap would have to be applied
	// identically on BOTH the CPU and the GPU shader; see FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::NoiseToTerrainHeight.

	FWorldModeTerrainParams() = default;

	FWorldModeTerrainParams(float InSeaLevel, float InHeightScale, float InBaseHeight)
		: SeaLevel(InSeaLevel)
		, HeightScale(InHeightScale)
		, BaseHeight(InBaseHeight)
	{
	}
};
```

### Source/VoxelGeneration/Public/InfinitePlaneWorldMode.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "IVoxelWorldMode.h"
#include "VoxelBiomeSnapshot.h"

class UVoxelBiomeConfiguration;

/**
 * Infinite Plane World Mode implementation.
 *
 * Generates heightmap-style terrain extending infinitely in X/Y with Z as height.
 * Terrain surface is determined by 2D noise (sampling only X,Y coordinates),
 * creating natural hills and valleys.
 *
 * Density Calculation (SDF):
 * - TerrainHeight = BaseHeight + SeaLevel + (NoiseValue * HeightScale)
 * - Density = TerrainHeight - WorldPos.Z
 * - Positive = solid (below surface), Negative = air (above surface)
 *
 * Material Assignment:
 * - Stone: depth > 4 voxels below surface
 * - Dirt: 1-4 voxels below surface
 * - Grass: at or near surface
 *
 * Configuration:
 * - SeaLevel: Base terrain elevation (world units)
 * - HeightScale: Noise amplitude multiplier for terrain height variation
 * - BaseHeight: Additional height offset
 *
 * @see IVoxelWorldMode
 */
class VOXELGENERATION_API FInfinitePlaneWorldMode : public IVoxelWorldMode
{
public:
	/**
	 * Construct with default terrain parameters.
	 */
	FInfinitePlaneWorldMode();

	/**
	 * Construct with specified terrain parameters.
	 *
	 * @param InTerrainParams Terrain generation parameters
	 */
	explicit FInfinitePlaneWorldMode(const FWorldModeTerrainParams& InTerrainParams);

	virtual ~FInfinitePlaneWorldMode() = default;

	// ==================== IVoxelWorldMode Interface ====================

	virtual float GetDensityAt(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		int32 LODLevel,
		float NoiseValue) const override;

	virtual float GetTerrainHeightAt(
		float X,
		float Y,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const override;

	virtual FIntVector WorldToChunkCoord(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		int32 ChunkSize,
		float VoxelSize) const override;

	virtual FVector ChunkCoordToWorld(
		const FIntVector& ChunkCoord,
		int32 ChunkSize,
		float VoxelSize,
		int32 LODLevel) const override;

	virtual int32 GetMinZ() const override;
	virtual int32 GetMaxZ() const override;

	virtual EWorldMode GetWorldModeType() const override { return EWorldMode::InfinitePlane; }
	virtual bool IsHeightmapBased() const override { return true; }

	virtual uint8 GetMaterialAtDepth(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		float SurfaceHeight,
		float DepthBelowSurface) const override;

	// ==================== Terrain Configuration ====================

	/**
	 * Get the terrain parameters.
	 */
	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& GetTerrainParams() const { return TerrainParams; }

	/**
	 * Set the terrain parameters.
	 */
	void SetTerrainParams(const FWorldModeTerrainParams& InParams) { TerrainParams = InParams; }

	/**
	 * Provide the biome configuration used for continentalness height modulation.
	 *
	 * When set (and continentalness is enabled on the config), GetTerrainHeightAt applies the SAME
	 * height modulation (BaseHeight offset + HeightScale multiplier) that generation applies, so the
	 * analytic height used for spawn / nav / POI placement matches the real generated surface.
	 *
	 * The config is snapshotted BY VALUE at this call (game thread) — the mode holds no UObject
	 * reference afterwards, so the instance is safe to share into background tasks that may outlive
	 * the world (e.g. VoxelMap tile generation). Config changes after this call are not picked up
	 * (configs are static after world init).
	 *
	 * @param InBiomeConfig Biome configuration, or null to use raw (un-modulated) base terrain height.
	 */
	virtual void SetBiomeContext(const UVoxelBiomeConfiguration* InBiomeConfig) override
	{
		BiomeSnapshot = FVoxelBiomeSnapshot::FromConfig(InBiomeConfig);
	}

	/** Per-mode vertical-cull bounds (IVoxelWorldMode): wraps the static using this mode's params + biome snapshot. */
	virtual void GetTerrainHeightBounds(float& OutMin, float& OutMax) const override
	{
		FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightBounds(TerrainParams, &BiomeSnapshot, OutMin, OutMax);
	}

	// ==================== World Bounds and Local Frame (IVoxelWorldMode, WM-A2) ====================
	// A plane has no edge (IsInsideWorld keeps the default: always inside), up is +Z and the surface coordinate is
	// (0, X, Y) (the defaults); the datum is SeaLevel.

	/** Unbounded, with the terrain's height bounds and the centre at (0, 0, SeaLevel). */
	virtual FVoxelWorldBounds GetWorldBounds() const override;

	/** Z above SeaLevel. */
	virtual float GetAltitude(const FVector& WorldPos) const override;

	/** (U, V, SeaLevel + Altitude). */
	virtual FVector SurfaceToWorld(const FVoxelSurfaceCoord& Coord, float Altitude) const override;

	/**
	 * Get sea level height.
	 */
	float GetSeaLevel() const { return TerrainParams.SeaLevel; }

	/**
	 * Get height scale (noise amplitude multiplier).
	 */
	float GetHeightScale() const { return TerrainParams.HeightScale; }

	/**
	 * Get base height offset.
	 */
	float GetBaseHeight() const { return TerrainParams.BaseHeight; }

	// ==================== Static Helpers ====================

	/**
	 * Sample 2D noise for terrain height.
	 * Uses only X,Y coordinates for heightmap generation.
	 *
	 * @param X World X coordinate
	 * @param Y World Y coordinate
	 * @param NoiseParams Noise generation parameters
	 * @return Noise value in range [-1, 1]
	 */
	static float SampleTerrainNoise2D(
		float X,
		float Y,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams);

	/**
	 * The terrain height generation produces at (X,Y): base noise with continentalness applied. The one
	 * analytic height for code that runs off the chunk manager's world mode (POI placement and the pad
	 * conditioner, which must stay pure and thread-safe); GetTerrainHeightAt wraps it.
	 *
	 * @param X,Y           World XY sample position
	 * @param BaseParams    Un-modulated terrain params (SeaLevel, HeightScale, BaseHeight)
	 * @param NoiseParams   Terrain noise params
	 * @param BiomeSnapshot Value-captured biome data for continentalness, or null for the raw base height
	 * @return World Z of the generated terrain surface (before conditioning zones and edits)
	 */
	static float SampleTerrainHeight(
		float X,
		float Y,
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& BaseParams,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams,
		const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot);

	/**
	 * Whether analytic height queries apply continentalness (cvar voxel.Height.AnalyticContinentalness,
	 * default on). Callers that capture their own biome snapshot honour it the way GetTerrainHeightAt does.
	 * @return False when the cvar reverts analytic heights to the raw base terrain
	 */
	static bool IsAnalyticContinentalnessEnabled();

	/**
	 * Convert terrain noise to height.
	 *
	 * @param NoiseValue Noise sample in range [-1, 1]
	 * @param TerrainParams Terrain configuration
	 * @return World Z height for terrain surface
	 */
	static float NoiseToTerrainHeight(
		float NoiseValue,
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& TerrainParams);

	/**
	 * Apply continentalness height modulation to base terrain params — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
	 * shared by chunk generation and the analytic GetTerrainHeightAt query.
	 *
	 * Samples the continentalness noise field at (X,Y) (same params as generation: 2-octave Simplex,
	 * seed = BaseNoiseParams.Seed + snapshot seed offset) and offsets BaseHeight / scales HeightScale via
	 * the snapshot's baked continentalness curves. Returns BaseParams unchanged when BiomeSnapshot is
	 * null or continentalness is disabled. Pure and thread-safe (the snapshot is plain data — build it
	 * once per batch with FVoxelBiomeSnapshot::FromConfig, on the game thread).
	 *
	 * @param X,Y             World XY sample position
	 * @param BaseParams      Un-modulated terrain params
	 * @param BaseNoiseParams Terrain noise params (only Seed is used, to derive the continentalness seed)
	 * @param BiomeSnapshot   Value-captured biome data providing continentalness curves, or null
	 * @param OutContinentalness Sampled continentalness in [-1,1] (0 when disabled) — reusable by callers
	 * @return Effective terrain params with continentalness applied
	 */
	static FWorldModeTerrainParams ComputeEffectiveTerrainParams(
		float X,
		float Y,
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& BaseParams,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& BaseNoiseParams,
		const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
		float& OutContinentalness);

	/**
	 * ComputeEffectiveTerrainParams with the continentalness field sampled at a 3D point: (X, Y, 0) in heightmap modes
	 * (the XY overload calls this), the point on the datum sphere on a planet (FSphericalPlanetWorldMode, spherical
	 * SP-B5). Same noise field, same curves.
	 *
	 * @param SamplePos       Where the continentalness noise is sampled
	 * @param BaseParams      Un-modulated terrain params
	 * @param BaseNoiseParams Terrain noise params (only Seed is used, to derive the continentalness seed)
	 * @param BiomeSnapshot   Value-captured biome data providing continentalness curves, or null
	 * @param OutContinentalness Sampled continentalness in [-1,1] (0 when disabled)
	 * @return Effective terrain params with continentalness applied
	 */
	static FWorldModeTerrainParams ComputeEffectiveTerrainParamsAt(
		const FVector& SamplePos,
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& BaseParams,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& BaseNoiseParams,
		const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
		float& OutContinentalness);

	/**
	 * Worst-case terrain-height bounds [OutMin, OutMax] over ALL (X,Y) for this heightmap mode — the
	 * authority for vertical chunk-culling bounds (VoxelLOD). Co-located with the height math so it
	 * stays in sync as height-affecting features are added (add a feature -> update it here, next to
	 * NoiseToTerrainHeight / ComputeEffectiveTerrainParams).
	 *
	 * Accounts for the base noise amplitude (BaseHeight ± HeightScale) AND continentalness (height
	 * offset range + max scale multiplier). The returned range is a conservative superset that CONTAINS
	 * every value the generator can produce at any (X,Y), so culling to it can never remove a chunk that
	 * holds real terrain. Callers add their own per-chunk buffer for meshing / edit slack.
	 *
	 * @param BaseParams    Un-modulated terrain params (SeaLevel, BaseHeight, HeightScale)
	 * @param BiomeSnapshot Value-captured biome data for the continentalness extent, or null (base range only)
	 * @param OutMin,OutMax  Guaranteed-containing terrain height range (world Z)
	 */
	static void GetTerrainHeightBounds(
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& BaseParams,
		const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
		float& OutMin,
		float& OutMax);

	/**
	 * Calculate signed distance to terrain surface.
	 *
	 * @param WorldZ World Z coordinate of sample point
	 * @param TerrainHeight Z height of terrain surface at this X,Y
	 * @return Signed distance (positive = below surface/solid)
	 */
	static float CalculateSignedDistance(
		float WorldZ,
		float TerrainHeight);

	/**
	 * Convert signed distance to voxel density [0-255].
	 * Uses smooth falloff for surface blending.
	 *
	 * @param SignedDistance Distance to surface (positive = inside)
	 * @param VoxelSize Size of voxel for normalization
	 * @return Density value where 127 = surface threshold
	 */
	static uint8 SignedDistanceToDensity(
		float SignedDistance,
		float VoxelSize);

private:
	/** Terrain generation parameters */
	FWorldModeTerrainParams TerrainParams;

	/**
	 * Value-captured biome data for continentalness height modulation in GetTerrainHeightAt
	 * (snapshotted from the config in SetBiomeContext). Plain data, no UObject reference — safe on
	 * any thread and for tasks that outlive the world. Default (never set) => raw base terrain height.
	 */
	FVoxelBiomeSnapshot BiomeSnapshot;

	/** Practical vertical limits for chunk generation */
	static constexpr int32 MIN_Z_CHUNKS = -64;
	static constexpr int32 MAX_Z_CHUNKS = 64;
};
```

### Source/VoxelGeneration/Public/IslandBowlWorldMode.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "IVoxelWorldMode.h"
#include "VoxelBiomeSnapshot.h"

class UVoxelBiomeConfiguration;

/**
 * Island shape types for boundary calculation.
 */
enum class EIslandShape : uint8
{
	/** Circular island (radial distance from center) */
	Circular,

	/** Rectangular island (axis-aligned box with separate X/Y sizes) */
	Rectangle
};

/**
 * Falloff curve types for island edge transitions.
 */
enum class EIslandFalloffType : uint8
{
	/** Linear falloff (simple but sharp transition) */
	Linear,

	/** Smooth hermite falloff (gradual, natural-looking) */
	Smooth,

	/** Squared falloff (faster transition near edge) */
	Squared,

	/** Exponential falloff (steep near the island, flattening toward the edge; rescaled to reach 0 at the edge) */
	Exponential
};

/**
 * Island-specific configuration parameters. Build them from a world configuration with
 * FVoxelWorldModeFactory::MakeIslandParams, the one builder generation, the LOD cull, the map and the editor share.
 */
struct VOXELGENERATION_API FIslandBowlParams
{
	/** Shape of the island (Circular or Rectangle) */
	EIslandShape Shape = EIslandShape::Circular;

	/** Radius/SizeX of the island in world units (distance from center to edge start) */
	float IslandRadius = 50000.0f;

	/** Size Y of the island (only used for Rectangle shape) */
	float SizeY = 50000.0f;

	/** Width of the falloff zone where terrain fades to nothing */
	float FalloffWidth = 10000.0f;

	/** Type of falloff curve to use */
	EIslandFalloffType FalloffType = EIslandFalloffType::Smooth;

	/**
	 * Centre of the island, world X. Absolute: FVoxelWorldModeFactory::MakeIslandParams resolves the config's
	 * offset (UVoxelWorldConfiguration::IslandCenterX, relative to WorldOrigin) to WorldOrigin.X + offset.
	 */
	float CenterX = 0.0f;

	/** Centre of the island, world Y. Absolute, like CenterX */
	float CenterY = 0.0f;

	/** Terrain height the falloff fades to at the edge (R + FalloffWidth); beyond it the seabed slopes down from here */
	float EdgeHeight = -1000.0f;

	/** How far below EdgeHeight the seabed beyond the edge ends up (GetSeabedHeight; WM-E1) */
	float SeabedDepth = 6000.0f;

	/** Horizontal distance past the edge over which the seabed slopes down by SeabedDepth; 0 is a step at the edge */
	float SeabedSlopeWidth = 20000.0f;

	FIslandBowlParams() = default;

	FIslandBowlParams(float InRadius, float InFalloff, EIslandFalloffType InType = EIslandFalloffType::Smooth)
		: IslandRadius(InRadius)
		, SizeY(InRadius)
		, FalloffWidth(InFalloff)
		, FalloffType(InType)
	{
	}

	/** Get the total island extent in X (radius/sizeX + falloff) */
	float GetTotalExtentX() const
	{
		return IslandRadius + FalloffWidth;
	}

	/** Get the total island extent in Y (sizeY + falloff, or same as X for circular) */
	float GetTotalExtentY() const
	{
		return (Shape == EIslandShape::Rectangle ? SizeY : IslandRadius) + FalloffWidth;
	}

	/** Get the maximum total extent (for circular compatibility) */
	float GetTotalExtent() const
	{
		return FMath::Max(GetTotalExtentX(), GetTotalExtentY());
	}
};

/**
 * Island Bowl World Mode implementation.
 *
 * Generates bounded terrain with falloff at the edges, creating an island
 * or bowl-shaped landmass. Terrain height is modulated by distance from
 * the island center, fading to nothing (or a minimum height) at the edges.
 *
 * Island Shape:
 * - Center to IslandRadius: Full terrain height (no falloff)
 * - IslandRadius to IslandRadius+FalloffWidth: Gradual falloff, reaching EdgeHeight at the edge
 * - Beyond the edge: the seabed slopes from EdgeHeight down by SeabedDepth over SeabedSlopeWidth, then stays flat
 *   (GetSeabedHeight; world modes review WM-E1: it was a flat floor 1,000 uu down, a cliff at the edge)
 *
 * Density Calculation:
 * - Sample base terrain height (same as InfinitePlane)
 * - Calculate falloff factor based on distance from center
 * - Final height = BaseHeight * FalloffFactor + EdgeHeight * (1 - FalloffFactor)
 * - Density = FinalHeight - WorldPos.Z
 *
 * @see IVoxelWorldMode
 * @see FInfinitePlaneWorldMode
 */
class VOXELGENERATION_API FIslandBowlWorldMode : public IVoxelWorldMode
{
public:
	/**
	 * Construct with default parameters.
	 */
	FIslandBowlWorldMode();

	/**
	 * Construct with specified parameters.
	 *
	 * @param InTerrainParams Base terrain generation parameters
	 * @param InIslandParams Island-specific parameters
	 */
	FIslandBowlWorldMode(
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& InTerrainParams,
		const FIslandBowlParams& InIslandParams);

	virtual ~FIslandBowlWorldMode() = default;

	// ==================== IVoxelWorldMode Interface ====================

	virtual float GetDensityAt(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		int32 LODLevel,
		float NoiseValue) const override;

	virtual float GetTerrainHeightAt(
		float X,
		float Y,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const override;

	virtual FIntVector WorldToChunkCoord(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		int32 ChunkSize,
		float VoxelSize) const override;

	virtual FVector ChunkCoordToWorld(
		const FIntVector& ChunkCoord,
		int32 ChunkSize,
		float VoxelSize,
		int32 LODLevel) const override;

	virtual int32 GetMinZ() const override;
	virtual int32 GetMaxZ() const override;

	virtual EWorldMode GetWorldModeType() const override { return EWorldMode::IslandBowl; }
	virtual bool IsHeightmapBased() const override { return true; }

	virtual uint8 GetMaterialAtDepth(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		float SurfaceHeight,
		float DepthBelowSurface) const override;

	// ==================== Configuration ====================

	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& GetTerrainParams() const { return TerrainParams; }
	void SetTerrainParams(const FWorldModeTerrainParams& InParams) { TerrainParams = InParams; }

	const FIslandBowlParams& GetIslandParams() const { return IslandParams; }
	void SetIslandParams(const FIslandBowlParams& InParams) { IslandParams = InParams; }

	/**
	 * Provide the biome configuration for continentalness height modulation (IVoxelWorldMode). IslandBowl
	 * applies continentalness (internal oceans/mountains) to the base height, THEN the island edge falloff,
	 * so a large island gets internal variation while still fading at the world edges.
	 * Snapshotted BY VALUE at this call (game thread) — no UObject reference is retained, so the mode is
	 * safe to share into background tasks that may outlive the world.
	 */
	virtual void SetBiomeContext(const UVoxelBiomeConfiguration* InBiomeConfig) override
	{
		BiomeSnapshot = FVoxelBiomeSnapshot::FromConfig(InBiomeConfig);
	}

	/**
	 * Per-mode vertical-cull bounds (IVoxelWorldMode): the base continentalness extent, with the minimum lowered to
	 * the seabed's floor beyond the edge (EdgeHeight - SeabedDepth) when that is deeper.
	 */
	virtual void GetTerrainHeightBounds(float& OutMin, float& OutMax) const override;

	// ==================== World Bounds and Local Frame (IVoxelWorldMode, WM-A2) ====================
	// Up is +Z and the surface coordinate is (0, X, Y) (the defaults); the datum is SeaLevel.

	/** Inside the island's R + falloff footprint (IsWithinIslandBounds): beyond it generation writes only the seabed. */
	virtual bool IsInsideWorld(double X, double Y) const override;

	/** A circle (R + F) or a rectangle (R + F by SizeY + F) around the island centre, with the terrain's height bounds. */
	virtual FVoxelWorldBounds GetWorldBounds() const override;

	/** Z above SeaLevel. */
	virtual float GetAltitude(const FVector& WorldPos) const override;

	/** (U, V, SeaLevel + Altitude). */
	virtual FVector SurfaceToWorld(const FVoxelSurfaceCoord& Coord, float Altitude) const override;

	// ==================== Static Helpers ====================

	/**
	 * Calculate the distance from a point to the island center (2D, ignoring Z).
	 * For circular islands, returns Euclidean distance.
	 *
	 * @param X World X coordinate
	 * @param Y World Y coordinate
	 * @param CenterX Island center X
	 * @param CenterY Island center Y
	 * @return Distance from center
	 */
	static float CalculateDistanceFromCenter(
		float X, float Y,
		float CenterX, float CenterY);

	/**
	 * Calculate the normalized distance from a point to the island boundary.
	 * Works for both circular and rectangular islands.
	 *
	 * @param X World X coordinate
	 * @param Y World Y coordinate
	 * @param IslandParams Island configuration parameters
	 * @return Normalized distance: 0 = at center, 1 = at edge, >1 = in falloff zone
	 */
	static float CalculateNormalizedDistance(
		float X, float Y,
		const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams);

	/**
	 * Calculate the falloff factor based on distance from center.
	 *
	 * @param Distance Distance from island center (or normalized distance for rectangle)
	 * @param IslandRadius Inner radius where falloff starts
	 * @param FalloffWidth Width of the falloff zone
	 * @param FalloffType Type of falloff curve
	 * @return Falloff factor in range [0, 1] (1 = full terrain, 0 = no terrain)
	 */
	static float CalculateFalloffFactor(
		float Distance,
		float IslandRadius,
		float FalloffWidth,
		EIslandFalloffType FalloffType);

	/**
	 * Calculate the falloff factor using island params (handles both shapes).
	 *
	 * @param X World X coordinate
	 * @param Y World Y coordinate
	 * @param IslandParams Island configuration
	 * @return Falloff factor in range [0, 1] (1 = full terrain, 0 = no terrain)
	 */
	static float CalculateFalloffFactorForPoint(
		float X, float Y,
		const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams);

	/**
	 * The falloff curve on the normalized position in the falloff zone (shared by both shapes, and mirrored by
	 * ApplyIslandFalloffCurve in Shaders/Private/IslandFalloff.ush).
	 *
	 * @param T Position in the falloff zone: 0 at IslandRadius, 1 at the edge (clamped)
	 * @param FalloffType Type of falloff curve
	 * @return Falloff factor: 1 at T = 0, exactly 0 at T = 1 for every curve
	 */
	static float ApplyFalloffCurve(float T, EIslandFalloffType FalloffType);

	/**
	 * The island terrain height at (X, Y) for a base (continentalness-modulated) terrain height: the falloff
	 * toward EdgeHeight inside the island's extent, the seabed (GetSeabedHeight) beyond it, which needs no noise.
	 * The one composition generation (CPU and GPU), GetTerrainHeightAt and GetDensityAt share.
	 *
	 * @param X World X coordinate
	 * @param Y World Y coordinate
	 * @param BaseHeight Terrain height before the island falloff
	 * @param IslandParams Island configuration
	 * @return Island terrain height
	 */
	static float ComposeTerrainHeight(
		float X, float Y,
		float BaseHeight,
		const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams);

	/**
	 * Apply falloff to a terrain height value.
	 *
	 * @param BaseHeight Original terrain height from noise
	 * @param FalloffFactor Falloff factor [0, 1]
	 * @param EdgeHeight Height at island edges (when falloff = 0)
	 * @return Modified terrain height
	 */
	static float ApplyFalloffToHeight(
		float BaseHeight,
		float FalloffFactor,
		float EdgeHeight);

	/**
	 * Check if a position is within the island's total extent.
	 *
	 * @param X World X coordinate
	 * @param Y World Y coordinate
	 * @param IslandParams Island configuration
	 * @return True if within island bounds (including falloff zone)
	 */
	static bool IsWithinIslandBounds(
		float X, float Y,
		const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams);

	/**
	 * How far (X, Y) lies past the island's edge, measured the way the falloff measures it: radially for a circle,
	 * the larger axis excess for a rectangle (so the seabed's contours are circles or rectangles around the island).
	 *
	 * @param X World X coordinate
	 * @param Y World Y coordinate
	 * @param IslandParams Island configuration
	 * @return Distance past the edge; zero or negative inside the island's extent
	 */
	static float GetDistancePastEdge(
		float X, float Y,
		const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams);

	/**
	 * The seabed beyond the island's edge (world modes review WM-E1): EdgeHeight at the edge, sloping down by
	 * SeabedDepth over SeabedSlopeWidth with a smoothstep (flat where it meets the falloff, flat where it reaches the
	 * open sea's floor), flat beyond. Mirrored by IslandSeabedHeight in Shaders/Private/IslandFalloff.ush; the far
	 * ocean's seabed (FVoxelFarOcean) follows it.
	 *
	 * @param DistancePastEdge Distance past the edge (GetDistancePastEdge); clamped at 0
	 * @param IslandParams Island configuration
	 * @return Seabed height (world Z)
	 */
	static float GetSeabedHeight(
		float DistancePastEdge,
		const FIslandBowlParams& IslandParams);

private:
	/** Base terrain generation parameters */
	FWorldModeTerrainParams TerrainParams;

	/** Island-specific parameters */
	FIslandBowlParams IslandParams;

	/**
	 * Value-captured biome data for continentalness height modulation (GetTerrainHeightAt), snapshotted
	 * from the config in SetBiomeContext. Plain data, no UObject reference — safe on any thread and for
	 * tasks that outlive the world. Default (never set) => raw base terrain height (no continentalness).
	 */
	FVoxelBiomeSnapshot BiomeSnapshot;

	/** Practical vertical limits for chunk generation */
	static constexpr int32 MIN_Z_CHUNKS = -4;
	static constexpr int32 MAX_Z_CHUNKS = 8;
};
```

### Source/VoxelGeneration/Public/SphericalPlanetWorldMode.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "IVoxelWorldMode.h"
#include "VoxelBiomeSnapshot.h"

/**
 * Spherical planet configuration parameters. Build them from a world configuration with
 * FVoxelWorldModeFactory::MakePlanetParams (SP-A6).
 */
struct VOXELGENERATION_API FSphericalPlanetParams
{
	/**
	 * Radius of the planet surface (the datum) in world units. Double (spherical Phase 6, WM-BP4): every quantity of size R
	 * is kept in double from the centre to the final altitude or signed distance, so a 1,000 km planet (R 1e8, where a
	 * float's spacing is 8 uu) has no cancellation at magnitude R. Altitudes, chunk and voxel sizes stay float.
	 */
	double PlanetRadius = 100000.0;

	/** Maximum terrain height above PlanetRadius */
	float MaxTerrainHeight = 5000.0f;

	/** Maximum terrain depth below PlanetRadius (caves, valleys) */
	float MaxTerrainDepth = 2000.0f;

	/** Center of the planet in world space */
	FVector PlanetCenter = FVector::ZeroVector;

	/**
	 * How far above PlanetRadius the world reaches (spherical Phase 6): the outer out-of-world bound and KillZ's place
	 * (FVoxelWorldBounds::OrbitRadius = PlanetRadius + OrbitCeiling). 0 = 3 x PlanetRadius. Not part of the terrain.
	 */
	double OrbitCeiling = 0.0;

	FSphericalPlanetParams() = default;

	FSphericalPlanetParams(double InRadius, const FVector& InCenter = FVector::ZeroVector)
		: PlanetRadius(InRadius)
		, PlanetCenter(InCenter)
	{
	}

	/** Get the inner shell radius (planet surface minus max depth) */
	double GetInnerRadius() const
	{
		return PlanetRadius - MaxTerrainDepth;
	}

	/** Get the outer shell radius (planet surface plus max height) */
	double GetOuterRadius() const
	{
		return PlanetRadius + MaxTerrainHeight;
	}
};

/**
 * Spherical Planet World Mode implementation.
 *
 * Generates terrain on a spherical surface. Terrain height is radial
 * displacement from the planet's base radius, with noise sampled using
 * the direction vector from the planet center.
 *
 * Coordinate System:
 * - Planet center is at PlanetCenter (typically WorldOrigin)
 * - Radial distance determines "height" above/below surface
 * - The 2D fields (terrain noise, continentalness, temperature, moisture) are sampled at the point on the datum
 *   sphere along the direction from the centre (GetNoiseSamplePoint), so features keep their size in world units
 *   on any radius and the two hemispheres differ (spherical SP-B1)
 *
 * Density Calculation (SampleRadialDisplacement is the one surface function: generation, GetSurfacePoint and the
 * configuration's shell check share it):
 * - Sample terrain noise and continentalness at the direction's noise sample point
 * - Displacement = BaseHeight + offset + noise * HeightScale * multiplier / 2, continentalness giving the offset
 *   and the multiplier as in the heightmap modes (SP-B5)
 * - Calculate terrain radius = PlanetRadius + displacement
 * - Density = TerrainRadius - DistanceFromCenter (positive = inside solid)
 *
 * @see IVoxelWorldMode
 * @see FInfinitePlaneWorldMode
 */
class VOXELGENERATION_API FSphericalPlanetWorldMode : public IVoxelWorldMode
{
public:
	/**
	 * Construct with default parameters.
	 */
	FSphericalPlanetWorldMode();

	/**
	 * Construct with specified parameters.
	 *
	 * @param InTerrainParams Base terrain generation parameters (HeightScale used for radial displacement)
	 * @param InPlanetParams Planet-specific parameters
	 */
	FSphericalPlanetWorldMode(
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& InTerrainParams,
		const FSphericalPlanetParams& InPlanetParams);

	virtual ~FSphericalPlanetWorldMode() = default;

	// ==================== IVoxelWorldMode Interface ====================

	virtual float GetDensityAt(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		int32 LODLevel,
		float NoiseValue) const override;

	/**
	 * Legacy heightmap query (spherical SP-A3): a planet has no height per (X, Y), so this returns the world Z where the
	 * vertical line through (X, Y) meets the terrain on the upper hemisphere (the planet centre's Z when the line misses
	 * the terrain) and logs a warning the first time it is called. Planet code uses GetSurfacePoint instead; the
	 * fallback only keeps a stray legacy caller on the surface rather than at a radius read as a Z.
	 */
	virtual float GetTerrainHeightAt(
		float X,
		float Y,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const override;

	/** The terrain shell's world-Z extent: PlanetCenter.Z -/+ the outer radius (what GetWorldBounds reports). */
	virtual void GetTerrainHeightBounds(float& OutMin, float& OutMax) const override;

	/** The terrain shell as altitudes: -MaxTerrainDepth to +MaxTerrainHeight (spherical SP-A4). */
	virtual void GetAltitudeBounds(float& OutMin, float& OutMax) const override;

	virtual FIntVector WorldToChunkCoord(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		int32 ChunkSize,
		float VoxelSize) const override;

	virtual FVector ChunkCoordToWorld(
		const FIntVector& ChunkCoord,
		int32 ChunkSize,
		float VoxelSize,
		int32 LODLevel) const override;

	virtual int32 GetMinZ() const override;
	virtual int32 GetMaxZ() const override;

	virtual EWorldMode GetWorldModeType() const override { return EWorldMode::SphericalPlanet; }
	virtual bool IsHeightmapBased() const override { return false; }  // 3D terrain, not heightmap

	virtual uint8 GetMaterialAtDepth(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		float SurfaceHeight,
		float DepthBelowSurface) const override;

	/**
	 * Snapshot the biome configuration for continentalness (SP-B5), by value: GetSurfacePoint then applies the same
	 * height modulation generation does. No UObject reference is kept.
	 */
	virtual void SetBiomeContext(const UVoxelBiomeConfiguration* InBiomeConfig) override
	{
		BiomeSnapshot = FVoxelBiomeSnapshot::FromConfig(InBiomeConfig);
	}

	/** The surface along the direction from the planet centre to WorldPos, with its outward normal (SP-A1). */
	virtual FVoxelTerrainSurfacePoint GetSurfacePoint(const FVector& WorldPos, const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const override;

	/**
	 * The generated surface (spherical SP-B10): GetSurfacePoint with planet conditioning zones applied to the altitude
	 * along every direction it samples (FVoxelTerrainConditioning::ApplyToAltitude, as GenerateChunkSphericalPlanet does),
	 * so the point and its normal follow a flattened pad and its ring. No zones: GetSurfacePoint exactly.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos Any position on the up-line
	 * @param NoiseParams Terrain noise
	 * @param Zones Conditioning zones (planet zones apply; gather them for the place, e.g. UVoxelChunkManager::GatherConditioningZonesOnSphere)
	 * @return The surface point, normal and altitude
	 */
	FVoxelTerrainSurfacePoint GetConditionedSurfacePoint(const FVector& WorldPos, const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams,
		const TArray<struct FVoxelConditioningZone>& Zones) const;

	/**
	 * GetTerrainAltitude with planet conditioning zones applied (spherical SP-B10).
	 *
	 * @param Direction Unit direction from the planet centre
	 * @param NoiseParams Terrain noise
	 * @param Zones Conditioning zones (planet zones apply)
	 * @return Altitude (uu)
	 */
	float GetConditionedTerrainAltitude(const FVector& Direction, const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams,
		const TArray<struct FVoxelConditioningZone>& Zones) const;

	// ==================== World Bounds and Local Frame (IVoxelWorldMode, WM-A2; SP-A1, SP-A2) ====================
	// The interface fits a planet: up is radial, altitude is above PlanetRadius, the surface coordinate is a cube face
	// with the tangent warp (spherical Phase 1, WORLD_MODES_REVIEW_PLAN.md §15). No 2D system consumes the coordinate
	// yet (Phase 4).

	/** Whether the vertical line at (X, Y) meets the terrain shell (within its outer radius in XY). */
	virtual bool IsInsideWorld(double X, double Y) const override;

	/** The terrain shell: PlanetRadius - MaxTerrainDepth to PlanetRadius + MaxTerrainHeight around the planet centre. */
	virtual FVoxelWorldBounds GetWorldBounds() const override;

	/** The radial direction from the planet centre (+Z at the centre itself). */
	virtual FVector GetUpVector(const FVector& WorldPos) const override;

	/** Distance from the planet centre minus PlanetRadius. */
	virtual float GetAltitude(const FVector& WorldPos) const override;

	/**
	 * The cube face the radial direction points through (0..5 = +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z) and (U, V) in [-1, 1] on it:
	 * the gnomonic projection onto the face, warped per axis by u = (4 / pi) * atan(g) (the tangent warp). Equal UV
	 * cells cover areas within about 1.41x of each other (the plain gnomonic map: 5.2x); along a face's centre lines
	 * UV is proportional to the angle, so a UV step du spans about PlanetRadius * pi / 4 * du on the datum sphere.
	 */
	virtual FVoxelSurfaceCoord WorldToSurface(const FVector& WorldPos) const override;

	/** The point at Altitude above PlanetRadius along the direction through (Face, U, V). */
	virtual FVector SurfaceToWorld(const FVoxelSurfaceCoord& Coord, float Altitude) const override;

	// ==================== Configuration ====================

	const FWorldModeTerrainParams& GetTerrainParams() const { return TerrainParams; }
	void SetTerrainParams(const FWorldModeTerrainParams& InParams) { TerrainParams = InParams; }

	const FSphericalPlanetParams& GetPlanetParams() const { return PlanetParams; }
	void SetPlanetParams(const FSphericalPlanetParams& InParams) { PlanetParams = InParams; }

	/** The biome snapshot SetBiomeContext took (continentalness for the surface); invalid without a biome config. */
	const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot& GetBiomeSnapshot() const { return BiomeSnapshot; }

	/**
	 * The terrain's altitude above the datum along a direction: SampleRadialDisplacement with this planet's radius,
	 * terrain params and biome snapshot, what GetSurfacePoint uses without its normal (spherical Phase 4, the map's
	 * pixels).
	 *
	 * @param Direction Unit direction from the planet centre
	 * @param NoiseParams Terrain noise
	 * @return Altitude (uu)
	 */
	float GetTerrainAltitude(const FVector& Direction, const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams) const
	{
		return SampleRadialDisplacement(Direction, PlanetParams.PlanetRadius, TerrainParams, NoiseParams, &BiomeSnapshot);
	}

	// ==================== Static Helpers ====================

	/**
	 * Calculate the distance from a point to the planet center, in double (WM-BP4: a float of size R is 8 uu coarse at
	 * R 1e8). Subtract PlanetRadius in double before narrowing anything to float.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos World position
	 * @param PlanetCenter Center of the planet
	 * @return Distance from planet center
	 */
	static double CalculateRadialDistance(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		const FVector& PlanetCenter);

	/**
	 * Get the normalized direction from planet center to a point.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos World position
	 * @param PlanetCenter Center of the planet
	 * @return Normalized direction vector (or UpVector if at center)
	 */
	static FVector GetDirectionFromCenter(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		const FVector& PlanetCenter);

	/**
	 * Where the planet's 2D fields (terrain noise, continentalness, temperature, moisture) are sampled for a direction:
	 * the point on the datum sphere, relative to the planet centre (SP-B1). A feature is about 1 / Frequency uu across on
	 * the surface whatever the radius, as on the plane, and a 3D field has no seam and no mirror between hemispheres.
	 *
	 * @param Direction Unit direction from the planet centre
	 * @param PlanetRadius Datum radius
	 * @return Noise sample position
	 */
	static FVector GetNoiseSamplePoint(const FVector& Direction, double PlanetRadius)
	{
		return Direction * PlanetRadius;
	}

	/**
	 * Terrain noise by direction: FBM3D at GetNoiseSamplePoint (SP-B1).
	 *
	 * @param Direction Unit direction from the planet centre
	 * @param PlanetRadius Datum radius
	 * @param NoiseParams Terrain noise parameters
	 * @return Noise value in range [-1, 1]
	 */
	static float SampleSphericalNoise(
		const FVector& Direction,
		double PlanetRadius,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams);

	/**
	 * The terrain params at a direction with continentalness applied: BaseHeight plus the height offset, HeightScale times
	 * the multiplier, the continentalness field sampled at GetNoiseSamplePoint (SP-B5). The same noise field and curves
	 * as FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::ComputeEffectiveTerrainParams. BaseParams unchanged without a snapshot or with
	 * continentalness off.
	 *
	 * @param Direction Unit direction from the planet centre
	 * @param PlanetRadius Datum radius
	 * @param BaseParams Un-modulated terrain params (HeightScale = PlanetHeightScale)
	 * @param NoiseParams Terrain noise params (the seed derives the continentalness seed)
	 * @param BiomeSnapshot Biome data with the continentalness curves, or null
	 * @param OutContinentalness Sampled continentalness in [-1, 1] (0 when off): biome selection reuses it
	 * @return Effective terrain params
	 */
	static FWorldModeTerrainParams ComputeEffectiveTerrainParams(
		const FVector& Direction,
		double PlanetRadius,
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& BaseParams,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams,
		const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
		float& OutContinentalness);

	/**
	 * The planet's terrain height: the surface's radial displacement from PlanetRadius along a direction. Generation,
	 * GetSurfacePoint and the shell check all use it (SP-A1, SP-B1, SP-B5).
	 *
	 * @param Direction Unit direction from the planet centre
	 * @param PlanetRadius Datum radius
	 * @param TerrainParams Un-modulated terrain params
	 * @param NoiseParams Terrain noise params
	 * @param BiomeSnapshot Biome data for continentalness, or null
	 * @param OutContinentalness Optional: the sampled continentalness
	 * @return Displacement (uu, positive above the datum)
	 */
	static float SampleRadialDisplacement(
		const FVector& Direction,
		double PlanetRadius,
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& TerrainParams,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& NoiseParams,
		const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
		float* OutContinentalness = nullptr);

	/**
	 * Worst-case displacement bounds over every direction: noise in [-1, 1] at continentalness's extremes, decoupled
	 * (FVoxelBiomeSnapshot::GetContinentalnessExtremes), as FInfinitePlaneWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightBounds does for the
	 * plane. The terrain shell (MaxTerrainHeight, MaxTerrainDepth) must contain it; UVoxelWorldConfiguration's settings
	 * check computes the same numbers.
	 *
	 * @param TerrainParams Un-modulated terrain params
	 * @param BiomeSnapshot Biome data for continentalness, or null
	 * @param OutMin Lowest displacement
	 * @param OutMax Highest displacement
	 */
	static void GetDisplacementBounds(
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& TerrainParams,
		const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot* BiomeSnapshot,
		float& OutMin,
		float& OutMax);

	/**
	 * Convert noise value to radial terrain displacement, without continentalness (GetDensityAt's contract: the caller
	 * passes the terrain noise, as in the heightmap modes). SampleRadialDisplacement is the full surface.
	 *
	 * @param NoiseValue Raw noise value [-1, 1]
	 * @param TerrainParams Terrain scaling parameters
	 * @return Radial displacement from PlanetRadius
	 */
	static float NoiseToRadialDisplacement(
		float NoiseValue,
		const FWorldModeTerrainParams& TerrainParams);

	/**
	 * The signed distance generation writes: TerrainRadius - DistFromCenter, held at -1000 more than 1000 uu above the
	 * outer shell radius (air) and at +1000 more than 1000 uu below the inner one (core). Both radii in double; the
	 * difference is formed in double (ShellSignedDistanceAtAltitude).
	 *
	 * @param DistFromCenter Distance from the planet centre
	 * @param TerrainRadius PlanetRadius + displacement along the point's direction
	 * @param PlanetParams Planet shell
	 * @return Signed distance (positive = solid)
	 */
	static float ShellSignedDistance(
		double DistFromCenter,
		double TerrainRadius,
		const FSphericalPlanetParams& PlanetParams);

	/**
	 * ShellSignedDistance written with altitudes (spherical Phase 6, WM-BP4): TerrainAltitude - VoxelAltitude, held at
	 * -1000 more than 1000 uu above MaxTerrainHeight and at +1000 more than 1000 uu below -MaxTerrainDepth. Both are of
	 * the size of the relief, not of R, so nothing cancels; the generator computes VoxelAltitude = |P - C| - R in double,
	 * the GPU from the chunk origin's altitude and a small difference (SphericalPlanet.ush).
	 *
	 * @param VoxelAltitude The point's distance from the centre minus PlanetRadius
	 * @param TerrainAltitude The terrain's altitude along the point's direction
	 * @param PlanetParams Planet shell
	 * @return Signed distance (positive = solid)
	 */
	static float ShellSignedDistanceAtAltitude(
		double VoxelAltitude,
		double TerrainAltitude,
		const FSphericalPlanetParams& PlanetParams);

	/**
	 * A position with its altitude above the datum scaled by VerticalScale and its direction kept: Centre + Direction *
	 * (PlanetRadius + Altitude * VerticalScale). Cave noise samples here, so VerticalScale flattens caves along local up
	 * as it flattens them along Z in heightmap modes (SP-B6), and keeps horizontal distances near the datum.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos World position
	 * @param PlanetParams Planet centre and radius
	 * @param VerticalScale Scale applied to the altitude
	 * @return Cave noise sample position
	 */
	static FVector ScaleAltitude(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		const FSphericalPlanetParams& PlanetParams,
		float VerticalScale);

	/**
	 * ScaleAltitude relative to the planet centre: PlanetRelativePos with its altitude scaled by VerticalScale, in double.
	 * Planet caves sample the planet noise here (WM-BP5), so they move with the planet and stay exact at any radius.
	 *
	 * @param PlanetRelativePos Position relative to the planet centre
	 * @param PlanetRadius Datum radius
	 * @param VerticalScale Scale applied to the altitude
	 * @return Cave noise sample position, relative to the centre
	 */
	static FVector ScaleAltitudeRelative(
		const FVector& PlanetRelativePos,
		double PlanetRadius,
		float VerticalScale);

	/**
	 * The planet's continentalness field: the 2-octave Simplex field at the biome configuration's frequency and seed
	 * offset (the heightmap modes' parameters), sampled by the planet noise (WM-BP5).
	 *
	 * @param WorldSeed The terrain noise seed
	 * @param BiomeSnapshot Biome data with the continentalness settings
	 * @return Noise parameters
	 */
	static FVoxelNoiseParams GetContinentalnessNoiseParams(int32 WorldSeed, const FVoxelBiomeSnapshot& BiomeSnapshot);

	/**
	 * Temperature and moisture along a direction: each field at the direction's point on the datum sphere (SP-B1) by the
	 * planet noise (WM-BP5), as generation, the surface queries and the map sample them.
	 *
	 * @param Direction Unit direction from the planet centre
	 * @param PlanetRadius Datum radius
	 * @param TemperatureParams Temperature field (FVoxelPlanetNoise::MakeFieldParams)
	 * @param MoistureParams Moisture field
	 * @param OutTemperature Temperature in about [-1, 1]
	 * @param OutMoisture Moisture in about [-1, 1]
	 */
	static void SampleClimate(
		const FVector& Direction,
		double PlanetRadius,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& TemperatureParams,
		const FVoxelNoiseParams& MoistureParams,
		float& OutTemperature,
		float& OutMoisture);

	/**
	 * Calculate signed distance from a point to the terrain surface.
	 *
	 * @param DistFromCenter Distance from planet center
	 * @param TerrainRadius Radius of terrain at this direction (PlanetRadius + displacement)
	 * @return Signed distance (positive = inside solid, negative = air)
	 */
	static float CalculateSignedDistance(
		double DistFromCenter,
		double TerrainRadius);

	/**
	 * Check if a position is within the planet's terrain shell.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos World position
	 * @param PlanetParams Planet configuration
	 * @return True if within inner/outer radius bounds
	 */
	static bool IsWithinPlanetBounds(
		const FVector& WorldPos,
		const FSphericalPlanetParams& PlanetParams);

private:
	/** Base terrain generation parameters */
	FWorldModeTerrainParams TerrainParams;

	/** Planet-specific parameters */
	FSphericalPlanetParams PlanetParams;

	/** Continentalness for GetSurfacePoint (SetBiomeContext); plain data, safe on any thread. */
	FVoxelBiomeSnapshot BiomeSnapshot;

	/** Practical chunk range for spherical planet (relative to viewer) */
	static constexpr int32 CHUNK_RANGE = 32;
};
