		// (the hillshade's neighbours; past a face edge the face's plane extended, which is the neighbouring face's ground).
		TArray<FVector> Directions;
		TArray<float> Altitudes;
		Directions.SetNumUninitialized(GridSize * GridSize);
		Altitudes.SetNumUninitialized(GridSize * GridSize);
		for (int32 GY = 0; GY < GridSize; ++GY)
		{
			for (int32 GX = 0; GX < GridSize; ++GX)
			{
				const FVector Direction = Grid.DirectionAt(TileCoord, (GX - 0.5) / Resolution, (GY - 0.5) / Resolution);
				Directions[GY * GridSize + GX] = Direction;
				Altitudes[GY * GridSize + GX] = Planet.GetConditionedTerrainAltitude(Direction, NoiseParams, Zones);
			}
		}

		// Surface material as the planet generator writes it at the surface voxel (QueryPlanetSurfaceConditions).
		auto AnalyticMaterialAt = [&](const FVector& Direction, float Altitude) -> uint8
		{
			const FVector Position = Center + Direction * (Radius + Altitude);
			uint8 MaterialID = 0;
			if (bUseBiomes && BiomeSnapshot.bIsValid)
			{
				uint8 BiomeID = 0;
				FVoxelSurfaceQuery::QueryPlanetSurfaceConditions(Planet, Position, VoxelSize, NoiseParams, BiomeSnapshot, Sea, MaterialID, BiomeID, &Zones);
			}
			else if (bUseBiomes)
			{
				// The planet generator's climate: the planet noise on the datum sphere (WM-BP5)
				float Temperature, Moisture;
				FSphericalPlanetWorldMode::SampleClimate(Direction, Radius, FallbackTempNoiseParams, FallbackMoistureNoiseParams, Temperature, Moisture);
				const FBiomeBlend Blend = FVoxelBiomeRegistry::GetBiomeBlend(Temperature, Moisture, 0.15f);
				MaterialID = FVoxelBiomeRegistry::GetBlendedMaterial(Blend, 0.0f,
					FVoxelBlendDitherKey(FVoxelBiomeBlendDither::KeyAt(Position, VoxelSize), NoiseParams.Seed));
			}
			else
			{
				MaterialID = Planet.GetMaterialAtDepth(Position, static_cast<float>(Radius + Altitude), 0.0f);
			}
			return MaterialID;
		};

		// The tile's own pixels: the overlay build reads them, and the game thread keeps their altitude range.
		TArray<FVector> PixelDirections;
		TArray<float> AnalyticAltitudes;
		PixelDirections.SetNumUninitialized(NumPixels);
		AnalyticAltitudes.SetNumUninitialized(NumPixels);
		float AnalyticMin = TNumericLimits<float>::Max();
		float AnalyticMax = TNumericLimits<float>::Lowest();
		for (int32 PY = 0; PY < Resolution; ++PY)
		{
			for (int32 PX = 0; PX < Resolution; ++PX)
			{
				const int32 G = (PY + 1) * GridSize + PX + 1;
				PixelDirections[PY * Resolution + PX] = Directions[G];
				AnalyticAltitudes[PY * Resolution + PX] = Altitudes[G];
				AnalyticMin = FMath::Min(AnalyticMin, Altitudes[G]);
				AnalyticMax = FMath::Max(AnalyticMax, Altitudes[G]);
			}
		}

		// --- Edit overlay: rebuilt along each pixel's line when due, as on the plane.
		bool bOverlayPending = false;
		if (RebuildInput.IsValid())
		{
			const FVoxelMapEditOverlay Built = FVoxelMapEditOverlay::BuildPlanet(*RebuildInput, PixelDirections, AnalyticAltitudes,
				[&](int32 PX, int32 PY)
				{
					const int32 Index = PY * Resolution + PX;
					return AnalyticMaterialAt(PixelDirections[Index], AnalyticAltitudes[Index]);
				});
			bOverlayPending = Built.PendingColumns.Num() > 0;
			const FVoxelMapEditOverlay* Previous = OwnOverlay.Get();
			FVoxelMapEditOverlay Merged = FVoxelMapEditOverlay::MergePending(Built, Previous);
			Merged.PendingColumns.Empty();
			OwnOverlay.Reset();
			if (!Merged.IsEmpty())
			{
				OwnOverlay = MakeShared<const FVoxelMapEditOverlay>(MoveTemp(Merged));
			}
			RebuildInput.Reset();
		}
		const TSharedPtr<const FVoxelMapEditOverlay> Overlay = OwnOverlay;
		auto UsableOverlay = [Resolution](const FVoxelMapEditOverlay* Candidate)
		{
			return Candidate && Candidate->bAltitudeHeights && Candidate->Resolution == Resolution;
		};

		// Edited altitudes into the grid: the tile's own pixels from its overlay, the apron's from whichever neighbour holds
		// the apron pixel's direction.
		TArray<int32> OverlaySlot;
		OverlaySlot.Init(INDEX_NONE, NumPixels);
		for (int32 GY = 0; GY < GridSize; ++GY)
		{
			for (int32 GX = 0; GX < GridSize; ++GX)
			{
				const int32 G = GY * GridSize + GX;
				const bool bInterior = GX >= 1 && GY >= 1 && GX <= Resolution && GY <= Resolution;
				const FVoxelMapEditOverlay* Source = nullptr;
				int32 PX = GX - 1;
				int32 PY = GY - 1;
				if (bInterior)
				{
					Source = UsableOverlay(Overlay.Get()) ? Overlay.Get() : nullptr;
				}
				else if (NeighbourOverlays.Num() > 0)
				{
					FVector2D Fraction;
					const FIntPoint Cell = Grid.CellOfDirection(Directions[G], &Fraction);
					for (const TPair<FIntPoint, TSharedPtr<const FVoxelMapEditOverlay>>& Pair : NeighbourOverlays)
					{
						if (Pair.Key == Cell && UsableOverlay(Pair.Value.Get()))
						{
							Source = Pair.Value.Get();
							PX = FMath::Clamp(FMath::FloorToInt32(Fraction.X * Resolution), 0, Resolution - 1);
							PY = FMath::Clamp(FMath::FloorToInt32(Fraction.Y * Resolution), 0, Resolution - 1);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!Source)
				{
					continue;
				}
				const int32 Slot = Source->FindColumn(PX, PY);
				if (Slot != INDEX_NONE)
				{
					Altitudes[G] = Source->Heights[Slot];
					if (bInterior)
					{
						OverlaySlot[PY * Resolution + PX] = Slot;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		// Shading ranges from the terrain's altitude bounds: land from the sea (or the lowest terrain) to the highest, water
		// depth from the sea down to the lowest.
		const bool bSeaOn = Sea.bEnabled && Sea.bRadial;
		const float SeaAltitude = bSeaOn ? static_cast<float>(Sea.Radius - Radius) : AltitudeMin;
		const float LandBase = bSeaOn ? SeaAltitude : AltitudeMin;
		const float LandSpan = FMath::Max(AltitudeMax - LandBase, 1.0f);
		const float DepthSpan = FMath::Max(LandBase - AltitudeMin, 1.0f);
		auto PositionAt = [&](int32 G)
		{
			return Center + Directions[G] * (Radius + Altitudes[G]);
		};

		// --- Pass 2: colour, as the plane's in the local frame.
		TArray<FColor> PixelData;
		PixelData.SetNumUninitialized(NumPixels);
		for (int32 PY = 0; PY < Resolution; ++PY)
		{
			for (int32 PX = 0; PX < Resolution; ++PX)
			{
				const int32 GX = PX + 1;
				const int32 GY = PY + 1;
				const int32 G = GY * GridSize + GX;
				const float Altitude = Altitudes[G];

				uint8 MaterialID = 0;
				bool bWater = false;
				const int32 Slot = OverlaySlot[PY * Resolution + PX];
				if (Slot != INDEX_NONE)
				{
					MaterialID = Overlay->Materials[Slot];
					bWater = (Overlay->Flags[Slot] & FVoxelMapEditOverlay::FlagWater) != 0;
				}
				else
				{
					MaterialID = AnalyticMaterialAt(Directions[G], Altitude);
					bWater = bSeaOn && Radius + Altitude < Sea.Radius;
				}

				FColor Color;
				if (bWater)
				{
					const float Depth = SeaAltitude - Altitude;
					const float DepthFactor = FMath::Lerp(1.0f, 0.3f, FMath::Clamp(Depth / DepthSpan, 0.0f, 1.0f));
					Color.R = FMath::Clamp(static_cast<int32>(20 * DepthFactor), 0, 255);
					Color.G = FMath::Clamp(static_cast<int32>(80 * DepthFactor), 0, 255);
					Color.B = FMath::Clamp(static_cast<int32>(180 * DepthFactor), 0, 255);
					Color.A = 255;
				}
				else
				{
					Color = MaterialPalette[MaterialID];
					const float ElevationFactor = FMath::Clamp((Altitude - LandBase) / LandSpan, 0.0f, 1.0f);
					const float Elevation = FMath::Lerp(0.75f, 1.0f, ElevationFactor);

					// Hillshade: the surface normal from the neighbouring pixels' ground points, lit by the plane's NW key
					// light in the local frame (north toward the +Z pole).
					const FVector Up = Directions[G];
					FVector Normal = FVector::CrossProduct(PositionAt(G + 1) - PositionAt(G - 1), PositionAt(G + GridSize) - PositionAt(G - GridSize)).GetSafeNormal();
					if (Normal.IsNearlyZero())
					{
						Normal = Up;
					}
					else if (FVector::DotProduct(Normal, Up) < 0.0)
					{
						Normal = -Normal;
					}
					FVector East, North;
					FVoxelCubeSphere::GetTangentFrame(Up, East, North);
					const FVector LightDir = (North * -0.707 + East * -0.707 + Up).GetSafeNormal();
					const float NdotL = FMath::Clamp(static_cast<float>(FVector::DotProduct(Normal, LightDir)), 0.0f, 1.0f);
					const float Shade = FMath::Lerp(0.55f, 1.25f, NdotL);

					const float Brightness = Elevation * Shade;
					Color.R = FMath::Clamp(static_cast<int32>(Color.R * Brightness), 0, 255);
					Color.G = FMath::Clamp(static_cast<int32>(Color.G * Brightness), 0, 255);
					Color.B = FMath::Clamp(static_cast<int32>(Color.B * Brightness), 0, 255);
					Color.A = 255;
				}
				PixelData[PY * Resolution + PX] = Color;
			}
		}

		AsyncTask(ENamedThreads::GameThread,
			[WeakThis, TileCoord, PixelData = MoveTemp(PixelData), Resolution, Generation, bRebuild, Overlay,
			 bOverlayPending, AnalyticMin, AnalyticMax]() mutable
		{
			if (UVoxelMapSubsystem* Self = WeakThis.Get())
			{
				Self->FinishTileDrawing(TileCoord, MoveTemp(PixelData), Resolution, Generation, bRebuild, Overlay, bOverlayPending,
					AnalyticMin, AnalyticMax);
			}
		});
	});
}
```

### Source/VoxelMap/Private/VoxelMapTileQueue.cpp
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#include "VoxelMapTileQueue.h"

void FVoxelMapTileQueue::Request(uint64 Key, bool bInvalidate, bool bPriority)
{
	const bool bDrawing = Drawing.Contains(Key);
	if (bInvalidate)
	{
		++Generations.FindOrAdd(Key);
	}
	else if (bDrawing)
	{
		// The running drawing already shows the tile as it is now.
		return;
	}
	Waiting.Add(Key);
	if (bPriority)
	{
		PriorityWaiting.Add(Key);
	}
}

bool FVoxelMapTileQueue::StartNext(uint64& OutKey, uint32& OutGeneration)
{
	return StartNext(OutKey, OutGeneration, [](uint64) { return true; });
}

bool FVoxelMapTileQueue::StartNext(uint64& OutKey, uint32& OutGeneration, TFunctionRef<bool(uint64 Key)> CanStart)
{
	for (const TSet<uint64>* Set : { &PriorityWaiting, &Waiting })
	{
		bool bFound = false;
		for (const uint64 Key : *Set)
		{
			// An invalidated tile waits while its stale drawing finishes; it starts again after Complete.
			if (!Drawing.Contains(Key) && CanStart(Key))
			{
				OutKey = Key;
				bFound = true;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (bFound)
		{
			return Start(OutKey, OutGeneration);
		}
	}
	return false;
}

bool FVoxelMapTileQueue::Start(uint64 Key, uint32& OutGeneration)
{
	if (!Waiting.Contains(Key) || Drawing.Contains(Key))
	{
		return false;
	}
	Waiting.Remove(Key);
	PriorityWaiting.Remove(Key);
	OutGeneration = Generations.FindRef(Key);
	Drawing.Add(Key, OutGeneration);
	return true;
}

bool FVoxelMapTileQueue::Complete(uint64 Key, uint32 Generation)
{
	Drawing.Remove(Key);
	if (Generation != Generations.FindRef(Key))
	{
		// Invalidated while drawing: the request that bumped the generation already queued the tile again.
		Waiting.Add(Key);
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

void FVoxelMapTileQueue::Cancel(uint64 Key)
{
	Drawing.Remove(Key);
	Waiting.Remove(Key);
	PriorityWaiting.Remove(Key);
}

void FVoxelMapTileQueue::Reset()
{
	Waiting.Empty();
	PriorityWaiting.Empty();
	Drawing.Empty();
	Generations.Empty();
}

### Source/VoxelMap/Private/VoxelMapTileStore.cpp
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#include "VoxelMapTileStore.h"

TArray<FColor> FVoxelMapTileStore::Downsample(const TArray<FColor>& Pixels, int32 Resolution, int32 Factor)
{
	TArray<FColor> Out;
	if (Factor <= 0 || Resolution <= 0 || Resolution % Factor != 0 || Pixels.Num() != Resolution * Resolution)
	{
		return Out;
	}
	const int32 Small = Resolution / Factor;
	const int32 Count = Factor * Factor;
	Out.SetNumUninitialized(Small * Small);
	for (int32 Y = 0; Y < Small; ++Y)
	{
		for (int32 X = 0; X < Small; ++X)
		{
			int32 R = 0, G = 0, B = 0, A = 0;
			for (int32 DY = 0; DY < Factor; ++DY)
			{
				const FColor* Row = &Pixels[(Y * Factor + DY) * Resolution + X * Factor];
				for (int32 DX = 0; DX < Factor; ++DX)
				{
					R += Row[DX].R;
					G += Row[DX].G;
					B += Row[DX].B;
					A += Row[DX].A;
				}
			}
			Out[Y * Small + X] = FColor(
				static_cast<uint8>((R + Count / 2) / Count),
				static_cast<uint8>((G + Count / 2) / Count),
				static_cast<uint8>((B + Count / 2) / Count),
				static_cast<uint8>((A + Count / 2) / Count));
		}
	}
	return Out;
}

void FVoxelMapTileStore::SetBudgets(int64 InDetailBudgetBytes, int64 InOverviewBudgetBytes)
{
	DetailBudgetBytes = FMath::Max<int64>(InDetailBudgetBytes, 0);
	OverviewBudgetBytes = FMath::Max<int64>(InOverviewBudgetBytes, 0);
	Enforce();
}

void FVoxelMapTileStore::Store(uint64 Key, FIntPoint Coord, TArray<FColor>&& Pixels, int32 Resolution, bool bKeepDetail)
{
	FEntry& Entry = Entries.FindOrAdd(Key);
	const bool bHadDetail = Entry.Detail.PixelData.Num() > 0;
	DetailBytes -= ImageBytes(Entry.Detail);
	OverviewBytes -= ImageBytes(Entry.Overview);
	DetailCount -= bHadDetail ? 1 : 0;

	// The overview, from the new image (a size that does not divide keeps the image itself as its overview).
	TArray<FColor> Small = Downsample(Pixels, Resolution, OverviewDownsample);
	Entry.Overview.TileCoord = Coord;
	Entry.Overview.bIsReady = true;
	if (Small.Num() > 0)
	{
		Entry.Overview.Resolution = Resolution / OverviewDownsample;
		Entry.Overview.PixelData = MoveTemp(Small);
	}
	else
	{
		Entry.Overview.Resolution = Resolution;
		Entry.Overview.PixelData = Pixels;
	}

	Entry.Detail.TileCoord = Coord;
	Entry.Detail.Resolution = Resolution;
	Entry.Detail.bIsReady = true;
	if (bKeepDetail || bHadDetail)
	{
		Entry.Detail.PixelData = MoveTemp(Pixels);
	}
	else
	{
		Entry.Detail.PixelData.Empty();
	}

	DetailBytes += ImageBytes(Entry.Detail);
	OverviewBytes += ImageBytes(Entry.Overview);
	DetailCount += Entry.Detail.PixelData.Num() > 0 ? 1 : 0;
	Entry.LastUse = ++UseClock;
	Enforce();
}

const FVoxelMapTile* FVoxelMapTileStore::Find(uint64 Key, bool bTouch) const
{
	const FEntry* Entry = Entries.Find(Key);
	if (!Entry)
	{
		return nullptr;
	}
	if (bTouch)
	{
		Entry->LastUse = ++UseClock;
	}
	return Entry->Detail.PixelData.Num() > 0 ? &Entry->Detail : &Entry->Overview;
}

bool FVoxelMapTileStore::HasDetail(uint64 Key) const
{
	const FEntry* Entry = Entries.Find(Key);
	return Entry && Entry->Detail.PixelData.Num() > 0;
}

void FVoxelMapTileStore::Remove(uint64 Key)
{
	if (const FEntry* Entry = Entries.Find(Key))
	{
		DetailBytes -= ImageBytes(Entry->Detail);
		OverviewBytes -= ImageBytes(Entry->Overview);
		DetailCount -= Entry->Detail.PixelData.Num() > 0 ? 1 : 0;
		Entries.Remove(Key);
	}
}

void FVoxelMapTileStore::Reset()
{
	Entries.Empty();
	UseClock = 0;
	DetailBytes = 0;
	OverviewBytes = 0;
	DetailCount = 0;
	DetailEvictions = 0;
	OverviewEvictions = 0;
}

int32 FVoxelMapTileStore::Enforce()
{
	int32 Dropped = 0;

	// Detail first: the least recently used detail images go; their tiles keep the overview.
	if (DetailBudgetBytes > 0 && DetailBytes > DetailBudgetBytes)
	{
		TArray<TPair<uint64, uint64>> Order; // (last use, key)
		Order.Reserve(DetailCount);
		for (const TPair<uint64, FEntry>& Pair : Entries)
		{
			if (Pair.Value.Detail.PixelData.Num() > 0)
			{
				Order.Emplace(Pair.Value.LastUse, Pair.Key);
			}
		}
		Order.Sort([](const TPair<uint64, uint64>& A, const TPair<uint64, uint64>& B) { return A.Key < B.Key; });
		const int64 Target = DetailBudgetBytes * 9 / 10;
		for (const TPair<uint64, uint64>& Item : Order)
		{
			if (DetailBytes <= Target)
			{
				break;
			}
			FEntry& Entry = Entries[Item.Value];
			DetailBytes -= ImageBytes(Entry.Detail);
			--DetailCount;
			Entry.Detail.PixelData.Empty();
			++DetailEvictions;
			++Dropped;
		}
	}

	// Then overviews: the least recently used tiles without a detail image lose their images altogether.
	if (OverviewBudgetBytes > 0 && OverviewBytes > OverviewBudgetBytes)
	{
		TArray<TPair<uint64, uint64>> Order;
		Order.Reserve(Entries.Num());
		for (const TPair<uint64, FEntry>& Pair : Entries)
		{
			if (Pair.Value.Detail.PixelData.Num() == 0)
			{
				Order.Emplace(Pair.Value.LastUse, Pair.Key);
			}
		}
		Order.Sort([](const TPair<uint64, uint64>& A, const TPair<uint64, uint64>& B) { return A.Key < B.Key; });
		const int64 Target = OverviewBudgetBytes * 9 / 10;
		for (const TPair<uint64, uint64>& Item : Order)
		{
			if (OverviewBytes <= Target)
			{
				break;
			}
			OverviewBytes -= ImageBytes(Entries[Item.Value].Overview);
			Entries.Remove(Item.Value);
			++OverviewEvictions;
			++Dropped;
		}
	}
	return Dropped;
}

### Source/VoxelMap/Public/VoxelMap.h

// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "Modules/ModuleManager.h"

DECLARE_LOG_CATEGORY_EXTERN(LogVoxelMap, Log, All);

/**
 * VoxelMap module - Map data generation for voxel terrain.
 *
 * Provides a world subsystem that generates 2D tile map data from
 * terrain height and material queries. Tiles are generated asynchronously
 * and cached for consumption by UI widgets (minimap, world map).
 *
 * Key components:
 * - FVoxelMapTile: Serializable tile data (pixel colors for a chunk's XY footprint)
 * - UVoxelMapSubsystem: World subsystem managing tile cache, exploration tracking,
 *   and async tile generation
 *
 * The module is world-mode-agnostic — it queries IVoxelWorldMode interface
 * for terrain height and material data, working with any world mode.
 */
class FVoxelMapModule : public IModuleInterface
{
public:
	/** IModuleInterface implementation */
	virtual void StartupModule() override;
	virtual void ShutdownModule() override;

	/**
	 * Singleton-like access to this module's interface.
	 * Beware of calling this during the shutdown phase - module may have been unloaded.
	 */
	static inline FVoxelMapModule& Get()
	{
		return FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked<FVoxelMapModule>("VoxelMap");
	}

	/**
	 * Checks if this module is loaded and ready.
	 */
	static inline bool IsAvailable()
	{
		return FModuleManager::Get().IsModuleLoaded("VoxelMap");
	}
};

### Source/VoxelMap/Public/VoxelMapEditOverlay.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "Containers/ArrayView.h"
#include "Templates/Function.h"
#include "VoxelData.h"

/**
 * One chunk of a map tile's vertical stack, as handed to FVoxelMapEditOverlay::Build (VoxelMap, R22).
 *
 * Gathered on the game thread from the chunk manager and the edit manager; plain data afterwards, so the
 * build runs on a worker.
 */
struct VOXELMAP_API FVoxelMapOverlayChunk
{
	/** Chunk Z coordinate. The stack's X and Y are the tile's. */
	int32 ChunkZ = 0;

	/**
	 * Edit-merged voxels of the chunk (ChunkSize^3, chunk-local index X + Y*CS + Z*CS*CS), shared with the chunk
	 * manager's snapshot cache. Null = the chunk has no voxel data loaded.
	 */
	TSharedPtr<const TArray<FVoxelData>> Voxels;

	/**
	 * Per column (PY * ChunkSize + PX): local Z of the highest edited voxel in this chunk, -1 where the column has
	 * no edit. Empty when the chunk has no edits at all.
	 */
	TArray<int16> TopEditedZ;
};

/** Everything FVoxelMapEditOverlay::Build needs for one tile, as plain data. */
struct VOXELMAP_API FVoxelMapOverlayBuildInput
{
	/** Voxels per chunk edge, which is also the tile's pixels per edge. */
	int32 ChunkSize = 0;

	/** World units per voxel. */
	float VoxelSize = 0.0f;

	/** World Z of voxel 0 of chunk Z 0 (the world origin's Z). */
	float WorldOriginZ = 0.0f;

	/** Water is enabled; columns below WaterLevel read as water in the analytic map. */
	bool bUseWater = false;
	float WaterLevel = 0.0f;

	/**
	 * The tile's chunks that carry edits (loaded or not) plus loaded unedited chunks around them, in any order.
	 * Chunks that are not listed read as the analytic terrain: solid below the analytic height, air above it.
	 */
	TArray<FVoxelMapOverlayChunk> Chunks;
};

/**
 * One chunk around a planet map tile, as handed to FVoxelMapEditOverlay::BuildPlanet (spherical Phase 4, WM-SY8).
 * Gathered on the game thread; plain data afterwards.
 */
struct VOXELMAP_API FVoxelMapPlanetOverlayChunk
{
	/** Chunk coordinate. */
	FIntVector Coord = FIntVector::ZeroValue;

	/** Edit-merged voxels (ChunkSize^3, chunk-local index X + Y*CS + Z*CS*CS). Null = no voxel data loaded. */
	TSharedPtr<const TArray<FVoxelData>> Voxels;

	/** Which voxels carry an edit (one bit per voxel index). Null when the chunk has no edits. */
	TSharedPtr<const TBitArray<>> EditedVoxels;
};

/** Everything FVoxelMapEditOverlay::BuildPlanet needs for one planet tile, as plain data. */
struct VOXELMAP_API FVoxelMapPlanetOverlayInput
{
	/** Voxels per chunk edge, which is also the tile's pixels per edge. */
	int32 ChunkSize = 0;

	/** World units per voxel. */
	float VoxelSize = 0.0f;

	/** World position of voxel 0's density sample of chunk (0, 0, 0) (the world origin). */
	FVector Origin = FVector::ZeroVector;

	/** Planet centre and datum radius. */
	FVector Center = FVector::ZeroVector;
	double PlanetRadius = 0.0;

	/** Water is enabled; terrain inside WaterRadius of the centre reads as under the sea in the analytic map. */
	bool bUseWater = false;
	double WaterRadius = 0.0;

	/**
	 * The chunks that carry edits on the tile (loaded or not) plus loaded unedited chunks around them. Voxels in chunks
	 * that are not listed read as the analytic terrain along the pixel's line: solid below its analytic altitude.
	 */
	TArray<FVoxelMapPlanetOverlayChunk> Chunks;
};

/**
 * Per-tile map edit overlay (VoxelMap, QA refinement R22).
 *
 * Map tiles are drawn from the analytic terrain (world-mode height, conditioning, biome material), which knows
 * nothing about voxel edits. The overlay records, for one tile (one chunk column, one pixel per voxel column), the
 * columns where edits changed the TOP surface, with the edited surface height, its material and whether water covers
 * it (a water-flagged voxel in the air above it). Tile composition uses those values in place of the analytic ones.
 *
 * The overlay is built from edit-merged chunk data (FVoxelMapEditOverlay::Build) while the chunks are loaded, kept
 * per tile by UVoxelMapSubsystem, and is small enough to be saved with the world, so edits show on the map before
 * their area loads again.
 *
 * Masked columns are stored sparsely in ascending column order (column = PY * Resolution + PX). Plain value type,
 * safe to copy to and read from any thread.
 */
struct VOXELMAP_API FVoxelMapEditOverlay
{
	/** Serialization format of one overlay (Serialize). Bump when the layout changes. */
	static constexpr uint8 FormatVersion = 1;

	/** The same layout with altitudes for heights: a planet's overlay (bAltitudeHeights; spherical Phase 4). */
	static constexpr uint8 PlanetFormatVersion = 2;

	/** Water covers the surface: a water-flagged voxel in the air run above it (flag bit in Flags). */
	static constexpr uint8 FlagWater = 0x01;

	/** Pixels per tile edge (the chunk size). 0 for a default-constructed overlay. */
	int32 Resolution = 0;

	/**
	 * A planet tile's overlay (BuildPlanet): a column is the pixel's line along local up and Heights are altitudes above
	 * the datum. Saved as PlanetFormatVersion.
	 */
	bool bAltitudeHeights = false;

	/** Masked column indices (PY * Resolution + PX), ascending. */
	TArray<uint16> Columns;

	/** Edited surface height (world Z) per masked column; on a planet the altitude above the datum (bAltitudeHeights). */
	TArray<float> Heights;

	/** Surface material ID per masked column. */
	TArray<uint8> Materials;

	/** Flags per masked column (FlagWater). */
	TArray<uint8> Flags;

	/**
	 * Build output only, not saved: edited columns whose surface could not be resolved because a chunk it depends
	 * on is not loaded (for example a shaft dug into an unloaded chunk). The caller keeps the previous value for
	 * these columns (MergePending) and rebuilds once the chunk loads.
	 */
	TArray<uint16> PendingColumns;

	/** No masked column. */
	bool IsEmpty() const { return Columns.Num() == 0; }

	/** Number of masked columns. */
	int32 Num() const { return Columns.Num(); }

	/**
	 * Slot of a column in the parallel arrays.
	 * @param PX Pixel X in [0, Resolution)
	 * @param PY Pixel Y in [0, Resolution)
	 * @return Index into Heights / Materials / Flags, or INDEX_NONE when the column is not masked
	 */
	int32 FindColumn(int32 PX, int32 PY) const;

	/**
	 * Whether a column is pending (Build output).
	 * @param PX Pixel X
	 * @param PY Pixel Y
	 * @return True if the column is in PendingColumns
	 */
	bool IsPending(int32 PX, int32 PY) const;

	/**
	 * Build the overlay for one tile. Pure; runs on any thread.
	 *
	 * For every column some chunk marks as edited, assembles the voxel column from the top of the highest edited
	 * chunk (or the analytic surface chunk, whichever is higher) down to one chunk below the lowest edited one, and
	 * finds its top surface with FVoxelSurfaceQuery::ExtractSurfaceFromColumn. Chunks that are not listed read as
	 * the analytic terrain. The column is masked when an edited voxel lies at or above that surface and the surface
	 * differs from the analytic one (height by more than half a voxel, material, or water). Buried edits, such as
	 * dungeon interiors, therefore produce nothing. A column whose scan needs a listed chunk with no data, or falls
	 * through the stack, is reported in PendingColumns.
	 *
	 * Cost: O(edited columns x stack voxels), e.g. ~1M voxel reads for a fully edited tile three chunks deep.
	 *
	 * @param Input            The tile's chunk stack and world constants
	 * @param AnalyticHeights  Analytic surface height per column (ChunkSize^2, row-major PY * ChunkSize + PX)
	 * @param AnalyticMaterial Analytic surface material of a column (PX, PY); called only for columns that would
	 *                         otherwise match the analytic surface
	 * @return The overlay (Resolution = ChunkSize); empty when no edit changed the top surface
	 */
	static FVoxelMapEditOverlay Build(
		const FVoxelMapOverlayBuildInput& Input,
		TConstArrayView<float> AnalyticHeights,
		TFunctionRef<uint8(int32 PX, int32 PY)> AnalyticMaterial);

	/**
	 * Build the overlay for one planet tile (spherical Phase 4, WM-SY8). Pure; runs on any thread.
	 *
	 * A column is the pixel's line along local up (its direction from the centre). For every pixel whose line passes
	 * through an edited chunk, walks the line from two voxels above the highest edited chunk (or the analytic surface)
	 * down to a chunk below the lowest, reading the nearest voxel every half voxel (listed chunks' voxels; elsewhere the
	 * analytic terrain), and takes the first solid voxel under air as the surface, refined on the line by the trilinear
	 * density as UVoxelChunkManager::QueryEditMergedSurfacePoint does. The column is masked when an edited voxel lies on
	 * the walk at or above that surface and the surface differs from the analytic one (altitude by more than half a
	 * voxel, material, or water: a water-flagged voxel in the air above). A walk that meets a listed chunk with no data
	 * before the surface, or a surface in the analytic stand-in under the analytic altitude (dug into an unloaded
	 * chunk), is pending.
	 *
	 * @param Input             The tile's chunks and world constants
	 * @param PixelDirections   Unit direction of each pixel's line (ChunkSize^2, row-major PY * ChunkSize + PX)
	 * @param AnalyticAltitudes Analytic surface altitude per pixel (same layout)
	 * @param AnalyticMaterial  Analytic surface material of a pixel (PX, PY)
	 * @return The overlay (Resolution = ChunkSize, bAltitudeHeights); empty when no edit changed the surface
	 */
	static FVoxelMapEditOverlay BuildPlanet(
		const FVoxelMapPlanetOverlayInput& Input,
		TConstArrayView<FVector> PixelDirections,
		TConstArrayView<float> AnalyticAltitudes,
		TFunctionRef<uint8(int32 PX, int32 PY)> AnalyticMaterial);

	/**
	 * Fill a fresh build's pending columns from the previous overlay, so a column waiting on an unloaded chunk keeps
	 * showing what it showed before.
	 * @param Built    Build output (its PendingColumns are kept in the result)
	 * @param Previous The tile's current overlay, or null
	 * @return Built's masked columns plus Previous's masked columns at Built's pending columns
	 */
	static FVoxelMapEditOverlay MergePending(const FVoxelMapEditOverlay& Built, const FVoxelMapEditOverlay* Previous);

	/**
	 * Whether two overlays agree on the tile's border columns (the ones neighbouring tiles read for their hillshade
	 * apron). Null counts as empty.
	 * @param A First overlay or null
	 * @param B Second overlay or null
	 * @return True if the border columns are masked identically with identical values
	 */
	static bool BordersEqual(const FVoxelMapEditOverlay* A, const FVoxelMapEditOverlay* B);

	/**
	 * Serialize to or from an archive: format version (FormatVersion, or PlanetFormatVersion for altitude heights),
	 * resolution, a column mask (Resolution^2 bits), then height, material and flags for each masked column in column
	 * order. PendingColumns are not serialized.
	 * @param Ar The archive
	 * @return False when loading malformed data (the overlay is then reset to empty)
	 */
	bool Serialize(FArchive& Ar);

	/** Value equality of the saved fields (pending columns ignored). */
	bool operator==(const FVoxelMapEditOverlay& Other) const;
};

/** A tile coordinate with its edit overlay: the unit UVoxelMapSubsystem saves and restores (R22 phase 3). */
struct VOXELMAP_API FVoxelMapTileOverlay
{
	/** Tile coordinate (chunk X, Y; a planet's atlas coordinate). */
	FIntPoint Tile = FIntPoint::ZeroValue;

	/** The tile's overlay. */
	FVoxelMapEditOverlay Overlay;
};
```

### Source/VoxelMap/Public/VoxelMapSubsystem.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "Subsystems/WorldSubsystem.h"
#include "VoxelMapTypes.h"
#include "VoxelMapEditOverlay.h"
#include "VoxelMapTileQueue.h"
#include "VoxelMapTileStore.h"
#include "VoxelCoreTypes.h"
#include "VoxelEditTypes.h"
#include "VoxelWorldModeTypes.h"
#include "VoxelCubeSphere.h"
#include "VoxelSeaSurface.h"
#include "TimerManager.h"
#include "VoxelMapSubsystem.generated.h"

class IVoxelWorldMode;
class UVoxelChunkManager;
class UVoxelEditManager;
class UVoxelBiomeConfiguration;
struct FVoxelFarFieldSurface;

/**
 * A planet's coarse albedo for the world map's globe zoomed out (spherical Phase 6, WM-BP11): a cube-sphere grid of at
 * most UVoxelMapSubsystem::GlobeAlbedoCellsPerEdge cells a face edge, each the colour of the surface at its centre as a
 * tile pixel draws it (water by depth under the sea; land the surface material, shaded by elevation and a hillshade),
 * sampled from the analytic surface the far field draws (FVoxelFarFieldSurface). Where a pixel of the globe spans many
 * tiles, the world map reads this instead of one tile pixel each.
 */
struct VOXELMAP_API FVoxelMapGlobeAlbedo
{
	/** The albedo's cells (the same faces and warp as the tile grid, coarser) */
	FVoxelCubeSphereGrid Grid;

	/** One colour per cell, atlas order: Y * 6N + X */
	TArray<FColor> Colors;

	/** Time the build took (s, on its thread) */
	double BuildSeconds = 0.0;

	/** The colour of a cell (atlas coordinate). */
	const FColor& At(const FIntPoint& Cell) const { return Colors[Cell.Y * 6 * Grid.GetCellsPerEdge() + Cell.X]; }
};

/**
 * World subsystem that manages 2D map tile data for voxel terrain.
 *
 * Generates tile images by sampling terrain height and material from
 * IVoxelWorldMode — works with any world mode without casting.
 *
 * Tile generation is dual-strategy:
 * 1. Event-driven: binds to UVoxelChunkManager::OnChunkGenerated to auto-generate
 *    tiles as chunks stream in.
 * 2. Predictive: RequestTilesInRadius() generates tiles ahead of chunk streaming
 *    using deterministic height queries (no loaded chunk data needed).
 *
 * Voxel edits (QA R22): the analytic terrain knows nothing about digs, builds or POI stamps, so each edited tile
 * keeps an FVoxelMapEditOverlay of the columns whose top surface an edit changed. UVoxelEditManager::OnChunkEdited
 * marks tiles dirty; every voxel.Map.EditRefreshSeconds the dirty tiles whose edited chunks are loaded gather their
 * edit-merged snapshots (UVoxelChunkManager::GetEditMergedSnapshot) and redraw, building the overlay in the tile
 * task. Tiles whose chunks are not loaded keep their current overlay until a chunk of theirs generates.
 *
 * Tile images live under a fixed memory budget (world modes review WM-E2, finding KI15; FVoxelMapTileStore): every
 * drawn tile keeps a small overview image, and the detail image only while recently used (voxel.Map.DetailBudgetMB,
 * voxel.Map.OverviewBudgetMB). Exploration is separate and never evicted: a tile that lost its images is drawn again
 * when the minimap (RequestTilesInRadius) or the world map (RequestTileImage) asks for it.
 *
 * Planets (spherical Phase 4, WORLD_MODES_REVIEW_PLAN.md §18, WM-SY8): a tile is a cell of the cube-sphere grid
 * (FVoxelCubeSphereGrid, N = ceil((pi / 2) * R / chunk size) cells a face edge, so a tile is about a chunk across),
 * addressed by its atlas coordinate (Face * N + tile U, tile V); every FIntPoint key, the store, the queue, the budgets and
 * the save blobs work unchanged. A tile's pixels run along the face's U and V; each is the terrain along its direction
 * from the centre (material by QueryPlanetSurfaceConditions, water by the sea sphere, shading by altitude, hillshade in
 * the local frame). Edit overlays walk each pixel's line along local up and store altitudes.
 *
 * All tile generation runs on background threads. The subsystem has zero
 * knowledge of players, characters, or UI — purely manages tile data.
 */
UCLASS()
class VOXELMAP_API UVoxelMapSubsystem : public UWorldSubsystem
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	// --- Tile Queries ---

	/**
	 * Get a generated tile: its detail image, or its overview when the detail was evicted (the tile's Resolution says
	 * which; callers scale by it). Counts as a use, which keeps the tile's images from eviction.
	 * @return The image, or nullptr if the tile has none (not drawn yet, or evicted)
	 */
	const FVoxelMapTile* GetTile(FIntPoint TileCoord) const;

	/** Check if a tile has an image (detail or overview), regardless of exploration state. */
	bool HasTile(FIntPoint TileCoord) const;

	/** Check if a tile has its full-resolution image. */
	bool HasTileDetail(FIntPoint TileCoord) const;

	/**
	 * Ask for an explored tile's image when it has none (evicted), or its detail when bDetail and it only has the
	 * overview. The world map calls this for the tiles it shows (WM-E2).
	 * @param TileCoord Tile coordinate (chunk X, Y)
	 * @param bDetail Want the full-resolution image (a zoomed-in view), not just the overview
	 * @return True if a drawing was queued (or the tile's queued drawing now keeps its detail)
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	bool RequestTileImage(FIntPoint TileCoord, bool bDetail);

	/** The tile images and their budgets (diagnostics, tests). */
	const FVoxelMapTileStore& GetTileStore() const { return TileStore; }

	/**
	 * Pixels a side of a tile's overview image: the detail resolution over FVoxelMapTileStore::OverviewDownsample.
	 * A view that shows more texels per tile than this wants detail (RequestTileImage).
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	int32 GetTileOverviewResolution() const { return FMath::Max(1, CachedChunkSize / FVoxelMapTileStore::OverviewDownsample); }

	/** Apply voxel.Map.DetailBudgetMB / voxel.Map.OverviewBudgetMB (called when they change). */
	void ApplyTileBudgets();

	/**
	 * Debug (voxel.Map.ExploreAll): mark every tile that overlaps the world's bounds explored, as a fully explored save
	 * restores it, and queue their images (overview only). Unbounded worlds: the tiles within Radius of Center. A planet
	 * (spherical Phase 6, WM-BP11): its whole atlas up to voxel.Map.ExploreAllMaxTiles tiles (16 million on a 50 km
	 * planet, 6.4 billion at 1,000 km), else that many nearest Center; the images of the nearest
	 * PlanetExploreAllImageTiles queued, the rest drawn when the map shows them.
	 * @return Number of tiles explored
	 */
	int64 ExploreAllTiles(const FVector& Center, float Radius);

	/** Planets: ExploreAllTiles queues the images of at most this many tiles (nearest first); the rest draw when shown. */
	static constexpr int32 PlanetExploreAllImageTiles = 65536;

	// --- The globe zoomed out (spherical Phase 6, WM-BP11) ---

	/** Most cells along a globe albedo's face edge (never more than the tile grid has). */
	static constexpr int32 GlobeAlbedoCellsPerEdge = 256;

	/**
	 * A planet's coarse albedo for the globe zoomed out (FVoxelMapGlobeAlbedo). The first call starts the build on a
	 * worker thread (about a second at 256 cells a face edge); OnMapTileReady fires with (-1, -1) when it is ready.
	 * @return The albedo, or null until it is built (and in heightmap worlds)
	 */
	const FVoxelMapGlobeAlbedo* GetGlobeAlbedo();

	/**
	 * Whether any explored tile lies in a cell of the globe albedo's grid: the globe's fog of war zoomed out.
	 * @param AlbedoCell Atlas coordinate in the albedo's grid
	 * @return True when explored (false without an albedo)
	 */
	bool IsGlobeCellExplored(const FIntPoint& AlbedoCell);

	/**
	 * Pure: build a planet's globe albedo (any thread): every cell's colour from the analytic surface at its centre.
	 * @param Surface The planet's analytic surface
	 * @param CellsPerEdge Cells along a face edge
	 * @param MaterialPalette Colour per material id (256)
	 * @param AltitudeMin Lowest terrain altitude over the datum (the depth shading)
	 * @param AltitudeMax Highest (the elevation shading)
	 * @return The albedo
	 */
	static TSharedPtr<FVoxelMapGlobeAlbedo> BuildGlobeAlbedo(const FVoxelFarFieldSurface& Surface, int32 CellsPerEdge,
		const TArray<FColor>& MaterialPalette, float AltitudeMin, float AltitudeMax);

	// --- Exploration ---

	/**
	 * Mark tiles in radius as explored and request generation for any not yet cached.
	 * Call this from external code (character plugin) to drive predictive generation.
	 *
	 * @param WorldPos Player or camera world position
	 * @param Radius World-unit radius around the position to explore
	 */
	void RequestTilesInRadius(const FVector& WorldPos, float Radius);

	/** Check if a tile has been explored. */
	bool IsTileExplored(FIntPoint TileCoord) const;

	/**
	 * Whether a tile holds any of the world: it overlaps the world mode's footprint (an island's R + falloff; every
	 * tile on a plane). Only such tiles are explored, so exploration stops at the world's edge (world modes review
	 * WM-I2, KI9). True before the map has resolved its world.
	 *
	 * @param TileCoord Tile coordinate (chunk X, Y)
	 * @return True when the tile overlaps the world
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	bool IsTileInsideWorld(FIntPoint TileCoord) const;

	/**
	 * The world's bounds as the map resolved them (unbounded before the map has resolved its world). The world map
	 * clamps its pan to them.
	 *
	 * @return The bounds
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	FVoxelWorldBounds GetWorldBounds() const { return CachedWorldBounds; }

	/** Get all explored tile coords. */
	const TSet<uint64>& GetExploredTiles() const { return ExploredTiles; }

	/**
	 * The explored tiles as a compact blob for a save: zlib-compressed int32 (X, Y) pairs, base64-encoded. A string
	 * keeps it JSON-safe (packed 64-bit keys would lose precision as JSON numbers) and small (neighbouring tiles
	 * compress well).
	 * @param OutCount Receives the number of tiles encoded (needed to decode)
	 * @return The encoded tiles; empty when nothing is explored
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	FString ExportExploredTiles(int32& OutCount) const;

	/**
	 * Restore explored tiles saved by ExportExploredTiles and queue their map images. Merges into the current set:
	 * exploration only grows, and tiles already explored this session (the spawn area streams in before a save
	 * loads) stay explored.
	 * @param Encoded The blob from ExportExploredTiles
	 * @param Count   The tile count ExportExploredTiles reported
	 * @return Number of tiles restored (0 for an empty or malformed blob)
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	int32 ImportExploredTiles(const FString& Encoded, int32 Count);

	/**
	 * Pure: encode tile coordinates (see ExportExploredTiles).
	 * @param Tiles Tile coordinates to encode
	 * @return Base64 of the zlib-compressed int32 (X, Y) pairs; empty for no tiles or a compression failure
	 */
	static FString EncodeTileCoords(const TArray<FIntPoint>& Tiles);

	/**
	 * Pure: decode EncodeTileCoords output.
	 * @param Encoded  The encoded blob
	 * @param Count    Number of tiles it holds
	 * @param OutTiles Receives the coordinates (emptied first)
	 * @return False for a malformed blob (OutTiles left empty)
	 */
	static bool DecodeTileCoords(const FString& Encoded, int32 Count, TArray<FIntPoint>& OutTiles);

	// --- Edit overlays (R22) ---

	/**
	 * The edit overlay a tile is drawn with: the columns whose top surface voxel edits changed.
	 * @param TileCoord Tile coordinate (chunk X, Y)
	 * @return The overlay, or null when no edit changes the tile's surface (or it is not known yet)
	 */
	const FVoxelMapEditOverlay* GetEditOverlay(FIntPoint TileCoord) const;

	/** Number of tiles with an edit overlay. */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	int32 GetEditOverlayCount() const { return EditOverlays.Num(); }

	/**
	 * The edit overlays as a compact blob for a save (R22 phase 3), so edits show on the map after a load before
	 * their areas load again. See EncodeEditOverlays for the format.
	 * @param OutCount Receives the number of tiles encoded
	 * @return The encoded overlays; empty when no tile has one
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	FString ExportEditOverlays(int32& OutCount) const;

	/**
	 * Restore overlays saved by ExportEditOverlays. They replace the current overlays. Every tile whose overlay
	 * changes is redrawn and marked for a refresh, which reconciles it with the edits loaded next: a tile whose
	 * edited chunks are loaded is rebuilt from them, a tile with no edits left is cleared, and any other tile keeps
	 * the saved overlay until its chunks load. Call it before loading the edits.
	 * @param Encoded The blob from ExportEditOverlays (empty clears every overlay)
	 * @return Number of tiles restored (0 for an empty or malformed blob)
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	int32 ImportEditOverlays(const FString& Encoded);

	/**
	 * Pure: encode tile overlays. Binary payload: magic 'VMEO', format version, tile count, then per tile its X, Y
	 * and FVoxelMapEditOverlay::Serialize data; zlib-compressed behind its uncompressed size, base64-encoded.
	 * @param Overlays Tiles and overlays to encode
	 * @return The blob; empty for no tiles or a compression failure
	 */
	static FString EncodeEditOverlays(const TArray<FVoxelMapTileOverlay>& Overlays);

	/**
	 * Pure: decode EncodeEditOverlays output.
	 * @param Encoded     The blob
	 * @param OutOverlays Receives the tiles (emptied first)
	 * @return False for a malformed blob (OutOverlays left empty); true for an empty blob
	 */
	static bool DecodeEditOverlays(const FString& Encoded, TArray<FVoxelMapTileOverlay>& OutOverlays);

	/**
	 * Redraw every explored tile, keeping the current images until the new ones land.
	 * @param bRebuildOverlays Also rebuild the edit overlay of every tile with edits (from loaded chunks)
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	void RedrawAllTiles(bool bRebuildOverlays);

	/**
	 * One-line state summary for diagnostics (voxel.Map.Stats).
	 * @return Cached / explored / queued tiles, overlays and their pending state
	 */
	FString GetDebugStats() const;

	/**
	 * Debug (voxel.Map.Capture): write the explored tiles around a world position to a PNG, north up as the world map
	 * draws them, with the position marked. Copies the cached tile pixels, so before/after comparisons need no UI
	 * capture.
	 * @param Center            World position at the image centre
	 * @param RadiusTiles       Tiles from the centre tile to each edge (0-64)
	 * @param FilePath          Output .png path
	 * @param bHighlightOverlay Tint edit-overlay columns magenta
	 * @return True if the file was written
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map|Debug")
	bool CaptureMapImage(const FVector& Center, int32 RadiusTiles, const FString& FilePath, bool bHighlightOverlay) const;

	// --- Coordinate Helpers ---

	/** Convert a world position to a tile coordinate (chunk XY). */
	FIntPoint WorldToTileCoord(const FVector& WorldPos) const;

	/** Convert a tile coordinate to world position (tile origin corner). */
	FVector TileCoordToWorld(FIntPoint TileCoord) const;

	/** Get the world size of a single tile edge (ChunkSize * VoxelSize). */
	float GetTileWorldSize() const;

	/** Get the tile resolution (pixels per edge, matches ChunkSize). */
	int32 GetTileResolution() const { return CachedChunkSize; }

	// --- Planets (spherical Phase 4, WM-SY8) ---

	/**
	 * Whether the map is a planet's: tiles are cells of the cube-sphere grid (GetPlanetTileGrid) addressed by atlas
	 * coordinates, and a tile's pixels run along its face's U and V instead of world X and Y.
	 * @return True once the map has resolved a planet world
	 */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Voxel|Map")
	bool IsPlanetMap() const { return PlanetGrid.IsValid(); }

	/** The planet's tile grid (invalid in heightmap worlds and before the map has resolved its world). */
	const FVoxelCubeSphereGrid& GetPlanetTileGrid() const { return PlanetGrid; }

	/** The planet's centre (zero in heightmap worlds). */
	FVector GetPlanetCenter() const { return CachedPlanetCenter; }

	/** The planet's datum radius (zero in heightmap worlds). */
	double GetPlanetRadius() const { return CachedPlanetRadius; }

	/**
	 * The tile and pixel a direction from the planet centre falls in.
	 * @param Direction Unit direction
	 * @param OutTile   Atlas coordinate of the tile
	 * @param OutPX     Pixel along the tile's U, in [0, GetTileResolution())
	 * @param OutPY     Pixel along the tile's V
	 * @return False in heightmap worlds
	 */
	bool PlanetDirectionToTilePixel(const FVector& Direction, FIntPoint& OutTile, int32& OutPX, int32& OutPY) const;

	// --- Events ---

	/** Fired on game thread when a tile finishes generating. */
	DECLARE_MULTICAST_DELEGATE_OneParam(FOnMapTileReady, FIntPoint);
	FOnMapTileReady OnMapTileReady;

protected:
	virtual void Initialize(FSubsystemCollectionBase& Collection) override;
	virtual void Deinitialize() override;
	virtual bool ShouldCreateSubsystem(UObject* Outer) const override;

private:
	/** Pack an FIntPoint into a uint64 key for TMap/TSet (avoids GetTypeHash issues). */
	static uint64 PackTileKey(FIntPoint Coord);

	/** Unpack a uint64 key back to FIntPoint. */
	static FIntPoint UnpackTileKey(uint64 Key);

	/** Event-driven: called when VoxelChunkManager generates a new chunk. */
	UFUNCTION()
	void OnChunkGenerated(FIntVector ChunkCoord);

	/** Terrain conditioning changed (POI pads registered after the first tiles): rebuild every tile image. */
	void HandleTerrainConditioningChanged();

	/**
	 * Queue a tile for background generation and start what the concurrency cap allows.
	 * @param TileCoord   Tile coordinate
	 * @param bInvalidate The tile's current image is stale: a drawing already running is discarded and redone
	 * @param bPriority   Draw before the backlog (edit refreshes)
	 */
	void QueueTileGeneration(FIntPoint TileCoord, bool bInvalidate = false, bool bPriority = false);

	/** Start waiting tiles up to MaxConcurrentTileGenTasks. */
	void LaunchWaitingTiles();

	/**
	 * Launch a tile drawing (the queue already marked it drawing). Captures inputs on the game thread, draws on a
	 * background thread, stores the result back on the game thread.
	 * @param TileCoord  Tile coordinate
	 * @param Generation The tile's queue generation at start (a mismatch at completion discards the result)
	 */
	void GenerateTileAsync(FIntPoint TileCoord, uint32 Generation);

	/** Resolve the chunk manager and cache configuration. Returns true if ready. */
	bool ResolveChunkManager();

	/**
	 * Drop explored tiles outside the world (a save explored before exploration stopped at the edge).
	 * @return Number of tiles dropped
	 */
	int32 PruneExploredOutsideWorld();

	/** UVoxelEditManager::OnChunkEdited: update the edited-chunk index and mark the tile's overlay dirty. */
	void HandleChunkEdited(const FIntVector& ChunkCoord, EEditSource Source, const FVector& EditCenter, float EditRadius);

	/** Record whether a chunk has edits in TileEditedChunkZ. */
	void RecordChunkEdits(const FIntVector& ChunkCoord);

	/** Mark a tile's overlay for a rebuild at the next coalesced refresh. */
	void MarkOverlayDirty(uint64 TileKey);

	/** Arm the one-shot refresh timer (voxel.Map.EditRefreshSeconds) unless it is already running. */
	void ArmOverlayRefresh();

	/** Coalesced refresh: queue overlay rebuilds for dirty tiles whose edited chunks are loaded. */
	void FlushOverlayRefresh();

	/**
	 * Whether every edited chunk the tile's surface can depend on has voxel data: those at or above one chunk below
	 * the tile's lowest analytic surface (all of them while that is not known yet).
	 */
	bool CanRebuildOverlay(uint64 TileKey) const;

	/** Game thread: gather the tile's chunk stack (shared snapshots + edited-column tables) for an overlay build. */
	TSharedPtr<FVoxelMapOverlayBuildInput> GatherOverlayInput(FIntPoint TileCoord) const;

	/** Game thread: a planet tile's edited chunks and the loaded chunks around them, for FVoxelMapEditOverlay::BuildPlanet. */
	TSharedPtr<FVoxelMapPlanetOverlayInput> GatherPlanetOverlayInput(FIntPoint TileCoord) const;

	/** GenerateTileAsync on a planet: the same inputs, queue and completion, the pixels along their directions. */
	void GeneratePlanetTileAsync(FIntPoint TileCoord, uint32 Generation);

	/**
	 * Game thread: store a finished drawing (either world kind), unless it went stale or the subsystem is shutting down;
	 * then start the waiting tiles.
	 */
	void FinishTileDrawing(FIntPoint TileCoord, TArray<FColor>&& PixelData, int32 Resolution, uint32 Generation, bool bRebuild,
		const TSharedPtr<const FVoxelMapEditOverlay>& Overlay, bool bOverlayPending, float AnalyticMin, float AnalyticMax);

	/** The tile a step away: TileCoord + (DX, DY) on a plane; the grid's neighbour (across a face edge too) on a planet. */
	FIntPoint GetNeighbourTile(FIntPoint TileCoord, int32 DX, int32 DY) const;

	/** The tiles a chunk belongs to: its (X, Y) on a plane; on a planet the cells its corners span. */
	void GetChunkTiles(const FIntVector& ChunkCoord, TArray<FIntPoint>& OutTiles) const;

	// Cached references (resolved in Initialize or lazily)
	TWeakObjectPtr<UVoxelChunkManager> CachedChunkManagerWeak;

	/**
	 * Standalone analytic world mode OWNED by this subsystem (built from the world configuration in
	 * ResolveChunkManager — never borrowed from the chunk manager). Async tile tasks capture this
	 * TSharedPtr by value, so the instance outlives any in-flight task regardless of PIE-teardown
	 * order. The chunk manager frees ITS instance in EndPlay->Shutdown() while background tasks can
	 * still be running — capturing that raw pointer is what crashed on PIE stop.
	 *
	 * Carries the biome context as a VALUE snapshot (FVoxelBiomeSnapshot, set once on the game thread
	 * in CreateStandaloneWorldMode): still UObject-free — safe on a worker thread even after the world
	 * is GC'd — while GetTerrainHeightAt returns the TRUE generated surface height (continentalness
	 * offset + height-scale modulation, composed correctly per world mode).
	 */
	TSharedPtr<const IVoxelWorldMode> CachedWorldMode;

	FVoxelNoiseParams CachedNoiseParams;
	int32 CachedChunkSize = 32;
	float CachedVoxelSize = 100.0f;
	FVector CachedWorldOrigin = FVector::ZeroVector;
	bool bCacheResolved = false;

	/** The world mode's bounds (WM-I2): exploration only marks tiles that overlap them */
	FVoxelWorldBounds CachedWorldBounds;

	// Biome configuration (cached from VoxelWorldConfiguration)
	UPROPERTY()
	TObjectPtr<UVoxelBiomeConfiguration> CachedBiomeConfig;
	bool bBiomesEnabled = false;

	// Water level (cached from VoxelWorldConfiguration)
	bool bWaterEnabled = false;
	float CachedWaterLevel = 0.0f;

	/**
	 * Map color per MaterialID (256 entries), resolved once in ResolveChunkManager: the material
	 * atlas' baked average-albedo colors where available, the material registry's palette otherwise.
	 * Plain data — captured by value by tile tasks.
	 */
	TArray<FColor> CachedMaterialPalette;

	/**
	 * Terrain height bounds from the world mode (IVoxelWorldMode::GetTerrainHeightBounds) — the
	 * elevation-tint and water-depth gradients are scaled to this range instead of hardcoded
	 * constants, so shading adapts to the world configuration.
	 */
	float CachedTerrainMinHeight = 0.0f;
	float CachedTerrainMaxHeight = 0.0f;

	// Tile storage: images under the budgets (WM-E2), and the exploration set (never evicted; saved)
	FVoxelMapTileStore TileStore;
	TSet<uint64> ExploredTiles;

	/** Tiles whose queued drawing should keep its detail image (the minimap's area, a zoomed-in world map) */
	TSet<uint64> DetailWanted;

	/** Which tiles wait for a (re)draw, which are drawing, and per-tile generations (game thread). */
	FVoxelMapTileQueue TileQueue;

	/** Binding on the chunk manager's OnTerrainConditioningChanged. */
	FDelegateHandle ConditioningChangedHandle;

	/** Explored tiles were imported before the map could resolve its world: queue their images once it can. */
	bool bGenerateExploredWhenReady = false;
	FCriticalSection TileMutex;		// Guards TileStore writes (made on the game thread when a drawing completes)

	/** Max concurrent async tile generation tasks. */
	static constexpr int32 MaxConcurrentTileGenTasks = 4;

	/** Whether the subsystem has bound to chunk manager delegates. */
	bool bDelegatesBound = false;

	// --- Edit overlays (R22), game thread ---

	/** Per-tile edit overlay. Immutable once stored: tile tasks share them by pointer. */
	TMap<uint64, TSharedPtr<const FVoxelMapEditOverlay>> EditOverlays;

	/** Chunk Zs with edits, per tile, kept in step with the edit manager through OnChunkEdited. */
	TMap<uint64, TArray<int32>> TileEditedChunkZ;

	/** Tiles edited since the last refresh (coalescing buffer; water propagation edits every frame). */
	TSet<uint64> OverlayDirtyTiles;

	/** Tiles whose last overlay attempt lacked loaded chunks; retried when one of their chunks generates. */
	TSet<uint64> OverlayAwaitingTiles;

	/** Tiles whose next drawing gathers chunk data and rebuilds the overlay. */
	TSet<uint64> OverlayRebuildTiles;

	/** Lowest and highest analytic surface height per drawn tile (X = min, Y = max), for CanRebuildOverlay. */
	TMap<uint64, FVector2f> TileAnalyticRange;

	/** One-shot coalescing timer for FlushOverlayRefresh. */
	FTimerHandle OverlayRefreshTimer;

	// --- Planets (WM-SY8) ---

	/** The tile grid of a planet world; invalid in heightmap worlds. */
	FVoxelCubeSphereGrid PlanetGrid;

	/** The planet's centre and datum radius. */
	FVector CachedPlanetCenter = FVector::ZeroVector;
	double CachedPlanetRadius = 0.0;

	/** The world's sea (FVoxelSeaSurface::FromConfig): the planet's water sphere. */
	FVoxelSeaSurface CachedSea;

	/** The terrain's altitude extent (IVoxelWorldMode::GetAltitudeBounds): the planet's elevation and depth shading. */
	float CachedAltitudeMin = 0.0f;
	float CachedAltitudeMax = 0.0f;

	/** The globe albedo (GetGlobeAlbedo), whether its build is in flight, and the albedo cells holding an explored tile. */
	TSharedPtr<const FVoxelMapGlobeAlbedo> GlobeAlbedo;
	bool bGlobeAlbedoBuilding = false;
	TSet<uint64> GlobeExploredCells;
	int32 GlobeExploredFromCount = -1;
	double GlobeExploredRefreshedSeconds = 0.0;

	/** Edited chunks per planet tile (a chunk belongs to every tile its corners span), in step with OnChunkEdited. */
	TMap<uint64, TArray<FIntVector>> PlanetTileEditedChunks;

	/** GFrameCounter of the last overlay gather: LaunchWaitingTiles starts at most one rebuild per frame. */
	uint64 LastOverlayGatherFrame = MAX_uint64;

	/** The chunk manager's edit manager, and the OnChunkEdited binding on it. */
	TWeakObjectPtr<UVoxelEditManager> CachedEditManagerWeak;
	FDelegateHandle ChunkEditedHandle;

	/**
	 * Set in Deinitialize(). In-flight async completions arriving after this are discarded
	 * (no cache writes, no broadcasts) and no new generation tasks may start.
	 */
	bool bShuttingDown = false;
};

### Source/VoxelMap/Public/VoxelMapTileQueue.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "Templates/Function.h"

/**
 * The map's tile draw queue (VoxelMap, QA refinement R22): which tiles wait for a (re)draw, which are drawing, and
 * whether a finished drawing is still current. Kept free of the world so the policy unit-tests headless; the
 * subsystem owns one and calls it on the game thread only.
 *
 * - A request is independent of the tile cache: a cached tile can be queued for a redraw, and its cached image
 *   stays on screen until the new one lands.
 * - Each tile has its own generation. An invalidating request (an edit or conditioning change landed) bumps it, so
 *   a drawing that started earlier is discarded on completion and the tile is drawn again; other tiles' drawings
 *   are unaffected.
 * - A non-invalidating request for a tile that is drawing is satisfied by that drawing.
 * - Priority requests (edit refreshes) start before the backlog (for example restored exploration).
 */
class VOXELMAP_API FVoxelMapTileQueue
{
public:
	/**
	 * Ask for a tile to be drawn.
	 * @param Key         Packed tile key
	 * @param bInvalidate The tile's current content is stale: a drawing already running is discarded and redone
	 * @param bPriority   Start before non-priority tiles
	 */
	void Request(uint64 Key, bool bInvalidate, bool bPriority = false);

	/**
	 * Take the next waiting tile that is not drawing (priority tiles first) and mark it drawing.
	 * @param OutKey        Receives the tile key
	 * @param OutGeneration Receives the generation the drawing must report to Complete
	 * @return False when nothing can start
	 */
	bool StartNext(uint64& OutKey, uint32& OutGeneration);

	/**
	 * As StartNext, skipping waiting tiles the caller cannot start now (they keep waiting, in place).
	 * @param OutKey        Receives the tile key
	 * @param OutGeneration Receives the generation the drawing must report to Complete
	 * @param CanStart      Whether a waiting tile may start now
	 * @return False when nothing can start
	 */
	bool StartNext(uint64& OutKey, uint32& OutGeneration, TFunctionRef<bool(uint64 Key)> CanStart);

	/**
	 * Start a specific waiting tile now.
	 * @param Key           Packed tile key
	 * @param OutGeneration Receives the generation the drawing must report to Complete
	 * @return False when the tile is not waiting or is already drawing
	 */
	bool Start(uint64 Key, uint32& OutGeneration);

	/**
	 * A drawing finished.
	 * @param Key        Packed tile key
	 * @param Generation The generation Start / StartNext returned for it
	 * @return True if the result is current (store it); false if the tile was invalidated meanwhile (discard it;
	 *         the tile is waiting again)
	 */
	bool Complete(uint64 Key, uint32 Generation);

	/**
	 * A drawing could not start after all (no world mode): forget it. Leaves no trace of the tile in the queue.
	 * @param Key Packed tile key
	 */
	void Cancel(uint64 Key);

	/** The tile waits for a drawing (it may also be drawing, when it was invalidated meanwhile). */
	bool IsWaiting(uint64 Key) const { return Waiting.Contains(Key); }

	/** The tile is drawing now. */
	bool IsDrawing(uint64 Key) const { return Drawing.Contains(Key); }

	/** Waiting or drawing: a request would be redundant unless it invalidates. */
	bool IsQueued(uint64 Key) const { return IsWaiting(Key) || IsDrawing(Key); }

	/** Number of drawings in flight. */
	int32 NumDrawing() const { return Drawing.Num(); }

	/** Number of tiles waiting. */
	int32 NumWaiting() const { return Waiting.Num(); }

	/** The tile's current generation (0 until first invalidated). */
	uint32 GetGeneration(uint64 Key) const { return Generations.FindRef(Key); }

	/** Forget everything (shutdown). */
	void Reset();

private:
	/** Tiles waiting for a drawing. */
	TSet<uint64> Waiting;

	/** The waiting tiles that start first. A subset of Waiting. */
	TSet<uint64> PriorityWaiting;

	/** Tiles drawing now -> the generation their drawing started under. */
	TMap<uint64, uint32> Drawing;

	/** Per-tile generation; bumped by invalidating requests. */
	TMap<uint64, uint32> Generations;
};
```

### Source/VoxelMap/Public/VoxelMapTileStore.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "VoxelMapTypes.h"

/**
 * The map's tile images under a fixed memory budget (VoxelMap, world modes review WM-E2, finding KI15). Kept free of
 * the world so the policy unit-tests headless; UVoxelMapSubsystem owns one and calls it on the game thread.
 *
 * Every drawn tile keeps two images:
 *  - the detail image, the tile's full resolution (ChunkSize pixels a side: 64 x 64 x 4 bytes = 16 KB on the demo),
 *    which the minimap and a zoomed-in world map draw;
 *  - the overview, the detail image box-filtered down OverviewDownsample times a side (16 x 16 = 1 KB), which a
 *    zoomed-out world map draws (at the world map's default zoom a tile spans 16 of its texels).
 *
 * Two budgets, each enforced least recently used first:
 *  - DetailBudgetBytes: over it, the least recently used detail images are dropped; their tiles keep the overview
 *    (GetTile returns it, with its own Resolution) and are drawn again in detail when something asks for detail.
 *  - OverviewBudgetBytes: over it, the least recently used tiles without a detail image lose their overview too; they
 *    stay explored (the exploration set is separate, and saved) and are drawn again when looked at.
 * A tile is "used" when it is stored or read (Find with bTouch). Eviction trims to 90% of a budget, so it runs rarely.
 * A budget of 0 means unlimited (the store then behaves as the map did before WM-E2: every image kept).
 */
class VOXELMAP_API FVoxelMapTileStore
{
public:
	/** The overview is the detail image shrunk this many times a side */
	static constexpr int32 OverviewDownsample = 4;

	/**
	 * Set the budgets (bytes of image data; 0 = unlimited). Trims at once if over.
	 * @param InDetailBudgetBytes Detail images
	 * @param InOverviewBudgetBytes Overview images
	 */
	void SetBudgets(int64 InDetailBudgetBytes, int64 InOverviewBudgetBytes);

	/**
	 * Store a drawn tile: its detail image and the overview made from it. Then trim to the budgets.
	 * @param Key Packed tile key
	 * @param Coord Tile coordinate
	 * @param Pixels Detail image, Resolution x Resolution (moved from)
	 * @param Resolution Pixels a side
	 * @param bKeepDetail Keep the detail image (else only the overview is kept, unless the tile already had detail)
	 */
	void Store(uint64 Key, FIntPoint Coord, TArray<FColor>&& Pixels, int32 Resolution, bool bKeepDetail);

	/**
	 * The tile's best image: the detail image if kept, else the overview (its Resolution says which).
	 * @param Key Packed tile key
	 * @param bTouch Count this read as a use (keeps the tile from eviction)
	 * @return The image, or null when the tile has none
	 */
	const FVoxelMapTile* Find(uint64 Key, bool bTouch = true) const;

	/** @return True when the tile has any image */
	bool Contains(uint64 Key) const { return Entries.Contains(Key); }

	/** @return True when the tile has its detail image */
	bool HasDetail(uint64 Key) const;

	/** Drop a tile's images. */
	void Remove(uint64 Key);

	/** Drop everything. */
	void Reset();

	/** Trim to the budgets now. @return Number of images dropped (detail and overview) */
	int32 Enforce();

	/** @return Tiles with an image */
	int32 Num() const { return Entries.Num(); }

	/** @return Tiles with their detail image */
	int32 NumDetail() const { return DetailCount; }

	/** @return Bytes of detail images */
	int64 GetDetailBytes() const { return DetailBytes; }

	/** @return Bytes of overview images */
	int64 GetOverviewBytes() const { return OverviewBytes; }

	/** @return Detail images dropped and overviews dropped since Reset */
	int64 GetDetailEvictions() const { return DetailEvictions; }
	int64 GetOverviewEvictions() const { return OverviewEvictions; }

	/** @return The budgets (0 = unlimited) */
	int64 GetDetailBudget() const { return DetailBudgetBytes; }
	int64 GetOverviewBudget() const { return OverviewBudgetBytes; }

	/** Every tile key with an image (for redraws). */
	void GetKeys(TArray<uint64>& OutKeys) const { Entries.GetKeys(OutKeys); }

	/**
	 * Pure: box-filter an image down Factor times a side (Resolution must divide by it).
	 * @return The smaller image ((Resolution / Factor)^2 pixels); empty if the sizes do not fit
	 */
	static TArray<FColor> Downsample(const TArray<FColor>& Pixels, int32 Resolution, int32 Factor);

private:
	struct FEntry
	{
		FVoxelMapTile Detail;    // PixelData empty when dropped
		FVoxelMapTile Overview;
		mutable uint64 LastUse = 0;
	};

	int64 ImageBytes(const FVoxelMapTile& Tile) const { return static_cast<int64>(Tile.PixelData.Num()) * sizeof(FColor); }

	TMap<uint64, FEntry> Entries;
	mutable uint64 UseClock = 0;
	int64 DetailBytes = 0;
	int64 OverviewBytes = 0;
	int32 DetailCount = 0;
	int64 DetailBudgetBytes = 0;
	int64 OverviewBudgetBytes = 0;
	int64 DetailEvictions = 0;
	int64 OverviewEvictions = 0;
};
```

### Source/VoxelMap/Public/VoxelMapTypes.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "VoxelMapTypes.generated.h"

/**
 * A single map tile representing one chunk's XY footprint as a 2D color image.
 *
 * Each pixel maps to one voxel column in the chunk. The color is determined
 * by the surface material at that column (e.g., grass=green, stone=gray).
 *
 * Tiles are serializable via UPROPERTY for future save/load support.
 */
USTRUCT()
struct VOXELMAP_API FVoxelMapTile
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

	/** Tile coordinate in chunk space (X, Y). */
	UPROPERTY()
	FIntPoint TileCoord = FIntPoint(0, 0);

	/** Pixel data in BGRA format. Array size = Resolution * Resolution. */
	UPROPERTY()
	TArray<FColor> PixelData;

	/** Pixels per edge (matches ChunkSize, e.g. 32). */
	UPROPERTY()
	int32 Resolution = 0;

	/** Format version for future save/load compatibility. */
	UPROPERTY()
	uint8 Version = 1;

	/** Runtime-only flag: true when pixel data has been fully generated. */
	bool bIsReady = false;
};

### Source/VoxelMeshing/Private/QEFSolver.h
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"

/**
 * Quadratic Error Function solver for Dual Contouring.
 *
 * Minimizes: sum_i (n_i . (v - p_i))^2
 * where p_i are edge crossing points and n_i are surface normals.
 *
 * Uses SVD via Jacobi eigenvalue decomposition on the 3x3 normal matrix A^T*A.
 * Threshold controls which singular values are treated as zero (degenerate axes).
 */
struct FQEFSolver
{
	/** Accumulated A^T*A matrix (symmetric 3x3) */
	float ATA[3][3];

	/** Accumulated A^T*b vector */
	float ATb[3];

	/** Accumulated b^T*b scalar (for error computation) */
	float BTB;

	/** Mass point (average of all intersection points) */
	FVector3f MassPoint;

	/** Number of intersection planes added */
	int32 Count;

	FQEFSolver()
	{
		Reset();
	}

	void Reset()
	{
		FMemory::Memzero(ATA, sizeof(ATA));
		FMemory::Memzero(ATb, sizeof(ATb));
		BTB = 0.0f;
		MassPoint = FVector3f::ZeroVector;
		Count = 0;
	}

	/** Add an intersection plane defined by a point and normal. */
	void Add(const FVector3f& Point, const FVector3f& Normal)
	{
		// Accumulate A^T*A (outer product of normal)
		ATA[0][0] += Normal.X * Normal.X;
		ATA[0][1] += Normal.X * Normal.Y;
		ATA[0][2] += Normal.X * Normal.Z;
		ATA[1][1] += Normal.Y * Normal.Y;
		ATA[1][2] += Normal.Y * Normal.Z;
		ATA[2][2] += Normal.Z * Normal.Z;

		// Accumulate A^T*b where b_i = n_i . p_i
		const float Dot = FVector3f::DotProduct(Normal, Point);
		ATb[0] += Normal.X * Dot;
		ATb[1] += Normal.Y * Dot;
		ATb[2] += Normal.Z * Dot;

		BTB += Dot * Dot;

		// Accumulate mass point
		MassPoint += Point;
		Count++;
	}

	/** Merge another QEF's accumulated data into this one. */
	void Merge(const FQEFSolver& Other)
	{
		for (int32 i = 0; i < 3; i++)
		{
			for (int32 j = i; j < 3; j++)
			{
				ATA[i][j] += Other.ATA[i][j];
			}
			ATb[i] += Other.ATb[i];
		}
		BTB += Other.BTB;
		MassPoint += Other.MassPoint;
		Count += Other.Count;
	}

	/**
	 * Solve the QEF and return the optimal vertex position.
	 *
	 * @param SVDThreshold Singular values below this are zeroed (controls feature sharpness)
	 * @param CellBounds Bounding box for the cell — result is blended toward mass point if outside
	 * @param BiasStrength How aggressively to blend toward mass point when outside bounds (0-1)
	 * @return Optimal vertex position
	 */
	FVector3f Solve(float SVDThreshold, const FBox3f& CellBounds, float BiasStrength) const
	{
		if (Count == 0)
		{
			return CellBounds.GetCenter();
		}

		const FVector3f MP = MassPoint / static_cast<float>(Count);

		if (Count == 1)
		{
			return MP;
		}

		// Fill symmetric part
		float M[3][3];
		M[0][0] = ATA[0][0]; M[0][1] = ATA[0][1]; M[0][2] = ATA[0][2];
		M[1][0] = ATA[0][1]; M[1][1] = ATA[1][1]; M[1][2] = ATA[1][2];
		M[2][0] = ATA[0][2]; M[2][1] = ATA[1][2]; M[2][2] = ATA[2][2];

		// Solve (A^T*A) * v = A^T*b using SVD of the symmetric matrix
		// Jacobi eigenvalue decomposition: find eigenvalues and eigenvectors of A^T*A
		float Eigenvalues[3];
		float V[3][3]; // Eigenvectors as columns

		JacobiEigen3x3(M, Eigenvalues, V);

		// Pseudoinverse solution: v = V * S^-1 * V^T * (ATb)
		// where S^-1 inverts only eigenvalues above threshold
		float Result[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};

		for (int32 i = 0; i < 3; i++)
		{
			if (Eigenvalues[i] > SVDThreshold)
			{
				// Project ATb onto eigenvector i
				float Proj = 0.0f;
				for (int32 j = 0; j < 3; j++)
				{
					Proj += V[j][i] * ATb[j];
				}
				Proj /= Eigenvalues[i];

				// Accumulate into result
				for (int32 j = 0; j < 3; j++)
				{
					Result[j] += V[j][i] * Proj;
				}
			}
		}

		FVector3f QEFResult(Result[0], Result[1], Result[2]);

		// Clamp/blend toward mass point if outside cell bounds
		if (!CellBounds.IsInside(QEFResult))
		{
			const FVector3f Closest = CellBounds.GetClosestPointTo(QEFResult);
			const float DistOutside = FVector3f::Distance(QEFResult, Closest);
			const float CellSize = CellBounds.GetExtent().X * 2.0f;
			const float Blend = FMath::Clamp(DistOutside / FMath::Max(CellSize, 0.001f) * BiasStrength * 2.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
			QEFResult = FMath::Lerp(QEFResult, MP, Blend);
		}

		return QEFResult;
	}

private:
	/**
	 * Jacobi eigenvalue decomposition for a 3x3 symmetric matrix.
	 * Finds eigenvalues and eigenvectors via iterative Givens rotations.
	 */
	static void JacobiEigen3x3(float M[3][3], float OutEigenvalues[3], float OutEigenvectors[3][3])
	{
		// Initialize eigenvectors to identity
		for (int32 i = 0; i < 3; i++)
		{
			for (int32 j = 0; j < 3; j++)
			{
				OutEigenvectors[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
			}
		}

		// Copy matrix (we modify it in place)
		float A[3][3];
		FMemory::Memcpy(A, M, sizeof(A));

		// Jacobi iteration
		constexpr int32 MaxIterations = 20;
		for (int32 Iter = 0; Iter < MaxIterations; Iter++)
		{
			// Find largest off-diagonal element
			int32 p = 0, q = 1;
			float MaxVal = FMath::Abs(A[0][1]);

			if (FMath::Abs(A[0][2]) > MaxVal) { p = 0; q = 2; MaxVal = FMath::Abs(A[0][2]); }
			if (FMath::Abs(A[1][2]) > MaxVal) { p = 1; q = 2; MaxVal = FMath::Abs(A[1][2]); }

			// Convergence check
			if (MaxVal < 1e-8f)
			{
				break;
			}

			// Compute Givens rotation
			const float Diff = A[q][q] - A[p][p];
			float t;
			if (FMath::Abs(Diff) < 1e-10f)
			{
				t = 1.0f;
			}
			else
			{
				const float Phi = Diff / (2.0f * A[p][q]);
				t = 1.0f / (FMath::Abs(Phi) + FMath::Sqrt(Phi * Phi + 1.0f));
				if (Phi < 0.0f) t = -t;
			}

			const float c = 1.0f / FMath::Sqrt(t * t + 1.0f);
			const float s = t * c;

			// Apply rotation to A
			const float Tau = s / (1.0f + c);
			const float Apq = A[p][q];
			A[p][q] = 0.0f;
			A[p][p] -= t * Apq;
			A[q][q] += t * Apq;

			// Update remaining elements
			for (int32 r = 0; r < 3; r++)
			{
				if (r != p && r != q)
				{
					const float Arp = A[r][p];
					const float Arq = A[r][q];
					A[r][p] = A[p][r] = Arp - s * (Arq + Tau * Arp);
					A[r][q] = A[q][r] = Arq + s * (Arp - Tau * Arq);
				}
			}

			// Update eigenvectors
			for (int32 r = 0; r < 3; r++)
			{
				const float Vp = OutEigenvectors[r][p];
				const float Vq = OutEigenvectors[r][q];
				OutEigenvectors[r][p] = Vp - s * (Vq + Tau * Vp);
				OutEigenvectors[r][q] = Vq + s * (Vp - Tau * Vq);
			}
		}

		// Extract eigenvalues from diagonal
		OutEigenvalues[0] = A[0][0];
		OutEigenvalues[1] = A[1][1];
		OutEigenvalues[2] = A[2][2];
	}
};
```

### Source/VoxelMeshing/Private/TransvoxelTables.cpp
```
// Copyright Daniel Raquel. All Rights Reserved.

#include "TransvoxelTables.h"

/**
 * Transvoxel lookup tables implementation.
 *
 * These tables are derived from Eric Lengyel's official Transvoxel Algorithm implementation.
 * Source: https://github.com/EricLengyel/Transvoxel (MIT License)
 * Reference: https://transvoxel.org/
 *
 * The transition cell has 9 sample points arranged in a 3x3 grid:
 *     6---7---8
 *     |   |   |
 *     3---4---5
 *     |   |   |
 *     0---1---2
 *
 * Each sample can be inside (1) or outside (0) the isosurface, giving 512 cases.
 * These map to 56 equivalence classes via rotation and reflection symmetry.
 *
 * IMPORTANT: The high bit (0x80) of TransitionCellClass indicates inverted winding order.
 */

namespace TransvoxelTables
{

// Sample point offsets in 2D face coordinates (0-1 range)
const FVector2f TransitionSampleOffsets[9] = {
	FVector2f(0.0f, 0.0f),   // 0: bottom-left
	FVector2f(0.5f, 0.0f),   // 1: bottom-center
	FVector2f(1.0f, 0.0f),   // 2: bottom-right
	FVector2f(0.0f, 0.5f),   // 3: middle-left
	FVector2f(0.5f, 0.5f),   // 4: center
	FVector2f(1.0f, 0.5f),   // 5: middle-right
	FVector2f(0.0f, 1.0f),   // 6: top-left
	FVector2f(0.5f, 1.0f),   // 7: top-center
	FVector2f(1.0f, 1.0f),   // 8: top-right
};

// 3D sample offsets for each face orientation
// Face 0: -X, Face 1: +X, Face 2: -Y, Face 3: +Y, Face 4: -Z, Face 5: +Z
//
// Each face has 13 sample points:
// - Samples 0-8: The 9 points of the high-resolution 3x3 grid (the FINE face)
// - Samples 9-12 (0x9-0xC): The 4 low-resolution corners (the COARSE face)
//
// ORIENTATION (corrected 2026-06-14 — see LOD_SEAM_INVESTIGATION.md T9):
// The transition strip is one fine cell thick on the finer chunk's boundary slab.
// Fine MC owns everything INWARD of the strip; the coarser neighbor owns everything
// OUTWARD. For a watertight (manifold) strip the two faces MUST be:
//   - The fine 9-sample face (0-8) on the INNER side, so it shares vertices with the
//     finer chunk's regular MC cells on that plane (no inner T-junctions).
//   - The coarse 4-corner face (9-12) on the OUTER side (the chunk boundary, toward
//     the coarser neighbor), so it produces only coarse-grid vertices matching the
//     neighbor exactly (no outer T-junctions).
// (Previously these were inverted, which left ~60 open edges per strip; the inner
// face under-tessellated against fine MC and the outer face T-junctioned against the
// coarse grid. The inversion was masked by a coarse midpoint-override + fin-snapping.)
//
// "Depth" is the face-normal axis. For NEGATIVE faces the chunk boundary is at local
// depth 0, so coarse corners sit at depth 0 and the fine face at depth 1. For POSITIVE
// faces the boundary is at local depth 1 (the cell base is one fine cell short of the
// chunk face), so coarse corners sit at depth 1 and the fine face at depth 0.
//
// The Transvoxel face sample layout (looking at the fine face from OUTSIDE the chunk):
//     6---7---8   (v=1, "top")
//     |   |   |
//     3---4---5   (v=0.5)
//     |   |   |
//     0---1---2   (v=0, "bottom")
//    u=0 0.5  1
const FVector3f TransitionCellSampleOffsets[6][13] = {
	// Face 0: -X. Boundary at X=0 -> coarse corners at X=0, fine face at X=1.
	{
		// Fine face samples (X=1): u->Y, v->Z
		FVector3f(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 0.5f, 0.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f),
		FVector3f(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.5f), FVector3f(1.0f, 0.5f, 0.5f), FVector3f(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.5f),
		FVector3f(1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 0.5f, 1.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f),
		// Coarse corners (X=0): correspond to fine corners 0,2,6,8
		FVector3f(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f), FVector3f(0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f),
	},
	// Face 1: +X (mirror in Y). Boundary at X=1 -> coarse corners at X=1, fine face at X=0.
	{
		// Fine face samples (X=0): u->-Y (mirrored), v->Z
		FVector3f(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.5f, 0.0f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f),
		FVector3f(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.5f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.5f, 0.5f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.5f),
		FVector3f(0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.5f, 1.0f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f),
		// Coarse corners (X=1, mirrored Y)
		FVector3f(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f),
	},
	// Face 2: -Y. Boundary at Y=0 -> coarse corners at Y=0, fine face at Y=1.
	{
		// Fine face samples (Y=1): u->X, v->Z
		FVector3f(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(0.5f, 1.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f),
		FVector3f(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.5f), FVector3f(0.5f, 1.0f, 0.5f), FVector3f(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.5f),
		FVector3f(0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), FVector3f(0.5f, 1.0f, 1.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f),
		// Coarse corners (Y=0)
		FVector3f(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f), FVector3f(1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f),
	},
	// Face 3: +Y (mirror in X). Boundary at Y=1 -> coarse corners at Y=1, fine face at Y=0.
	{
		// Fine face samples (Y=0): u->-X (mirrored), v->Z
		FVector3f(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(0.5f, 0.0f, 0.0f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f),
		FVector3f(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.5f), FVector3f(0.5f, 0.0f, 0.5f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.5f),
		FVector3f(1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f), FVector3f(0.5f, 0.0f, 1.0f), FVector3f(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f),
		// Coarse corners (Y=1, mirrored X)
